brjod pas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub par byed na/bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' gang ting nge 'dzin 'di thos nas 'dzin pa dang ske/ kun chub par byed pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par sgrogs 1)pa dang / sgom napa'i sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa lta ci smos te/ bzang skyong ting nge 'dzin 'di thos nas rjes su yi rang bar mi byed/ lung nod par mi byed/ kun chub par mi byed/'chang bar mi byed/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par sgrogs par mi byedam/ sgom 4pa'i sbyor ba la brtson par mi gnas pa lta su zhig yod/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bzang skyong 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin 'di thos pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bzang skyong de bas na khyod mos par bya'o/ /khyod kyis 5khong du chud par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub don du gnyer ba rnams kyis ri/ gal te ting nge 'dzin 'di dpag tshad tsam na yod par thos na / bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub don du gnyer ba des ting nge 'dzin 'di mnyan pa'i phyir dpag tshad tsam gyi bar der 'gro bar bya'o/ /thos nas kyang gzung bar bya/ kun chub par bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag 8par bya/gzhan dag la yang rgya cher bstan par bya/ bshad par bya/ bsgrag 9par bya'o/ /bsgom pa la yang 1 mngon par dga' bar bya'o/ /bzang skyong dpag tshad tsam lta zhog gi/ dpag tshad gnyis tsama'am1 / dpag tshad gsum tsama'am 2/dpag tshad bzhi tsama'am ri/ dpag tshad lnga tsam nas dpag tshad bcu'i bar 56—151

tsama'am1la/ bzang skyong dpag tshad bcu tsam lta'ang zhog gi/ gal te byang chub sems dpas dpag tshad brgya na da na/ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ljongs kyi phyogs che ge mo zhig na 5nispyod do zhes ting nge 'dzin 'di dpag tshad brgya'is bar tsam na yod par thos na yang ske/ bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub don du gnyer ba des zhum pa med pa dang / snyom las med pa dang /'jigs pa med pa dang / sgyid lug pa med pa dang / gdung ba med pa'i sems dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa mi lhod pas ting nge 'dzin 'di 5tha na mnyan pa nyi tse 6tsam gyi phyir yang dpag tshad brgya po der 'gro bar bya na lung mnod pa dang / kun chub par bya ba dang / bsgrag 7par bya ba dang / bsgom par bya ba'i phyir lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bzang skyong 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams ni ting nge 'dzin 'di la rag las pa'i phyir ro / /bzang skyong de la byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum 9tshogs pa byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag gis dpag tshad brgya po der song nas/ gang las ting nge 'dzin 'di thos par gyur pa'i slob dpon de la des ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /chos smra ba'i rigs kyi bu de la bsnyen bkur thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed cing phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /tha na ting nge 'dzin 'di mnyan pa tsam gyi phyir yang lo gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ gsum mam/ bzhi 1 'am/ lnga'am/ lo bcu'am / brgya'am/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i 11bar du phyi bzhin 'brang bar 12bya na lung mnod pa'am/ kun chub par bya ba'am/ bri ba'am/ bcang ba'am/56—152

bsgrags1/pa'am/ bsgomatshan)pa'i phyir lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bzang skyong rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo des rang nyam gtang bar bya ste/ btang nas kyang slob dpon de'i blo bzhin du 'jug par bya'o/ /gus pa dang bcas pa dang /zhe sa dang bcas pas slob dpon gyi phyir 'brang bar bya'o/ /bka' bzhin du byed pas phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /bka' mi gcog pa dang / mdza' ba brtagamachos pa dang / ngo mi rtag 45pa spangs pa dang / nyes par lta ba med pas phyi bzhin 'brang bar bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'du shes kyang bskyed par bya'ol/ /de la ston pa'i 'du shes kyang nye bar gzhags par bya'o/ /bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' des 7slob dpon de la de ltar nan tan byed na sngon chos kyis phongs par 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags 8pa ma gtogs par tha na ting nge 'dzin 'di nyan pa tsam yang mi thob pa ni gnas ma yin skabs ma yin te de ni gnas med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' des slob dpon de la khrel yod pa dang /byas pa gzo ba dang byas 9pa shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na de'i ting nge 'dzin de'i tshig dang yi ge de yun ring du gnas pa dang / rmongs pa med par 'gyur na/bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' gang ting nge 1 'dzin 'di grong gzhan na yod par thos sam grong gi 11zhing gzhan na yod par thos la/ thos nas kyang tha na mnyan pa tsam gyi phyir yang 'gro bar bya ba lta ci smos/ lung mnod par bya ba dang ske/ kun chub par bya ba dang / bcang bar bya ba dang / bklag tu par bya ba dang / bri bar bya ba dang / bsgom par byab dang / gzhan dag la yang 15yang dag par bsgrag 7par bya ba'i phyir lta'ang smos kyang ci dgos/ bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' gang ting nge 'dzin 'di tshol bas tha na ting nge 'dzin 'di 56—153

thos pa tsam yang thob pa ni 1bzang skyong khyod mos par bya khyod kyis khong du chud par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid tshol ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / chos don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang chos 'dod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin par rig par bya na/bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' gang ting nge 'dzin 'di lung nod par byed/kun chub par byed/ 'chang bar byedas/ klog par byed la/ lung mnod pa dang ske/ kun chub par bya ba dang / bcang bar bya ba dang / bklag 5par byas nas kyang gzhan dag la ston par byed/ sgrogs 4par byed/ yang dag par sgrogs 5par byed cing bsgom pa'i sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa lta smos kyang ci dgos de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mi yi 6mchog / seng ge 7blo gros zhes bya rjes dran te/ /der ni mi yi dbang po rgyal po des/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni de tshe thos par gyur/ /rgyal pos ting 'dzin 'di ni thos nas kyang / /sems mgu dga' ba dpe med pas bzung ste/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas seng ge'i blo gros la / /spar gang gi ni rin po ches kyang gtor/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis legs gsungs ting 'dzin 'di/ /sems can thams cad la ni phan par shog /khyod la skyabs su de ring mchi'o zhes/ /de snyam bsams 8nas tshig tu'ang brjod par gyur / /rgyal po de ni de yi 9las kyis ni/ /shi nas de nyid du ni yang skyes te/ /des ni dge slong rin chen zhes bya bar/ /phyogs su grags pa mthu chen mthong bar gyur/ /de las de nyid kyang ni thos gyur te/ /thos nas dga' ba shin tu 51—154

rgyas pa skyed/ /bskyed nas byang chub zhugs pa dga' gyur te/ /gser dang gos kyis dge slong dgab byas nas/ /de ni ting 'dzin 'di yang 'dod pa'i phyir / /srog chags stong dang lhan cig rab tu byung / /lo ni stong phrag brgya snyed tshang bar yang / /de dag kun gyi dge slong de phyir 'brangs/ /thos pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'di/ /lan gnyis ma yin lan gcig 1kho na thos/ / de yi 2dran pa skyo ba ma skyes shing 8/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di ni yongs su tshol / /de dag kun gyis las 'di byas pa'i phyir/ /stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas mthu chen rnams ni mnyes par byas/ /de las 5ting 'dzin 'di ni thos par gyur/ /de bas 6bde bar gshegs pa gzhan dag kyang / /stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad tshang ba mchod / /bde bar gshegs pa seng ge'i blo gros la/ /bdag ni rjes su yi rang bgyid ces brjod/ /bsod nams byas pa de yis rgyal po de/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa zhes bya'i sangs rgyas gyur/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig bsam mi khyab/ /thams cad de yis skye zhing 'chi las bkrol/ /stong du tshang ba'ang rjes su slob 8slob nas/ /sangs rgyas gyur te dpa' brtan zhes bya bar/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten la ni grags par gyur/ /ting 'dzin sgras kyang byang chub reg gyur na/ /srid pa thams cad la ni mi brten par/ /gang zhig ting 'dzin 'di ni rgya che bar/ /ston pa de dag byang chub 'gyur bar ni/ /smos ci dgos te nam yang the tsom med/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di/ /dpag tshad brgya na gal te yod gyur kyang / /byang chub don du gnyer ba nyin mtshan du/ /nam yang mi 'dug song ste mnyan par bya/ /gal te song nas 'di ni ma rnyed na/ /'on kyang de yi bsod nams tshad med de/ /de 56—155

ni de yi 1byang chub bskyed yin na/ /gang gis song ste 'di thos smos nami dgos//de phyir gang zhig ting 'dzin 'di 'dod pas/ /dang por tshangs pas byin de dran par byos/ /dge slong gang la ting 'dzin 'di yod la/ /skyo ba'i sems ni med par bsten par bya/ /rjes su dran te 5skye ba snga ma la/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug lo tshang bar/ /ngas ni chos smra ba la rtag brten canakyang / /ting 'dzin 'di ni nam yang thos ma gyur/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas bden pa ltazhes bya 6)byung / /de na dge slong gzhon nu thos mang zhing / /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa nub 'og tu/ /de tshe des ni ting 'dzin 'di nyid bzung / /nga ni de na rgyal rigs rgyal po ste/ /dge slong che ge mo zhig ting 'dzin 'di/ /'dzin gyis 7drung du legs par nanyon cig ces/ /rmi lam du ni ting 'dzin 'di thos nas/ /myur du langs te rings pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'di 'dzin pa yi 9dge slong de btsal te//mthong nas rab tu byung ba de las ni/ /'di nyid lan 'ga' thos lta srid dam zhes / /stong phrag drug cu rtsa drug lo tshang bar/ /ngas ni dge slong de la dga' bas bkur/ /bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /lan 'ga' tsam yang thos par ma gyur te/ /de phyir dge slong rnams dang dge slong ma/ /dge bsnyen dag dang dge bsnyen ma rnams la/ /ting 'dzin thos nas myur du zung 1 shig ces/ /mos 1par byed cing khong du chud par byed/ /der ni bskal pa tshang bar 'dug nas kyang / /ting 'dzin 'dzin pa de ni bsnyen cing bsten/ /bskal pa stong du legs par bsnyen bkur byas/ /des ni ting 'dzin 'di yang bshad par gyur/ /ting 'dzin rdul med 'di la rab spyod pa'i/ /dge slong grong du slong ba de nyid la/ /bza' ba dang ni bca' dang mal cha dang / /de 56wa 156

bzhin gos kyang 17bye ba byin par gyuran/ /bca' dang bza' dang mal stan 5de bzhin gos/ /mang po bye ba thams cad lta yang zhog /gal te rang gi sha byinasar thob na ni/ /legs spyad yin na zas skom smos ci dgos/ /rtag 6tu bran gyur bsnyen bkur byed cing ni/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di yang tshol byed la/ /mkhas pas rnyed 7nas de yang myur byed kyang / /de la byas pa gzo ba ma yin rnal/ /bskal pa namang po bye bar btsal kyang ni/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /'di yi sgra yang brgya lam thos 'gyur smyon/ /kha ton byas nas ston pa smos ci dgos/ /gang gis gang gā'i 1 bye snyed 'jig rten khams/ /rin po ches ni bkang ste byin pa bas/ /gang zhig 'di las tshigs 1 bcad 'ga' lung mnos12/ /de yi bsod nams tshad gzung mi sla'o/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i 1 bye snyed du/ /gang rtag brtson 'grus brtsams te gnas pa bas / /gang zhig 'di las tshigs 1 bcad 'ga' lung mnos/ / de yi 15bsod nams tshad gzung mi sla'o/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i 17bye snyed du/ /gang rtag 1 mi rten bsam gtan sgom pa bas/ /gang zhig 'di las tshigs 18bcad 'ga' lung mnos19/ /de yi bsod nams tshad gzung mi sla'o/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /gang rtag shes rab gnas par gyur pa bas/ /gang zhig 'di las tshigs bcad 21'ga' lung mnos/ / de yi 22bsod nams tshad gzung mi sla'o/ /bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 2 le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //bzang skyong de bas na dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos ting nge 56—157

'dzin 'di gus par byas te mnyan par bya'o/ /thos nas kyang gzung bar bya/kun chub par bya/ yi ger bri bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ bklag 1par bya'o/ /bzung zhing kun chub par byas nas kyang gzhan dag la yang 2rgya cher yang dag par bsgrag par bya'o/ /legs par bris te gzhag par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / bzang skyong nga 'das pa'i 'og tu ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa' dad pa can dang ba / brtag pa mang ba rimang po 'byung bar 'gyur te/de dag sems can rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir mang du thos pa tshol 6bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag mang du thos pa tshol 7bas dam pa'i chos tshol ba'i /phyir phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag tu rgyu bar 'gyur te/ bzang skyong sems can de lta bu chos don du gnyer ba/ chos la mos pa/ chos 'dod pa/ chos yongs su 'dzin pa/ shin tu rgyas pa 'dzin pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang ched du ting nge 'dzin 'di lung mnos ‘ shing bstan la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 0byin gyis brlabs te/ glegs bam chen por legs par bris nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag rgyas btab la gzhag par bya'o/ /bzang skyong de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag rgya gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/chos thams cad byed pa med pa/ bya ba med pa/ mngon par 'dus ma byas pa/chags pa med pa/ dmigs su med pa/ stong pa nyid/ mtshan ma med pa/smon pa med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa/ gnyis su med pa/ 'jug pa med pa/brten pa med pa/ bgrang du med pa/ rnam par gzhag tu med pa/ gzung ba ཿmed pa/ dor ba med pa/ gnas pa med pa/ chos thams cad rtag pa 15med pa/ chad pa med pa/ rgyu zad pa/ sdug bsngal zad pa/ dngos po zad 56wa 158

pa / mi skye ba/ mi 'gag pa/ mi gnas pa/ mi 'jig pa/ lam med pa/lam gyi 'bras bu med pa/ 'phags pa thams cad kyis ma 1dkrugs pa/ byis pa thams cad kyis spangs pa/ mi shes pa rnams kyis bor ba/ mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su bzung ba ste/ bzang skyong 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis phyag rgya 2gang gis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa rnams la btab pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /bzang skyong de bas na byang chub don du gnyer ba'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus der ting nge 'dzin 'di lung mnod par 'dod pas/ lung 3mnos shing kha ton 4du byas nas gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bsgrag /par bya'o/ /bzang skyong de la chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tha na ting nge 'dzin 'di mnyan 6pa'i phyir yang brtson par 'gyur na lung mnod pa dang / kha ton 7bya ba'i phyir lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sngon lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su sbyangs pa dang / sngon smon lam btab pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mos pa dang / ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mar yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i chos dkon mchog gi mdzod 'di 'chang bar 'gyur/ ston par 'gyur snyam nas chos kyi tshul thams cad len pa ste/bzang skyong chos bzhi po 'di dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di mnyan pa dang / gzung 8ba dang / bcang ba'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro/ /bzang skyong gzhan yang chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal ba la tha na yi ger bri ba tsam gyi phyir yang brtson par 56—159

'gyur ro/ /bzhi 1gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas yid la byed pa dang /phyi phyir zhing chos rjes su dran pa la mkhas pa dang / chos thams cad dmigs pa yongs su gcod pa yid la byed pa dang / mtshan ma thams cad rnam par 'jig pa la mkhas pa ste/ bzang skyong chos de bzhi nadang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal ba la tha na bri ba tsam gyi phyir yang brtson par 'gyur ro/ /bzang skyong de la chos bzhi dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal ba la brtson par rig par bya'o/ /bzhi 4cigang zhe na/'di lta ste/ chos thams cad gzung du med pa'i dngos por 5)yongs su gcod pa'i shes pas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtson par rig par bya'o / /sangs rgyas kyi sku dmigs pa rnam par sgom pa la mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtson par rig par bya'o/ /dmigs pa thams cad du sangs rgyas dmigs pa yid la byed pas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtson par rig 6par bya'o/ /chos thams cad dngos po dang bral bar mos pa la mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di la brtson par rig par bya ste7/ bzang skyong chos de bzhi dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal ba la mngon par brtson par rig par bya'o / /bzang skyong phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos kun tu 'khrug pa'i tshe sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i phyir gang la la zhig ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal ba la brtson par gyur cing / de 'di snyam du ting nge 'dzin 'di ji ltar na shin tu rgyas pa dang / rgya che ba dang / yun ring du gnas par 'gyur snyam du sems bskyed 56—160

par gyur na/ rigs kyi bu de'i bsod nams mang du bskyed de/ bsod nams kyi phung po de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gzhol bar rig par bya ba ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi phung po de'i mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po de smon lam gyi dbang gis myur du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gzhol bar 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs chen po dang ldan pa/bdag med par gnas pa las nges par byung ba/ gang dag gis bskal pa tshad med grangs med gzhal du med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'am/ de bas kyang lhag par go cha chen po bgos pa rnams ni ma gtogs te/ de dag thams cad ni bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ de dag thams cad ni spyod pa'i khyad par ji lta ba dang / tshogs ji lta ba bzhin du nges par 'byung ngo ske/ /bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen 1pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par 'dod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa thob par 'dod pas phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe 'jigs pa chen po 'byung ba dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig pa'i dus der ting nge 'dzin 'di yi ger bri ba dang ske/ lung mnod pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bsgrag napar bya ba'i phyir sbyor bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes ni bzang skyong ting nge 'dzin 'di'i nang du 'dus so/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la mkhas pa bsgrubs dpas/ chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa 'di ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ste/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 56—161

rnams dmigs pa thams cad sangs rgyas la dmigs par mos so/ /dmigs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthar 'jug par byed do/ /dmigs pa tsho1dngos po thams cad rang bzhin gyis ya ma brlar 2shes so/ /de dag ji lta ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dmigs par byed pa dang / yid la byed pa de lta de ltar de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba rnam par dag caste/ de lta bu la gnas pa de dag ni phyogs gang du yang de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mi 'gyur ba med de/ de dag ni phyogs thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa —mthong ba rnam par sbyong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba rnam par dag nas tshegs chung ngus 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid du dmigs pa byas na 'di nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa de dag mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad med pas de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mthong ba yongs su dag par 'gyur te / de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa rnams de'i mig lam du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dmigs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni gzung ba med pa'i phyir/dmigs pa gcig gis dmigs pa thams cad 'dzin pa yang ma yin/ dmigs pa thams cad kyis dmigs pa gcig 'dzin pa yang ma yin 5no/ /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nye bar brtags na shin tu nye bar zhi ba'i phyir dngos po med pa nyid du grub pa'o/ /bzang skyong de lta bu la gnas pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong ba rnam par dag par 'gyur la/ rnam par dag nas kyang dzorlom sems su mi byed/ spros par mi byed de/ de dag ni da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad kyang yongs su 51—162

rdzogs pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang dag gsungs pa ni/ /ji lta bzhin du ye shes 'jug pa yin/ /de ni 'jig rten gtso bo ston pa'i sras/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di la ni yid kyang brtson/ /gang gis sangs rgyas dmigs pa rjes dran pa/ /dmigs pa'i don ni du ma mthong bar 'gyur1 / /de la ting 'dzin zhi ba blta 2dka' 'di/ /phyi ma'i dus na mngon sum du yang 'gyur/ /mkhas pa gang zhig chos kun mi rten cing / /sems can dag la phan phyir yid brtson pa/ /de dag phyi dus 'jigs pa chen po'i tshe/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di la ni sbyor bar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la phan zhing gzung ba'i phyir/ /gang zhig rtag 3tu blta dka' 4chos 'di la/ /dran pa brtan par 'jog cing brtson byed pa/ / de yi zilag tu ting 'dzin 'di 'gro 'gyur / /gang zhig dran dang blo gros rtogs pa dag /sangs rgyas dmigs par rtag tu 'jog byed cing / /gzhan dring mi 'jog rnal 'byor brtson pa de/ /ting 'dzin chen po 'di la gnas par 'gyur/ /rjes su gzung phyir blta dka' 6tshig la gnas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni yid skyo zhing / /mkhas pa srid pa thams cad mi 'dod pa/ /de dag ting 'dzin chen po 'di la brtson kyi/ /byang chub 'dod cing phan phyir snying brtse gang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku la rtog /zhi ba'i chos la smon lam 'debs byed pa/ /de dag ting 'dzin 'di la brten 8par brtson/ /'thab pa med cing rtsod pa med la zhi/ /bde bar gshegs pas bstod pa'i chos tshol 9zhing / /sangs rgyas dmigs pa la ni rtag gnas pa/ /de dag ting 'dzin 'di la brtag brtson yin/ /gang dag phyi ma'i 56—163

sdig pa'i dus de na/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di la ni brtson byed pa/ /spyod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas la gnas pa/ /de yi yon tan 'jig rten mgon pos mkhyen/ /gang dag zag pa med pa'i chos shes shing / /shin tu tshul bzhin zag pa rnams kyang shes/ /rtog pa med spyod mnyam pa nyid gnas pa/ /de dag ting 'dzin 'di la brtag brtson yin/ /gang dag bde gshegs chos ni tshad med la/ /shes bzhin du yang kun tu 1smon pa 2'debs shing / /kun mkhyen /ye shes la ni brtan gnas pa/ /de la ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di ston to/ /mtshan nyid med cing mtshan nyid las kyang 'das/ /nyon mongs pa dang rnam cadag gang yang med/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i chos rnams gang shes pa/ /de dag bde bar gshegs pa tshad med mthong / /gang zhig dmigs pa mtha' med brtson byed kyang / /dmigs pa thams cad stong pa nyid du shes/ /blta bar dka' dag mthong nas rlom sems med/ /des ni bde bar gshegs pa tshad med mthong / /gang zhig don mthong yid kyang rnam par dag /nyon mongs med cing zhi ba'i go 'phang gnas / /rdul dang bral zhing mnyan don chos ston pa/ /de la ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di bshad do/ /bde gshegs sras po zug rngu phyung ba gang / /bden pa ma 5nyams ( the tsom rnams dang bral/ /srog chags phan phyir byams pa sgom 7byed pa//de dag la ni don mchog 'di bshad do/ /gang zhig rang bzhin gyis ni ma rig bral / /rig pas ma rig gnas ni sel byed cing / /don mchog 'di la brtson par sbyor byed pa/ /de la ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di bshad do/ /rnam dag gnas shing kun nas nyon mongs med/ /ye shes mtha' yas mngon par 'dod byed cing ske/ /nges don 'di la mchog tu dga' thob pa/ /de la rnam thar zhi ba 'di 56wa 164

bshad do/ /gang zhig kun tu sbyor ba kun las grol/ /brtan zhing srog chags kun la snying brtse zhing / /gnod sems med cing zhi lam dga' brten pa/ /de la ting 'dzin 'di ni yang dag bsgrags/ /bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //bzang skyong chos 'di bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi 1gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas la gus pa dang / mi phyed pa'i dang ba yid la byed pa dang / chos la gus shing 5nyan 'dod pa dang / chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i tshig bsgrub dpa ste/ bzang skyong chos bzhi po de cadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di thob ci par 'gyur ba'o/ /bzang skyong gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di thob par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/yid la phyin ci log med pas sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems pa 5)dang /chos la the tsom med pas dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid rang bzhin gyis dge ba la rtog pa dang / dngos po la mkhas pa la rtog pas ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa/ shin tu stong pa'i chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba dang / 'du shes rnam par 'jig 6pa la mkhas pa/ yongs su gcod pa shes pa la rtog pas dngos po ya ma brla rnam par 'jig pa ste/ bzang skyong 7chos de bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /bzang skyong gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas 56—165

thams cad kyis rjes su bzung ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa la mkhas la dam pa'i chos bsrung 1zhing sbed 2pa dang / sems can thams cad la bde bar sbyor zhing sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i sems dang / sems can gyi 'du shes rnam par 'jig pa la mkhas pa ste/ bzang skyong chos de bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ting nge 'dzin 3'di thob par 'gyur caba'o/ /bzang skyong de bas na phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos cher 'khrug pa'i tshe/ der byang chub sems dpas 5lus dang srog kyang yongs su btang ba la gnas te/ ting nge 'dzin 'di gzung bar bya'o/ /kun chub par bya'o/ /bcang bar bya'o/ /bzang skyong chos thams cad gzung ba la mkhas pa la brtson 6pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 7bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas par yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i chos rin po che'i mdzod 'di yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir 'jog par 'gyur/ chos 'di lta bu 'di yang dag par bstan pa dang / rnam par dbye ba dang / yang dag par bsgrags 8par bya ba yang nus par 'gyur ro/ /bzang skyong byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brtson 'grus kyi ‘ gnas 'di dag ni yod de1 / byang chub sems dpa' rnams brtson 'grus kyi byin gyi rlabs 1 kyis/ sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir smon lam la 12'jug par 'gyur ro / /bzang skyong gang zhig phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus der chos 'di dag 'jog par byedarka/ yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / sems can thams cad yang dag par gzung ba'i phyir 56wa 166

zhugs pa yin te/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs su gzung 1bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na 'dug kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /de ni chos 'dod pa dang / chos don du gnyer ba dang / chos bsgrub pa'i phyir phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na ting nge 'dzin 'di'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin par 'gyur ba de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa'i nor rnams kyis yang dag par gzung 2bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag phyi ma'i tshe phyi mi'i 3dus na chos 'di lta bu 'di dag yongs su gzung ba'i phyir gnas par 'gyur ba de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa labargyad dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang myur du 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /gang zhig brtan pa chos sems pa/ /phyi ma'i dus su gyur pa na/ /dam chos gzung phyir gnas gyur pa/ /de dag la ni gzungs ci 'di bshad/ /gang dag dam chos rin chen phyir/ /'jigs pa med pa (tshobartson byed cing / /snying yang brtse la snying rje canam/ /de dag chos kyang 'dzin par gnas/ /brtan cing ཿ bag yod dga' ba dang ske/ /thub pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ /de dag don du ting nge 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa bstan 8pa yin/ /gang zhig chos rgyal skyob pa yis /gang dag byin gyis brlabs gyur pa/ /de dag phyi dus 'jigs bcas tshe /56—167

chos nyid 'di ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /shin tu ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /chos rnams stong zhing spros med par/ /dran dang ldan pa gang gis shes/ /de dag chos kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /thams cad chos kyi ngo bo nyid/ /de la bsam yas tshigs su bcad/ /nges pa nyid du shes 'gyur ba1/ /de dag chos kyang 'dzin par 'gyur / /zad pa shes la gnas gyur cing / /mi skye ba la'ang narab gnas la/ /sems ni dul zhing ngo tsha ldan/ /de dag chos kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /bde ba'i lam ni bla na med/ /cang shes lam la zhugs gyur pa/ /brtson 'grus byin gyi rlabs dang ldan/ /de dag chos 'dzin gnas pa yin/ /de bzhin nyid dang mi rtog don/ /gang gis chos nyid rab tu shes/ /de la spros pa ci yang med/ /de dag chos kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ thams cad chos ni byed med par / /des pa gang gis shes pa de/ /ci yang med cing len med pa'i/ /chos nyid de ni sgrogs par 'gyur/ /'dzin pa med cing 'dzin dang bral/ /chos kun sngon nas yongs dag par/ /gang gis shes pa de dag ni/ /chos kyi spyod yul gnas pa yin/ /chos kun ngo bo med par ni/ /de ltar chos la gang gis shes / /de dag chos nyid 'di ston 'gyur/ /de ni 'jug pa yin par bshad/ /ming med ming dang bral gyur cing / /spros pa med cing mi skye bar/ /gang gis chos nyid rab shes pa/ /de dag stong pa nyid kyang sgrogs5/ /gnas pa med cing 'gro ba med/ /nam mkha'i gnas bzhin dag par ni/ /gang gis chos 'di shes gyur pa/ /de la ting 'dzin skye bar 'gyur/ /gang dag 'du shes don rtog bral/ /ngo bo nyid du ma skyes shing / /dngos po'i 'du shes bral gyur pa/ /de dag chos nyid ston par 'gyur/ /rgyas gdab de ni rgya med de/ /dgongs 56—168

——————wa wa— ——————wa ——————————wa —pa'i tshig tu gsungs pa yin/ /gang gis de ltar shes gyur pa/ /de dag chos // dīgipa shādzin 'gyur/ /bzang skyong gis zhus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste nyi bzang skyong de lta bas na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo 1tshodag gis bag yod pa lhur blangs te/ chos 'di dag yang dag par bsdu bar bya'o/ /'di'i phan yon la yang 5sbyar bar bya'o/ /tshul bzhin dang yang ldan par bya'o/ /tshul bzhin ma yin pa yang yongs su spang bar bya ste/ de ltar na /chos zab mo blta bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba/ gang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skyed par byed pa/ rang byung 4rnams kyi ye shes dang / thogs pa med pa'i ye shes thob par byed pa 'di rnyed mi dka' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 5chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang ske/ lid tsa bī tsigazhon nu rin chen 'byung gnas dang / khyim bdag ded dpon che bzang medang / tshong dpon gyi bu phug sbas dang / bram ze 'dam bus byin dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang pos byin dang / khyim bdag chu lha dang glu/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya tsam po de dag dang / 'khor bzhi po las ji snyed cig 'dus pa de dag thams cad dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rnams ngas bskal pa bye ba 8khrag khrig phrag brgya stong du yang dag par bsgrubs pa bla na med pa'i chos rin po che 'di'i mdzod dang / 'jig rten thams cad yid ches 56wa 169

par mi 'gyur ba zab mo/ /don zab pa/ rnam par thar pa sgo gsum gyi tshul bshad pa/ zab mo byang ba1/ mthong bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba/mkhas shing shes pas 2rig pa/ rgya che ba/ gya rnam pa/ don phun sum tshogs pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di yang khyed la gtad do/ /rjes su gtad do/ /gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rten du gyur pa de dag kyang ske/ khyed la nyis gyur catu rjes su gtad gyis / khyed kyis kyang ci nas kyang bri bar bya'o/ /mnyan par bya'o/ /gzung bar bya'o/ /kun chub par bya'o/ /bcang bar bya'o/ /bklag 3par bya'o/ /shin tu rgyas pa dang / rgya cher bya ba'i phyir gzhan dag la yang rgya cher bshad par bya'o/ /bstan par bya'o/ /yang dag par bsgrag 7par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bsgom pa'i sbyor ba la brtson par bya'o/ /ji skad bstan pa bzhin du chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos bsgrub par bya ste/ de ci nas kyang skyes bu tha ma par ma gyur par bya'o/ /bzang skyong rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig ting nge 'dzin 'di thos la thos nas kyang lung nod par byed/ kha ton du byed/kun chub par byed na des lhag pa'i bsam pas gus par bya ste mnyan par bya'o/ /lung mnod par bya'o/ /bshad par bya'o/ /gang dag gzhan dag la ston 8tam/klog tu 'jug na des kyang lhag pa'i bsam pas rgya cher bya ba'i phyir ci nas kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di yun ring du gnas pa dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / shin tu rgya cher 9gzhan dag la bstan 1 par bya/ klog tu gzhug par bya ste/ 'di ni khyed la rjes su bstan pa yin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe/sems can grangs med tshad med pa dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 56—170

byang chub tu dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa nas 'dus pa gang gā'i klung 3)gi bye ma snyed kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid thob ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi 2 khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /lha rnams kyis kyang bar snang las me tog 8gi char phab po/ / rnga bo boche dag kyang ma brdungs par sgra byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te 5ci/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so6// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu 74chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de ratna 8rakṣi tas zhus te gtan la phab pa/ skad gsar chad 9kyis kyang bcos 95tha/05 / / //56—171

༄ga /'phags pa bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ārya sarba pu tta sa mutstsha guya sa mā dhi nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i lamado/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yangs pa na a mus bsrungs pa'i tshal chen po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na/ dge slong khri'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang 5shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi 6don rjes su thob pa/srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin 56wa 196

tu rnam par grol ba/ sems7)thams cad kyi dbang gi(gyedam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stagashobadang / byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa/gzungasangagethob pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ mngon par shes pa thob pa/ting nge 'dzin bsgrub phyo)pa la mkhas pa/ dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / brtan pa dang / shes rab dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros bla ma dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyad par blo gros dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phel ba'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mtha' yas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (ge 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sred med kyi bu dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' nyi khri dang ske/ lha'i bu bzhi khri thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa sha stag dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba mang po dang ske/ thabs cig 75tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te chos ston to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa shin tu snying por gyur te/ mu stegs byed kyi tshogs 58)thams cad zil gyis mnan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems 56—197

dpa' chen po srid med kyi bu stan 1 las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / / bcom ldan 'das 2bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di shin tu snying por gyur te / mu stegs can ngan pa spyod pa can dang / kun tu rgyu grangs ma mchis pa dang / gcer bu pa la sogs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan te mdzes par gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams legs par yongs su gzung 4du gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phan gdags 5su gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yongs su bskyang 65du gsol/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par gsol / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams gzengs 7)bstod pa dang ske/ yang dag par dga' bar mdzad 8pa dang / yang dag par bstan par gsol / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chos kyi tshul yongs su gzung du gsol/ sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong 9bar gsol/ ji lta bu'i tshul gyis 1 chos kyi phan gdags pas mya ngan las 'das par mchi 11ba'i lam bstan par gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa na yang 12byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur 56—198

bgyid pa dang / mi 'bral ba dang / bskyud ngas pa ma mchis pa'i chos can gyi slad du dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi dgongs pa rtogs par 'gyur ba'i slad du blo gros dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / don rtogs pa rjes su 'thob pa'i slad du rtogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rang gi sems yongs su dag pa'i slad du ngo tsha dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sdig pa'i las thams cad spong kyi)ba'i slad du khrel yod pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang /cho ga dang spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i slad cidu brtan pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang rka/ nyon mongs pa thams cad bsal ba'i slad du dpa' bar 'gyur ba dang /'khor thams cad kyi nang du bag tsha ba dang bral ba'i slad du sran thub par 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bsod nams yongs su mi na nyams pa dang / chos yongs su mi nyams pa dang / shes rab yongs su mi nyams pa dang / ye shes yongs su mi nyams par 'gyur ba lags/ ji ltar na lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pas byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi nyams pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar thug gi bar du sems can thams cad la mdza' ba brtan pa dang / ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bgyid pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa chos yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du gnas pas sems can rnams la mi slu ba dang / gtong ba thams cad rjes su 'jug pas ma bstan pa'i sbyin pa dang ldan pa dang / sdom pa gsum yongs su dag pa la gnas pas ma bstan pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang /gnod sems med pa'i yid kyis sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pas ma bstan pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa dang / yongs su mi skyo ba'i yid kyis don 56—199

thams cad yongs su sgrub 1pas ma bstan pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang /dran pa dang / shes bzhin la mkhas te/ bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la mi gnas pas ma bstan pa'i bsam gtan dang ldan pa dang / lta ba thams cad dang bral zhing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la snang ba thob pas ma bstan pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa dang /sems can rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis bsdu ba la shin tu brtson pas bsdu ba shin tu bsdus pa dang / lha dang mi'i skye ba thams cad la mi rtag par yid la bgyid pa la brtson pas re ba ma mchis pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems la legs par gnas shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas 'dod pa dang bral bas sgo'i them pa'i rten lta bu dang / chos kyi dbang du bgyid kyi 'dod pa'i dbang du mi bgyid pa dang / chos kyi rgyal srid don du gnyer bar bgyid kyi lha dang mi'i rgyal srid don du mi gnyer ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i tshig dang ldan pa'i chos smra bar 'gyur ba dang / chos kyis 'tsho bar 'gyur gyi zang zing gis mi 'tsho ba dang / yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras napa ma mchis pa'i sems dang ldan pas zhe sdang dang bral bar 'gyur ba dang / chos thams cad la gti mug gi mun pa dang bral bas gti mug dang bral bar 'gyur ba dang /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral bas bdud thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur ba dang / sgo thams cad nas yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pas thabs la mkhas par 'gyur ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stong gsum gyi bdag po 56—200

sred med kyi bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sred med kyi bu khyod legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir don 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni sred med kyi bu khyod legs so/ /sred med kyi bu de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig 0)dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yon tan gyi khyad par 'di dag dang /gzhan dag kyang thob par 'gyur ba ngas bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol temi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sred med kyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sred med kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba yod de/de la brten nas gubyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bsod nams yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/ chos yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/shes rab yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/ ye shes yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang 'bralas ribar mi 'gyur/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la brtson pa dang /sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong bar gnas pa nas/ sgo thams cad nas yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pas/ thabs la 5rimakhas par 'gyur ba'i bar de dag dang / yon tan gyi khyad par gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di'i ming tsam bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar gyur 46to/ /de nas de'i tshe dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid ces bya ba tshan po che chen po stobs chen po dang ldan pa 56—201

zhig yangs pa'i grong khyer chen po na gnas so/ /de nas de 'di snyam du sems te/bdag ni 1tshan po che chen po stobs po che'i shugs dang ldan pa ste/ 'dzam bu'i tshon/gling 'di'i sems can la 'di lta ste/ stobs sam spro ba bdags5)dang mnyam pa yang med na lhag pa lta ga la yod snyam mo/ /des dge sbyong go'us54)ta ma stobs po che'i shugs dang ldan te/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan zhing sred med kyi bu'i lus thob bo/ /zhes grag pa go snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag dge sbyong go'u tsita ma'i thad du song la/ bcom ldan 'das de ci 'dra ba dang /bdag ci 'dra ba sad par bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas tshan po che chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid yangs pa'i grong khyer chen po nas byung nas/ a mras bsrungs pa'i tshal 7chen po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te/sangs rgyas kyi mthu chen pos chos ston cing / ri'i rgyal po ri rab rgya mtsho'i nang nas mngon par 'phags pa dang 'dra la kun nas mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes pa mthong ngo / /des nabacom ldan 'das mthong ma thag tu dga' 9 ba dang dang ba dang 1 mchog tu dga' ba chen po thob bo/ /de dga' ba dang dang bsgo11dang mchog tu dga' ba chen po thob nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor ba byas nas 12phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste / bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig 1dal phyag 'tshal zhing mgo bor thal mo sbyar nas / bcom ldan 'das la rtog cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshan po che chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid kyi 1 lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su 56—202

chud nas/ nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa gdul ba'i phyir gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' 1stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu khyod song la/nga byang chub sems dpar (2gyur pa na/ shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma'i phyir/ mda' 'phangs pa gang yin pa de 'dir long shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gnam camada' de ga la mchis pa bdag gis ma mthong lags sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe phyag g.yas pa nas snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer cig btang ste/ 'od zer des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bar byas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i khor yug chen po gang yin pa de na mda' de 'dug pa snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i khor yug chen po na mda' 'dug pa de khyod kyis mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu khyod song la mda' de long 5)shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/ 'khor thams cad kyi nang nas mi snang bar gyur nas/ dper na skyes 6bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa bskum pa las rkyong 7ba'am brkyang ba las skum napa bzhin du skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khor yug chen po de nas mda' de blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das la phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci gnam 9mda' 'di byang chub sems 56—203

dpas yab yum las byung ba'i stobs kyis 'phangs pa lags sam/ 'onam1)te rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis 'phangs pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bumageyab yum las byung ba'i stobs kyis mda' 'phangs pa yin gyi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis 'phangs pa ni ma yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis 'phangs su zin na 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yab yum las byung ba'i stobs/ rang gi stobs bsod nams yongs su smin pa las skyes pa de ji lta bu zhig lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / mod gal gyi bu mi bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang gcig gi stobs so/ /glang bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang sngon po gcig gi stobs so/ /glang sngon po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che tha mal pa gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che tha mal pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che 'jigs su rung ba gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che 'jigs su rung ba bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che glang po che mo 'dra ba gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che glang po che mo 'dra ba bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni dgon pa'i glang po che gcig gi stobs so/ /dgon pa'i glang po che bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni ri 'bigs byed kyi glang po che gcig gi stobs so/ /ri ci'abigs byed kyi glang po che bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che mtshon cha'i sder mo can gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che mtshon cha'i sder mo can bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che gshol mda' 'dzin gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che gshol mda' 'dzin bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che stang zil mdog gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che stang 56—204

zil mdog bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che gel ba gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che gel ba bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni/ glang po che sngon po gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che sngon po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che ser po gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che ser 1po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che dmar po gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che dmar po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che skya bo gcig gi 2stobs so/ /glang po che skya bo bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che ku mu da gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che ku dmu da bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che pad ma dkar po gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che pad ma dkar po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni glang po che pad ma gcig gi stobs so/ /glang po che pad ma bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni/ spos kyi glang po che gcig gi stobs so/ /spos kyi glang po che bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni spos kyi glang po che chen po gcig gi stobs so/ /spos kyi glang po che chen po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni seng cadage ral pa can thabs can rigacig gi stobs so/ /seng ge ral pa can thabs can bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni tshan po che gcig gi stobs so/ /tshan 6)po che bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni tshan po che chen po gcig gi stobs so/ /tshan po che chen po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni stobs mchog gcig gi stobs so/ /stobs mchog bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni stobs mchog chen po gcig gi stobs so/ /stobs mchog chen po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni rab gnon gcig gi stobs so/ /rab gnon bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni rab gnon chen po gcig gi stobs so/ /rab gnon chen po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni sa bla'i lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so/ /sa bla'i lha'i bu bcu'i 56—205

stobs gang yin pa de ni gzhal med khang na gnas pa'i lha'i bu gcig gi stobs sol/ /gzhal med khang na gnas pa'i lha'i bu bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i bu gshol mda' 'dzin gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i bu gshol mda' 1'dzin bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i bu lag na phreng thogs gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i bu lag na phreng thogs bcu'i 5stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i bu rtag tu myos gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i bu rtag tu myos bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lus ngan gcig gi stobs so/ /lus ngan bcu'i stobs gang yin pa 5de ni sum cu lartsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so / /sum cu 5rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni 'thab bral gyi lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so/ /'thab bral gyi 'chilha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i bu rab 'thab bral gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i bu rab 'thab bral bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so/ /dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu gcig gi 7stobs so/ /'phrul dga'i lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu gcig gi stobs so/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni lha'i 56—206

rgyal po dbang byed gcig gi stobs so/ /lha'i rgyal po dbang byed bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu gcig gi 1stobs so/ /bdud kyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad kyi stobs gang yin pa de ni bdud sdig can gcig gi stobs so / /bdud sdig can bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni srid med kyi bu phyed pa gcig gi stobs so/ /sred med kyi bu phyed pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni srid med kyi bu gcig gi stobs so/ /sred med kyi bu bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni sred med kyi bu chen po gcig gi stobs so/ /sred med kyi bu chen po bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa brgya lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa brgya lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa stong lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa stong lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa khri lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa nakhri lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa 'bum lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa 'bum lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa sa ya lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa sa ya lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni 56—207

byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag bcu lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag bcu lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag stong lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag stong lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag khri lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag 1)khri lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag 'bum lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag sa ya lon pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nges par byung nas bskal pa bye ba phrag sa ya lon pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa gcig gi stobs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa srid pa tha ma pa gcig gi stobs yin te/ mod gal gyi bu stobs de dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po btsas ma thag tu sa la gom pa bdun 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /mod gal gyi bu gal te 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na 56—208

bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' ga la 'dug pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis ma brlabs su zin na/ btsas ma thag tu gom pa bdun 'dor ba'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams de'i sa chen po slor du dpag tshad drug khri brgyad stong zhom par 'gyur te/de'i 'og nas chu'i phurme po las chu'i rgyun shing 1)rta'i srog shing tsam sa gzhi chen po brtol te 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig na/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthus sa chen po de yang zhom par tsho mi 'gyur la/ sems can rnams la yang gnod par mi 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po srid pa tha ma pa btsas ma thag pa'i stobs dang / myur ba dang / shugs dang / mthu ni de 'dra'o/ /mod gal gyi bu byang chub sems dpa' srid pa 5tha ma pa btsas 4rim thag pa 5bcu'i stobs gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' lang tsho'i mchog la bab pa gcig gi stobs yin te/ stobs de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi snying por 'gro'o/ /ji lta bu'i stobs dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba de bas ca'abum 'gyur (7gyis lhag pa'i stobs kyis ni byang chub kyi snying po la 'jug go/ /de bas kyang ches grangs med dpag tu med brjod du med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang ldan pas ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mod gal gyi bu gal te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can gang yin pa de dag thams cad byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod de/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs dang ldan par gyur na yang / de 56—209

dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas dang gnas ma yin pa 1)mkhyen pa'i stobs gcig gi 'bum gyi char yang mi phod pa nas dpe'i bar du yang mi bzod de/stobs de lta bu brnyes pas stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /mod gal gyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i stobs 'di ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pas bsdus pa ste/ de las chung ba yang med/ lhag pa yang med do/ /de ni rdzu 'phrul yang ma yin/ cho 'phrul yang ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs ni stobs gang dang ldan na byang chub sems dpas 2rkang pa'i mthe bo'i spu'i khung bu gcig gis 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bgrangs nas 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu 'phangs kyang / sems can 'ga' tsam la yang gnod par mi 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul dang /cho 'phrul gyi stobs ni de ltar dpag tu med bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med / grangs med do / /de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam mo/ /mod gal gyi bu gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de bstan du zin na ni khyed kyis kyang yid ches par mi nus na sems can gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ mod gal gyi bu gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba de'i tshe khams bzhi po sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung 5)gi khams 'di dag khams gcig pu 'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i khams su byin gyis rlob ste/ des na sa chen po de zhom par mi 'gyur la/ sems can rnams la yang gnod par mi 'gyur ro//de nas tshan po che chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa 56—210

las byang chub sems dpa'i yab yum las byung ba'i stobs 'di thos nas dga' zhing spu zing zhes byed la ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ stan 1las langs te2/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar rinas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga cas la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 55logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud phyinas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das 7bcom ldan 'das las / byang chub sems dpa'i stobs thos nas/ bdag gi nang rgyal dang dregs pa chag ste ma mchis par gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad la sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi stobs bcu ci 'dra ba de lta bu yang bdag gis thob par gyur cig /tshan po che chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid las lha'i bu khris tshig 'di thos nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ 'di skad du bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang da 9ltar de 1 bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ci 'dra ba de lta bu'i stobs dang ldan par gyur cig ces smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus 'di skad ces gsol to11/ / bcom ldan 'das 12bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi ming bka' stsal nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa zhes bgyi ba de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das ci nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sna bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba'i 56—211

slad du/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin de bshad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum gyi bdag po byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ sred med kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa des bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yongs su ma bzung ba de ni gang yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po thams cad ni/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de'i khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /sred med kyi bu dper na chu mig thams cad dang /mtsho bran 1thams cad dang / mtshe'u thams cad dang / chu klung thams cad dang ske/ chu bran thams cad dang / mtsho thams cad dang / lteng ka thams cad ni rgya mtsho chen po'i khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de bzhin du/ sred med kyi bu bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ci yang rung ba sbyin pa las byung ba rnams dang / tshul khrims las byung ba rnams dang / sgom ri pa las byung ba rnams dang / zag pa dang bcas pa rnams dang / zag pa med pa rnams dang /'jig rten pa rnams dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams dang / lha rnams dang ske/ mi rnams kyi bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ji snyed pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de dag thams cad ni byang chub kyi sems kyi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa dag go/ /sred med kyi bu de'i phyir bsod nams thams cad yongs su gzung bar 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mos bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /sred med kyi bu dper na/ rin po che'i ri chen po gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ lhun po dang /56—212

lhun po chen po dang / btang bzung dang / btang bzung chen po dang / khor yug dang / khor yug chen po dang / gzhan yang ri nag po rnams dang / rtswa dang ske/ shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal thams cad dang / grong dang ske/ grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang /rgyal po'i pho brang dang / 'dzam bu'i gling dang / shar gyi lus 'phags dang /nub kyi ba lang spyod dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan dang / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gnyis kyi nya)'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i na 'jig rten gyi khams dang /'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang ske/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar ji snyed yod pa nas/gling chen po bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya'i bar 'di dag thams cad ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs par blta tshoXbar bya ba de bzhin du sred med kyi bu so so'i 54)skye bo'i bsod nams rnams dang / slob pa'i bsod nams rnams dang / mi slob pa'i bsod nams rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams rnams ji yang (de/rung ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa'i khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs te/ sred med kyi bu rnam grangs des kyang gang dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sems can de dag gis bsod nams thams cad yongs su bzung ba de ltar rig par bya'o/ /sred med kyi bu gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 56—213

sems can las theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa ma gtogs (1)pa ji snyed pa de dag gi nang na 'khor los sgyur nab ni bsod nams dang shes rab kyis mchog tu brjod do/ /sred med kyi bu gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur te/ sems can re re yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba de lta bu'i bsod nams dang ldan par gyur na/sred med kyi bu 'di ji 7snyam du sems/ ci bsod nams kyi phung po de mang ngam/byang chub sems dpa' 4sred med kyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor los sgyur ba gcig gi bsod nams kyi phung po yang mang lags na sems can grangs ma mchis pa de dag gi lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred med kyi bu gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can ji snyed yod pa sems can du bsdu bar bsdus pa de dag re re nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pa'am/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pa lta zhog gi/ sred med kyi bu gal te 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur na/ sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ ci sems can de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po mang ngam/ byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gcig 'khor los sgyur ba dang mnyam par gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po yang 5dpag tu ma mchis grangs ma mchis 56—214

na sems can grangs ma mchis pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur pa de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred med kyi 1bu khyod mos par bya/ khong du chud par bya ste/ de bas na dun sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi phung po yongs su bzung ba ches mang la ches dpag tu med de/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung pos ni bsod nams kyi phung po de'i brgya'i /char yang mi phod / stong gi cha dang / 'bum gyi cha dang / bye ba phrag brgya'i cha dang / bye ba phrag stong gi cha dang / bye ba phrag 'bum gyi char yang mi phod/ grangs dang /cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dpe ri dang rgyur 5)yang mi bzod done/ /sred med kyi bu 'di ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa dang po'o / /sred med kyi bu gzhan yang stong gi bdag po tshangs pa ni stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byams pas khyab par byed do/ /sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems / gal te mi la la zhig gis stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis gang bar byas te sbyin pa byin na/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po de dang / tshangs pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de gnyis gang mang / byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de nyid ches mang gi sbyin pa las byung ba ni de lta ma lags so/ /sred med kyi bu stong gi bdag po tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po lta zhog gi sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ stong gnyis kyi bdag po tshangs pas stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams byams pas khyab par byed la/ sred med kyi bu gal te mi la la zhig gis stong gnyis kyi 'jig 56—215

rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su gang bar byas te sbyin pa byin na/sred med kyi bu sbyin pa las byung ba dang / byams pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po de gnyis gang mang / byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das stong gnyis kyi bdag po tshangs pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po gang lags 37pa de nyid ches mang gi sbyin pa las byung ba ni de lta ma lags so/ /srid med kyi bu stong gnyis kyi bdag po tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po lta zhog gi/ sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byams pas khyab napar byed la/ sred med kyi bu mi la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis gang bar byas te sbyin pa byin na/ sred med kyi bu sbyin pa las byung ba dang / tshangs pa chen po'i byams pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de gnyis gang mang /byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni tshangs pa chen po'i byams pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred med shekyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshangs pa chen po'i byams pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po lta zhog gi/ sred med kyi bu gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can du bsdu bar bsdus pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad tshangs pa chen po'i byams pa bsgom ripa 55tshodang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur pa'i sems can de dag thams 56wa 216

cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung po tsho bas ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa sems can thams cad yongs su dgrol ba la brtson pa/ g.yo med cing sgyu med pa'i byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po gang yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'di nyid de bas ches mang ste/ tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de ni byang chub sems dpa' 5de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /sred med kyi bu de ltar na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bsod nams kyi phung po ni dpag tu med pa yin te/ sred med kyi bu rnam grangs 'dis kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / skyed ripar 'gyur ba de dag gi nga bsod nams thams cad yongs su bsdus pa de ltar rig par bya ste/sred med kyi bu 'di ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa gnyis pa'o/ /sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed cig yod/ lho dang / nub dang / byang dang /'og dang / steng dang / phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed cig yod/byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpag tu ma mchis so/ /bde bar gshegs pa dpag tu ma mchis so/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni brjod pa'am/ brda sprad 5par rngo mi thogs 6lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred med kyi bu gal te dper blang ba bstan pas bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du bstan du zin kyang /56—217

phyogs bcu na 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed yod pa ni bstan par sla ba ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu 'on kyang don 'di nyid brda sprad 1pa dang / bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / sems can bsod nams 'dod pa rnams phyir zhing 'bogs par bya ba rinadang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i sems can rnams kyi brtson 'grus chen po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir ngas khyod la dpes bstan to/ /sred med kyi bu dper na mi la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chu'i phung po yan chad srid pa'i rtse mo man chad yungs 'brus yongs su gang bar byas la / sred med kyi bu de las shar phyogs su yungs 'bru de dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das nas yungs 'bru gcig bor te/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis yungs 'bru de dag thams cad yongs su zad par byas kyang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams kyi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /lho dang /nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng dang / phyogs bcu kun tu yang de bzhin tu sbyar ro/ /srid med kyi bu gal te 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i ri niklung gi bye ma snyed yungs 'brus pa yongs su gang bar gyur la po de las mi la la zhig gis yungs 'bru re re yang / yungs 'bru de dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi char gses nam/ sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ yungs 'bru'i cha gses pa de dag bgrang ba'i tshul gyis mtha' rtogs par nus sam/ byang chub sems dpa' sred med 7kyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yungs 'bru gcig gi cha gses pa'i phyogs gang lags pa de yang gling bzhi pa'i sems can thams cad shā ri'i bu dang 'dra bar gyur pas kyang 8bskal par yang rtogs par rngo mi thogs 9lags na/56—218

yungs 'bru'i cha gses pa thams cad lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ sred med kyi bu gal te mi la la zhig gis shar phyogs su yungs 'bru'i cha gses pa de dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das nas yungs 'bru'i cha gses pa re re bor te / sred med kyi bu de lta bu'i tshul gyis yungs 'bru'i cha gses pa thams cad zad par byas kyang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams kyi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang / steng dang ske/ phyogs bcu kun tu yang de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /sred med kyi bu de ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkhas yongs su khyab pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad mi la la zhig gis rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su gang bar byas te sbyin pa byin na/ sred med kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ mi de gzhi de las bsod nams mang du skyed dam/ byang chub sems dpa' sred med kyi bus tsho1gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpag tu ma mchis so/ /bde bar gshegs pa dpag tu ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred med kyi bu de lta bu'i sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po bsdus pa gang yin pa de ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa g.yo med pa sgyu med pan/ sems can thams cad yongs su dgrol ba la dbartson pa'i snying rje chen po dang / byams pa chen po bsgom sa pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po bsdus pa'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i 45)bar du yang mi rbezod do/ /sred med kyi bu dper na gzugs kyi rnam pa nam mkha'i khams kyis ma khyab pa ci yang med pa de bzhin du sred med kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i byams pa 56—219

des ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na ti 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed yod pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed yod pa de dag ma khyab pa gang yang med de/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can 'khod pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i byams pas yongs su khyab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/ sems can gang dag sems can du bsdu bar bsdus pa de dag thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur tam/ de bzhin du brgya byin gyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur tam/ de bzhin du tshangs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa/ g.yo med pa/ sgyu smyo med pa/ sems can yongs su dgrol ba la brtson pa/ snying rje chen po la zhugs pa/ byams pa chen po la gnas pa'i gom pa bdun la bsod nams kyi phung po bsdus pa gang yin pa de ni de bas ches mang ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i bsod nams dang ldan par gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de ni de lta ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu 'di ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa gsum pa'o/ /sred med kyi bu gzhan yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang de dag thams cad ni cabargya byin gyi bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char 5tshomi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /sred med kyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad brgya byin dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams 56—220

kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang de dag thams cad ni tshangs pa chen po'i bsod nams kyi phung po'imanya)brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do//sred med kyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad tshangs pa chen po dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang de dag thams cad ni dge bsnyen nag po'i mchog gi bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /sred med kyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad dge bsnyen nanag po'i mchog dang mnyam pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang de dag thams cad ni shā ri'i bu'i shes rab dang / ye shes dang bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /sred med kyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad shā ri'i bu dang mnyam pa'i shes rab dang / ye shes dang bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang / de dag thams cad ni rang sangs rgyas gcig gi shes rab dang ske/ ye shes dang bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /sred med kyi bu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rang sangs rgyas kyi chos)shes rab dang / ye shes dang bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur kyang de dag thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nges par byung nas bskal pa lnga brgya lon pa'i shes rab cadang / ye shes dang bsod nams kyi phung po'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do/ /56—221

thams cad la yang de bzhin du sbyar te/ sred med kyi bu 'di ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa bzhi pa'o/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa na/ mi sum khri nyis stong gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /stong gsum gyi stong chenas༅)po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /lha dang mi'i sil snyan dag kyang grag gol/ /lha dang mi'i me tog gi sprin dag kyang phab naste/ me tog gi sprin de dag gis sa chen po 'di pus mo nub tsam du bkram mo/ /lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba de dag thams cad kyis kyang tshig 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / skyed pa dang / skyed par 'gyur ba gang dag lags pa de dag gis ni bdag cag zil gyis gnon to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni sems can de dag gi don bgyid pa lags 57so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag cag gis 'tshal ba ltar na sems can gang su dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la ma zhugs pa de dag ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin las mngon par byung ba yang ma lags/ de dag thams cad ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di la yang dag par gzhol ba yang ma lags kyi/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de dag thams cad ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting 56—222

nge 'dzin las mngon par byung ba yang lags/ de dag thams cad ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la yang dag par gzhol ba yang lags so/ /le'u dang po'o// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshan po che chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob par bgyid pa'i chos rnams gang lags / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshan po che 1chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob napar byed pa'i chos gcig ste/ gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems mi gtong ba ste/ rigs kyi bu chos gcig po da'adi ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos gnyis te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mnyan pa'i chos yongs su tshol dzubs chog mi shes pa dang / ji ltar thos 5pa'i chos la tshul bzhin du so sor rtog pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos 'di gnyis ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos gsum ste46)rka/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su spong ba dang ske/ dge ba'i chos rnams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba 56—223

la mkhas pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos gsum po de dag ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos bzhi ste/ bzhi 1 gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pa dang /lta ba yongs su dag pa dang / sems yongs su dag pa dang / shes rab yongs su dag pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bzhi po de dag ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub la zhugs pa dang / rtag tu bden pa'i tshig smra ba dang / g.yo med pa dang / phrag dog med pa dang / sems can thams cad la sems snyoms pa ste/ rigs kyi bu lnga po de dag ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos drug ste/ drug gang zhe na 'di lta ste/dge ba'i bshes gnyen 5bsten pa dang / sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spong ba dang ske/ tshogs kyi kha mi 'drenam pa dang / dben pa'i gnas na gnas pa dang /byams pa chen po mi gtong ba dang / sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ste/ rigs kyi bu chos drug po de dag ni bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di 'thob par byed pa'i chos bdun te/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zhi gnas yongs su 'tshol 4)ba 56—224
