shes mig ces bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kyis gang tshe de la bgegs byas tshe/ /de ni khros pas cung zad 'tshig pa 'am/ /khyod la khro gnyer bzhin yang bstan byas sam/ /de las khyod kyis tshig ngan mngon thos sam/ /sdig can gyis smras pa/ de ni so sor brtags pas rtag tu bzod/ /'dod chags spangs shing zhe snang gti mug bral/ /de ni sems can kun la byams sems ldan//'dre bar spyod pa la yang de brtaganyego/ /bdud thub dka' zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /kun sbyor gsum gyi zhags pas gang bcings pa/ /de la bdag cag nan tan bgegs bya med/ /des ni skyon dang gti mug zhags pa spangs / /de la ji ltar brlag par bya bar nus/ /sdig can gyis smras pa/stobs thob khyedashecag nga yi ⑧grogs yin te/ /khyed rnams bag yod byos la de'u re chos/ /thams cad phyogs su ri yi phreng ba dang / /sa 'disnyem lus byin gyis chur brlab bo/ /mkha' las mi bzad stug pa'i brag char dang / /lcags kyi phye ma'i phung po rab tu dbab/ /lcags mda' rjomadung thung spu gri mda'algebo che/ /de lus phye mar brlag phyir dbab par bya/ /kun nas rab tu rno ba'i rdo rje dang / /mdung thung ral gri tho ba rnams phab la 'bar ba mngon 'phangs52)sbyor ba de dag gis/ /shākya'i bu de thal bar7brlag par bya0//de bzhin du bdud bye ba'i bar du thams cad kyis tshigs su bcad pa smras so/ /de nas bdud de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin du 'dong bar bgyi'o/ /rang rang gi gnas nas go bgos la sde dang g.yog tu bcas te 'dong ngo / /bdag cag gi511rdzu 'phrul dang / stobs kyi yul de dag thams cad bstan par ni bya na/ dge sbyong gi ta ma de rtsal ci 'dra 56—563

ba de'i med la rab tu ston te/ khyod rang gis rigs 1)par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud bye ba narang rang gi gnas nas go bgos te/ bdud bye ba re re zhing yang g.yog stong stong ya lad rnam pa mang po gyon pa/ lag cha sna tshogs thogs pa/go cha rnam pa sna tshogs bgos pa dag dang chas te/ de'i nub mo 'das nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir phyin te/ yul ang ga ma ga dma'i ri drang thad kyi nam mkha' la 'khod nas gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang /grul bum gang dag bcom ldan 'das la sems ma dad cing gus par bya ba yid la byed pa med par gyur la/ chos dang dge 'dun la'ang sems ma dad pa yod pa de dag thams cad bdud sdig can gyis bcom ldan 'das bgrongs su bcug nas/de dag kyang lag cha dang / go cha sna tshogs dang chas te de nyid na 'khod ri do/ /bdud sdig can ni dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su bsgyur nas/ drang srong skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen po la dad pa/ rig pa'i gnas bcwa brgyad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul gyi pha rol tu son pa/ g.yog lnga brgya yod pa/ gangs kyi ri'i ngos la gnas pa de'i mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /gi ta ma 5rigs las skyes pa'i drang srong mchog /mkhas shing mngon par shes pa dag la gnas/ /ang ga ma ga dhā dzin der 'dug de 7ring ni//rgyal po'i khab 8tu nges par bsod snyoms spyod/ /brtan 9por sna tshogs gsal ba'i gtam 1 rnams kyis/ /de dang khyod du lhan cig smra bar byos/ /der khyod mngon shes dbang po lnga po yang / /gdon mi za bar 11rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /56—564

de nas bdud sdig can gyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras te/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur nas rang gi gnas su song ste/ rang gi 'khor gyi bdud rnams la bsgo ba1/glu/ ngas deng mi mtshungs blos bsamasam ci 'dra nga las khyod nyon cig /8bdag yul bdud kyi dregs chen 'joms pa'i sgyu de mi ston par/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan de shākya'i bu la rang dgar 4smra/ /de rtag tshig 'jam slob ma dag la brtse ba 5bu la ma byams bzhin/ / de yis slob ma rgyags spangs gdon mi za bar snga dro ni/ /grong khyer dag tu g.yeng ba med par mthar gyis rgyu ba na/ /de dag glu tsugar snyan mchog tshul gyis rang dgar myur du gzungs / /de thos shākya'i 9dakhyu mchog ci nas yid spro med par bya/ /bdud gzhan zhig gis smras pa/glang chen rnga mo seng ge ma he stag gtum sgra drag dbyar dus kyi ri/ /'brug sgra 'byin pa lta bu du ma grong de'i 11phyi rol myur sprul te/ /bdag cag lag cha mtshon thogs 'dug pa ngo mtshar mngon sum de mthong na/ /bslad cing mi dran rdzu 'phrul stor te de nas tha dad phyogs su 'gro/ /bdud gzhan zhig gis smras pa/lam srang bzhi mdo rta babs dag na mi sdug gdong mangs 12'khod/ /sna tshogs mtshon rnon mda' chen mda' zhags brla dgas ral gri thogs/ /nam mkha' las kyang mtshon cha'i sgra grag sprin las lce 1 yang 'bebs/ /de nas sa g.yos 'jigs pas dbang med myur du ma rungs 1 'gyur/ /bdud de dag gis bdud kyi yul gyi stobs dang / rnam par sprul pa ji lta ba de bzhin du thams cad rgya cher 15byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rdo rjer byin gyis snyebarlabs nas bdud kyi sgra yang mi 'byin1 / phyogs bzhi na me dang ri yang med/ sprin nag po 56—565

yang med/ dus ma yin pa'i rlung yang med de/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs dang byin gyi rlabs 1kyis klu gang yang tha na char pa thigs pa gcig tsam yang mi 'bebs so/ /yang de'i tshe nyan thos chen po bzhi snga ((dro chos gos dang shamasathabs bgos/ lhung bzed thogs nas rgyal po'i khab bkyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs te/ de nas tshe dang ldanas45)pa shā ri'i bu grong khyer gyi lho phyogs kyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms ⑥kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / grong khyer gyi sgo de na bdud gzhon nu shin tu dar la bab pa/byad bzhin bzang ba/ btsun pa'i cha byad dang 'dra ba lnga bcu glu len gar byed cing kun tu rgyu ste/ de dag gis lag pa gnyis kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bzung nas srang du rgyug cing glu len gar byed de/ shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong glu long 8shig /dge sbyong gar byos shig /shā ri'ilo)bus smras pa/ grogs po dag khyed kyis sngon ma thos pa'i glu thos par bya yis 0nyon cig /bdud gzhon nu de dag thams cad kyis gcom 17bskyungs pa77dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rgyug cing glu'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /skye mched dag gis shin tu chog /skye mched dag gis bdag cag bslus/ /skye mched dag ni gsod pa ste/ /skye mched dag 12gis mthar dbyung ngo / /phung po byas pas shin tu chog /phung po byas pas 1 7bdag cag bslus/ /phung po byas pasnyigasod pa ste/ /phung po byas pa ngas samathar dbyung / /'di lta ste/ ba ha ra/ba ha ra/ bha ra ba ha/ ma ri rtsa 1 ba ha/ sa tya ba ha ā ma ba ha swāhā1ste/gnas brtan 1 shā ri'i bu rgyug cing / glu'i na dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 21'di dag smras pa dang / de nas bdud 56wa 566

gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag shin tu dga' ste yid rab tu dad nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /mgon po bdag cag de ring bzod par gsol/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ston pa'i mchog khyod de/ /phung po khyod kyis ji ltar 'jigs bcas bshad6)ske/ /bdag cag de ltar rtag tu de mngon sum/ /bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag thams cad kyis srang gi dbus der tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chosatshanasamanyan pa'i phyir de'i mdun du 'dug go/ /de nas modam )gal gyi bu grong khyer gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / de nas yang bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu nas glu'i dbyangs kyi bar du ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /khamasa'aji nyid dag gis shin tu chog /khams nyid dag gis bdag cag bslus5)/ /khams nyid dag ni gsod pa ste/ /khams nyid bdag gis mthar dbyung ngo / /(6tshor ba dag gis shin tu chogaci7 /tshor ba dag gis bdag cag bslus/ /tshor ba dag ni gsod pa ste/ /tshor ba dag 8)gis mthar dbyung ngo / /sems pa dag gis shin tu chog /sems pa dag gis bdag cag bslus/ /sems pa dag ni gsod pa ste/ /sems pa bdag gis mthar dbyung ngo 9ri/ /'du shes byas pas shin tu chog /'du shes byas pas bdag cag bslus/ /'du shes byas pa gsod pa ste/ /'du shes byas pas rkangs mthar dbyung / /'khor ba dag gis shin tu chog /'khor ba dag gis bdag cag bslus/ /'khor ba dag ni gsod pa ste/ /'khor ba bdag gis mthar dbyung ngo / /'di lta ste/ ā ma ba/ ā ma ba/ā ma ba/ ā 1 ra dza/ na ra dza ha sha 12ma mya tha/ sha ma mya tha ga ga na ba swā hā/tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po rgyug cing glu'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad 56—567

pa 'di dag dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag smras pa dang / de nas bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag shin tu dga' ste yid rab tu dad nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phrul ldan sbas pa 'phags lam thub dbang sras/ /'khor ba'i nyes la mnyam lta 1chos kyi sgron/ /sdig spangs bdag cag ri mo gus pa skyes//sangs rgyas chos mchog dge 'dun deng skyabs son/ /bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag thams cad kyis srang gi dbus der tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir de'i mdun du 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa byams dma'i bu gang po grong khyer gyi byang phyogs kyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang / de nas yang bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu nas glu'i dbyangs kyi bar du ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /reg pa byas pas shin tu chog /reg pa byas pas bdag cag bslus/ /reg pa byas pas cagasod pa ste/ /reg pa bdag gis ri 5mthar dbyung 6ngo / /bdag po dag gis shin tu chog /bdag po dag gis bdag cag bslus/ /bdag po dag ni gsod pa ste/ /bdag po bdag megis mthar dbyung ngo / /'khor ba dag gis shin tu chog /'khor ba dag 8gis bdag cag bslus/ /'khor ba dag ni gsod pa ste/ /'khor ba dag 9gis mthar dbyung ngo / /srid pa kun gyis shin tu chog /srid pa kun gyis bdag cag bslus/ /srid pa kun ni gsod pa ste/ /srid pa kun ni ngas 1 mthar dbyung ske/ /'dod pa'i dga' bas shin tu chog /'dod pa'i dga' bas bdag cag bslus 1/ /'dod pa'i dga' bas gsod pa ste/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba ngas mthar 1 dbyung / /grogs dag tshe 'di 1 myur 'gro ’ ste/ /ri gzar 15chu 56—568

drag mgyogs 'dra na/ /byis pa'i skyeshibos mi shes te/ /mi mkhas gzugs kyi dregs pas myos/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ mi mkhas sgra yi'udregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas dri yi ṭa/dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas ro yis)dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas reg gi dregs pas myos/ /grogs dag tshe 'di myur 'gro ste/ /ri gzarasho'ichu drag mgyogs 'dra na/ /byis pa'i skye bos mi shes te/ /mi mkhas chos kyi dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas phung po'i dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas khams kyi dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas longs spyod dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas bde ba'i dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas rigs kyi dregs pas myos/ /mi mkhas 'dod pa'i dregs pas myos/ /grogs dag tshe 'di myur 'gro ste/ /ri gzar chu drag yimagyogs 'dra na/ /byis pa'i skye bos mi shes te/ /mi mkhas kun gyi dregs pas myos / /'di lta ste/ kharga ba/ kharga ba/ kharga ba/ mun nyi ni/ ā57brta/bi brta/ kha brte/ pra ma arsha/ byo ti ra brta swā hā/ tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po rgyug cing glu'i dbyangs kyis bdud kyi bu rnams la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dgas dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag smras pa dang / de nas bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag shin tu dga' ste/ yid rab tu dga' nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /khams rnams sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra ba dang / /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten rtog pas bskyed 9pa dang / /zhi ba'i lam yang khyod kyis nye bar bstan / /mchog sbyin dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag thams cad kyis sung gi dbus der tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir de'i mdun du 'dug go/ /yang de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor nub phyogs kyi sgo 56—569

nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa dang /grong khyer gyi sgo de na bdud gzhon nu shin tu dar la bab pa/ byad bzhin bzang ba btsun pa'i cha byad 'chang ha)ba lnga bcu glu len gar byed cing kun tu rgyu ba de dag gis lag pa gnyis kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la bzung nas srang du rgyug cing glu len gar byed de/ rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong glu long pashig /dge sbyong gar byos shig /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ grogs po dag khyed cis misngon ma thos pa'i glu thos par bya yis50nyon cig /de dag gis gcom bskyungs 51pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rgyug cing glu'ipo)dbyangs kyis riga'adi skad ces smras so/ /dngos po thams cad mi rtag sgyu ma chu bur bzhin//'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gang la'ang rtagategepa med/ /smig rgyu mthong nas zhig bzhin de la ther zug 1)med/ /chos kun myur du 'jig par blo dang ldan pas shes/ /sdug bsngal chos gzir byisasgo/— )pa thams cad gar 37chags pa/ /reg kun sdug77bsngal khur yinatshwa tshor ba dag kyang med/ /ji ltar dad pa byangatswachub lam bsgom bstenam byed pa/ /de ltar sdug bsngal kun thar byedam grogs gang yang med/ /chos kun mtshan nyid gcig ste 'du shes spangs pa dge/ /bdag med ldan pas nyi 7spyod kun rdzas kyi mtshan nyid bdag /srog dang gso ba gang zag dang ni byed pa med/ /bdud kyi g.yo dag thong 1snyel sems ni byang chub bsngos / /nam mkha'i glog bzhin dbang po dag la rnam shes 'byung / /reg dang tshor dang sems pa thams cad bdag med de/ /tshul bzhin brtags na rdzas ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /byis pa'i sde rnams bslus pas 'khrul 'khor bzhin du 'jug /phung por thams cad tshul bzhin brtags na byed pa med/ /yang dag 56—570

mtha' ni stong zhing mtha' rnams kun dang bral/ /byang chub lam spyod des0)ni 'dren pas byang chub brnyes(pa/ /rmongs med chos nyid 'di ni chos su skyob pas gsungs / /'di lta ste/ su mun de/ bi mun de/ sun da dza ti(gu/ si li si li si li/ a ba'aji)si li/ a ba ha si li/ ta thā sne)tā si li/ bhu ta ko ṭi si li swāhā / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor rgyug cing glu'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag smras pa dang / de nas bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag shin tu dga' ste/ yid rab tu dad nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /sdig pa'i grogs kyi dbang song 'di 'dra'i chos ma thos/ /gti mug mi shes dngos pos sdig las ci bgyis pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras la bdag cag mngon sum deng bshags na6)/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas nyid du smon dge 'debasage / /bdud gzhon nu lnga bcu po de dag thams cad kyis srang gi dbus der tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/kye/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir de'i mdun du 'dug go/ /yang de'i tshe na sangs rgyas kyi mthus srang de phyo)dpag tshad brgya tsam du go skabs yangs par snang ste/ srang de'i dbus na gnas brtan shā ri'i bu ni byang phyogs su bltas te 'dug /mod gal gyi bu chen po ni nub phyogs su bltas te 'dug /gang po ni lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug /rab 'byor ni shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug nas gcig nas gcig tu dpag tshad phyed phyed tsam na 'khod do/ /nyan thos chen po bzhi po de dag gi sna dbus kyi sa'i phyogs na khru lnga bcus 'khor ba'i /1pad ma chu ba ni 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i 1gegaser/ 'dab ma ni bai drurya //sngon po/ /ze ba ni dpal gyi snying po/ /snying po ni mu tig /dri ni lha'i spos las 6lhag pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 56—571

dge ba'i rtsa ba las skyes pa zhig byung ste/ pad mo de las snang ba byung ngo / /snang ba des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar gyur te/srang de na pad ma de 'phang du mi gsum gyi khrun tsam du snang ngo / /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bar du ni pad ma de'i 'phang du lha'i dpag tshad lnga bcu par snang ngo / /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i nang du ni pad ma 1)de'i 'phang du ni dpag tshad brgya par snang ngo / /'og min gyi lha'i bar du ni pad ma de'i 'phang dpag tshad phyed par snang ngo / /pad ma de'i 'dab ma ltadag las tshig dang don dang tshigs su bcad pa sna tshogs byung ste/ sems can gang dag sa 'di la gnas pa de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di 5)dag thos so/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'dir gang zag sdig pa med pa gcig skyes pa/ /gcig pus bdud kyi sde ni dpung dang bzhon 4par bcas pa bcomar/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo gcig gis chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /nyag gcig 'gro ba dag la phan phyir byon pa the tshom med/ /mkhas pa bstan bcos tshul mang rig pa chos don mthar 'dod pa / /tshul shes pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal mchog 'dir ston pas btul/ /'gro ba kun la phan don rig mkhas dam chos gsung ba chene/ /thub pa smra mchog 'jig rten kun gyis mchod pas 7de ring gshegs/ /dus gsum gshegs pa ston pa dge sbyong rgyal po bslab gsum 'chang / /tshad med chos don rig pa mi dang lhar bcas 'gro ba skyob/ /'jig rten don dang phan spyod mkhas pa ye shes chen po'i sgron/ /dam pa nagasung ba dri ma gsum spangs de ring 'dir kun ston/ /sdug bsngal phongs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad rnam grol zhing / /'jig rten don slad mi bsnyel 9blo gros mnga' bas spyad/ /ma rig pa yis 56—572

bsgribs pa'i mig can dag la yang / /dam pa'i chos kyis7)mig ni ji bzhin rab tu sbyin/ /thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor 'di 'dir ni tshogs 'gyur gyisan/ /don gyi dam pa gzigs pa gzugs bzang mchog mnga' la/ /stobs dang ldan zhing mchog dang mchog ma yin mkhyen pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge ring por dmi thogs 'dir gshegs so/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal rgya mtshor gnas pa gzigs nas ni/ /dbang po drug gi sdom pa'i mchog la rab gnas shing / /mngon par shes pa drug mkhyen drug gi rjes 'brang ba/ /de ni chos kyi rnga chen brdung 4)du yang dag gshegs / /dbang po drug gi grong khyer gnas rnams rab 'joms (5pa/ /don mchog dran pa drug gi kha lo sgyur dbang po/ /pha rol chos drug mchog rnams rab tu bshad pa'i phyir/ /drug gi sa bon smra ba'i seng ge 'dir gshegs so/ /'dod pa na 6spyod pa'i lha'i ris drug gi bar du pad ma de las tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /khyed cag tshogs te 7)de ring dga' ba spyod/ /bag med sems pa srid nadang rgyags pas bsgribs/ /rtag tu rmongs shing dga' ba'i skom gyis myos/ /bag med gyur pas bde gshegs mchod mi byed/ /'dod pa 9)mi rtag chu yi 1 skuzla ba bzhin/ /skye dgu'i 1 'khor ba'i zhags pa shin tu sra/ /dga' ba dag la bag med ma thar ba/ / nam yang 1 mya ngan 'da' bar mi 'gyur rol/ /rtag tu bag med zhi ba'i phyir mi 'jug /dge dang mi dge sngon byas ma mthong ngam/ /rga dang na 'chi'i 'jigs pas kun zin cing / /khyed cag ngan song sa la rab tu zhugs/ /sbyin dang dul dang kun sdom bag yod la/ /sten cig sngon gyi legs byas rnams kyang srungs ri/ /'dod pa mi gtsang mtha' med kun spongs la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i skyabs su nye bar dong / /song ste de yi 56—573

bka' la rab tu nyon/ /legs bshad de ni khyod kyi don chen te/ /shes rab rnam 1grol rab tu zhi ba'i rgyu/ /dam pa'i chos ldan mnyan pa don chen no/ / gzugs na spyod pa'i nalha'i 5)ris bcu drug gi bar du pad ma de'i 'dab ma las tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu 'di dag byung ngo / /mnyam gzhag ji bsam gtanamarinakyidaga' ba nyon mongs med/ /rab tu bsgrimasam )te chos la rnam par bsgoms/ /ma 'khrul sems dang rnam par thar 'dod pas/ /zhe sdang rab tu spangs pa'i blo gyis shig /rnam pa bcu gsums mtshan ma bstan pa yi/ /bzod pa mchog la rnam 8par bsgom 1par gyis/ /des pani na dang rga las thar ba yi/ /shin tu rnam thar myur du thob par 'gyur/ /gang rnams 1nyagazugs kyi rnam rtog srog la chags / /ther zug rtag pa bdag brtan dngos por lta32/ /de dag gi ni skye ba'i rgyun mi 'chad/ /de rnams ngan song sa la shin tu 'bab1nya/ /rtag tu khams gsum bdag med rdzas thumed cing / /byed med rang dbang med par rnamashe bltas nas/ /rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa gang sgom pa/ /de dag 'gro ba kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /skye dang 'jig 'grolas chos 'di thams cad la/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar gang rnamos sgom 1 byed pa/ /de dag 'chi med rga med na ba'ang med / /ngan 'gro med cing mi sdug phrad pa'ang med/ /gang rnams dbang po dag la yid mi chags/ /lam de mchog ste shin tu dag pa yin/ /da 18ltar shākya seng ge 'di bzhin du/ /bdud rnams bzhi po rnam par 'joms 19par 'gyur/ /gang dag g.yo ba btul nas gnyis spang phyir/ /ci yang med cing mtshan ma kun spangs pa/ /tshul gcig rnam par sgom par byed pa rnams/ /de dag la ni lam mchog 'di bshad do/ /bdag po med cing byed pa med gyur par/ /chos 'di 56—574

thams cad stong par bsgoms nas su/ /smon pa spangs na bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin reg par 'gyur/ /de lta bu'i don gyi tshig gis chos kyi sgra de dag byung bas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag tshogs te/ srang gi dbus na pad ma de 'khor bar 'dug go/ /'og min gyi lha grangs 6)med dpag tu med pa'i bar du 'og min nas babs nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir pad ma de'i khoramo yug tu 'khod do/ /bdud sdig can gyis tshigs su bcad pa de dag thos nas kun tu bltas te(mi/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i srang gi dbus na pad ma de las 'di lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa dag byung ste/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir mi bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa dag gis pad ma de 'khor bar 'khod pasnyimathong ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can gyis steng du bltas na 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha drug gi gnas thams cad na yang chos mnyan pa'i phyir lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med zhedapag tu med pa dag gis pad ma de 'khor bar 'khod pa mthong ngo / /de nas bdud sdig can rab tu sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde nas yid la gcags ne/te/spu zing zhes byed par gyur cing / lus rngul te rime)lus 'dar nas nam mkha' la rgyug cing skad chen pos na bos te bdud gzhan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi 'gyur yid kyis nga 9)yi tshig nyon la/ /nga tu la stobs med bdags11yul 'dir dbang med/ /thub tu stobs yon tan shin tu dri med de/ /skye bo brtan 12phyir 'jig rten 'dir 'dug go/ /lha mi dga' ba'i dam pa 'dir byung ste/ /'gro mchog ma lus nges par nye bar dong / /bde gshegs tshig la skom zhing rab tu dga' / /yon tan rab mchog zhi ba'i lam du 'gro/ /'di ni 'jig rten 56—575

gsum po slu ba dge sbyong sgyu yin te/ /lha mi mang po thams cad yid gcig pad ma 'khor bar 'dug /da 1ni 'jigs pa'i skad phyung myur du ri yi 0char phob ste / /ci nas bdud kyi sde btsan mtshon gyis deng bcom 'dir rin)brlag gyis54)/ /de nas bdud gzhan zhig gis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag gi phan byed tshig 'di nyon cig khyod kyi chos rig na/ /bdag sde brlag pa mthong yang zhi bar ci yi phyir mi 'gro/ /bde gshegs gzi 5brjid sku dang dpal 'chang gzugs mthong bdag cag myos/ /sangs rgyas 'dren pa ma gtogs 'di na skyabs rab mchog gzhan med/ /de nas bdud gzhan zhig rab tu ngu zhing gdong mchog tu khro bas 6non pas bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs shing lam dman pa/ /bdag gi stobs mthu med pa'ang mi shes sam/ /'dren pa la yang gang phyir khyod sdo 7ba/ /ngo mi tsha 'am 'dzem par mi bya 'am/ /bdag cag stobs ni shin tu brlag par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mthu yis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /pad ma'i drung du nye bar der 'dong ste / /chos thos tshim pas lus kyang shin tu dag /bdag cag rnam par 'jigs shing skrag gyur te/ /lus ni dri nga stobs dang brtson 'grus stor/ /ci natsam skad cig brlag par ma gyur pa/ / de yi 9bar du thub dbang skyabs su 'dong / /de nas bdud gzhan zhig gis thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /sdig can khyod ni chos kyi spyod pa spangs shing sdig byed dga'/ /sangs rgyas mgon 'di 'gro ba'i phan don mkhas shing dge ba'i mchog /grong khyer 'dir byon bdag cag myur du dga' 'ing dang bas blta / /'jig rten gsum mchod srog 17chags kun gyi sman la skyabs su 'dong / /de nas nam mkha' de nyid nas 56—576

bdud dbyangs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba des sgra chen porapha17'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed kun tshogs pas gus shing dga' ldan nga yi70tshig nyon cig /sdig pa'i lta ba kun bzlog lus btud ngag yid 'thun spyod de/ /khro spangs rabs nodaga' thub pa'i gsung mchog la yang dga' dad bskyed pa // /sangs rgyas mngon sum rnyed dka' skyabs dong de 5ring gus par mchod/ /de nas skad cig de nyid la bdud thams cad nam mkha' las babs nas/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer gyi sgo rin po che sna bdun las byas te/ bdud la la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad du bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir 'bad cing 'khod do/ /la la ni tshangs pa'i cha byad du/ la la ni dbang byed kyi cha byad du/ la la ni dbang phyug chen po'i cha byad du/ la la ni sred med kyi bu'i cha byad 6 du/ la la ni dga' ldan pa'i 7)cha byad du/ la la ni 'thab bral ba'i na/cha byad du/ la la ni brgya byin gyi cha byad du/ la la ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i cha byad du/ la la ni gzhon nu'i cha byad du/ la la ni rnam thos kyi bu'i cha byad du/ la la ni 'phags skyes po'i cha byad du/ la la ni mig mi bzang gi cha byad du/ la la ni yul 'khor srung 9 gi cha byad 1 du/ la la ni rgyal chen bzhi pa phal pa'i cha byad du/ la la ni nyi ma'i cha byad du/ la la ni zla ba'i cha byad du/ la la ni skar ma'i cha byad du/ la la ni lha ma yin gyi cha byad du/la la ni nam mkha' lding gi cha byad du/ la la ni mi'am ci'i cha byad du/ la la ni lto 'phye chen po'i cha byad du/ la la ni rin po che'i cha byad du/ la la ni gser gyi rgyan gyi cha byad du/ la la ni /1rin po che 12 sna tshogs kyi 1 cha byad du/la la ni rin po che'i shing ljon pa chen po'i cha byad du/ la la ni rgyal rigs kyi cha 56—577

byad du/ la la ni gzhan mu stegs can gyi cha byad du/ la la ni 'khor lo rin po che'i cha byad du/ la la ni nor bu rin po che'i cha byad du/ la la ni glang po rin po che sa srung 1)gi bu'i (micha byad du/ la la ni rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyi cha byad du/ la la ni bud med rin po che'i cha byad du/ la la ni tshong dpon btsun pa'i cha byad du/ la la ni blon po rin po che'i cha byad du bdag nyid mngon par sprul te / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa ci kyibya ba'i phyir 'khod do/ /la la ni sngo zhing kha dog sngo la phyang pa 'phrul dang / rgyan dkar pos brgyan par bdag nyid mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dmar po dang / mu tig gi phreng ba thogs shing 'phang du ta la'i srid tsam gyi nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod do/ /la la ni dkar zhing kha dog dkar la phyang phyi 'phrul dang / spud pa kha dog le brgan te gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ser po dang / mu tig gi phreng ba thogs shing 'khod do/ /la la ni le brgan kha dog le brgan la gser gyi gos dang —/ phyang 7'phrul dang / lhab lhub ste/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan mthing ga 8thogs shing 'khod do/ /la la ni dmar zhings9kha dog dmar la mu tig dkar po'i char 'bebs so/ /la la ni dkar zhing kha dog dkar la mu tig dmar po'i char 'bebs so/ /la la ni lha'i drang srong gi kha dog tu bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas/ nam mkha' las me tog gi char mngon par 'bebasam/ sol/ /la la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi gzugs su mngon par sprul nas rto / nam mkha' las lha'i spos sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs so/ /la la ni dri za'i kha dog gis lha'i sil snyan sna tshogs rdung ngo / /la la ni lha'i bu mo'i kha dog 56—578

gis rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod du spos7chu thogs te sa la chagashechag 'debs sol/ /la la ni mching〈(bu nag po lta bu'i kha dog ste spos sna tshogs kyis rab tu bdug par byed do/ /la la ni lha'i bu'i cha byad kyis gar byed cing glu'i dbyangs 'byin to/ /la la ni kha dog sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la bstod do/ /bdud dang bdud kyi 'khor la la ni bcom ldan 'das phyogs ga la bzhugs pa de logs su mngon par phyogs te / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs thogs so/ /la la ni srang dang / khang pa dang / khyim dang / skar khung dang /rta babs dang / bsil khang dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang /khang pa brtsegs pa dang / sgo khangasredang / shing khangasnyedang / gzhal med khang rnams na 'dug cing thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis gang gi tshe bdud de dag thams cad g.yog dang bcas te dge sbyong gi skye)ta ma la skyabs su dong bar mthong ba de'i tshe/ rab tu 'khrugs te skrag cing myos nas rab tu ngu zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag la phyin chad grogs med de/ /bdag gi dpal deng thams cad stor/ /bdag ni bdud kyi yul nas 'khyams/ /brtson 'grus tha ma brtsam par bya/ /bdag gis pad 7)ma rtsa ba bcad she/ /pad ma bcad dang kun 'khrugs te/ /des na smyo/sems can phyogs phyogs 'gro/ /de ni tha ma'i stobs yin no/ /bdud sdig can gyis de ltar bsams 1 )nas rlung lta bur nam mkha' las babs te/ srang gi pad ma ga la ba der phyin nas pad ma de'i sdong po yan chad dbyung bar 'dod na reg par yang ma nus/ pad ma'i 'dab ma bcad 1756—579

par 'dod na de dag kyang ma mthong / padatuma'i snying pos lag pas brdab par 'dod na de yang ma dmigs te/ dper na glog snang yang mi dmigs pa bzhin rnal/ /'di lta ste dper na grib ma snang yang mi dmigs pa de bzhin du pad mo de yang snang mod kyi mi dmigs so/ /gang gi tshe bdud sdig can gyis pad ma de mthong yang mi dmigs shing rig 5)par mi rung ba de'i tshe/ 'khor thams cad rab tu dngangs 4par bya ba'i phyir skad drag cing che la 'jigs pa'i sgra dbyung bar 'dod na de yang ma nus so/ /yang stobs chen po'i drag shul gyis lag pa gnyis sa chen po la brdabs te rab tu bskyod par 'dod na reg par yang ma nus te ma tsho dmigs so/ /'di lta ste dper na la la zhig nam mkha' la rdob par 'dod na mi dmigs pa de bzhin du bdud sdig can gyis mthong yang reg par mi rung zhing ma dmigs nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ ci nas sems can 'dus56)pa rnams brtags te sems rnam par 'khrugs popar bya'o snyam na na/sems can de dag mthong yang mi dmigs shing reg par yang ma nus so/ /de nasapo)bdud sdig can rab tu ngu zhing sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i lus shing ljon pa bzhin du 'dar te/ gdong mchi ma can gyis phyogs bzhir blta zhing 'di skad ces smras sol/ /dge sbyong gis ni 'gro kun bsdu phyir de ring sgyu 'di byas/ /'di ltar bdag ni mdun 'dir slad 1 bzhin skad cig myos par song / /yul dang rang gi stobs las nyams shing bdag gi srog kyang zad/ /des bskrad brlag 11par ma gyur bar du bdag gnas myur du 'gro/ /bdag gi 12gnas su 'gro bar 'dod na der yang 'gro bar ma nus te/ /rab tu skrag cing ngus nas 'di snyam du sems so / /bdag gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs zad de bdag dge sbyong gi 12ta ma 'di'i 56—580

dbang du song du 'ong / dgra 'di'i mdun du bdag gi srog zad par 'gyur du 'ong gis 1)'dir mi snang bar byas te/ ci nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing na gnas pa'i sems can gcig gis kyang bdag 'chi ba'i dus byed pa mi mthong bar sangs rgyas kyi〈bzhing mi mjedarsā)kyi pha rol du 'chi ba'i dus bya'o snyam na/ 'on kyang mi snang bar bya ba'am/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su 'bros kyang ma nus teri ni / de nyid du mgul pa bcing ba lngas bcings par bdag gis mthong nas rab tu khros shing skrag ste/ skad chen por ngu zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /kyi hud bu dang gnyen bshes 55 sdug pa khyed rnams phyis mi mthong ngo zhes zer ro/ /de nas bdud dbyangs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad du 'dug par gyur te/ des bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci phyir khyod76/deng mya ngan yid kyis ngu gdangs 7)sgra chen 'bod/ /'gro ba kun gtso thub mchog skyabs su ma 'jigs myur du song / /'jig rten rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen sdug bsngal gsum sel ba/ /'di la bsnyen bkur zhi 'gro bde ba thob par 'gyur yang dag /de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du bdag gi tshig snyan pas dge sbyong gi ta ma la 8skyabs su song la/ bcings pa 'di las bdag grol bar bya'o snyam du bsams te9/ de nas bdud sdig can gyis phyogs gang na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud ’ nonas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang zag gi mchog skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba las rab tu thar bar mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de la bdag skyabs su mchi'o/ /'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /thub mchog myur du 'jigs chen mi bzad bcings pa 1 'di las khrol/ /de ring 56—581

slan 41chad bde gshegs gtso dunamachog skyabs sulabadag mchis te/ /gti mug gis ni bdag ldongs khyod la khros shing nongs chen gyis/ /mngon sum khyod bzhagalo)spyan sngar de dag so sor bshagasamacho par bgyi/ /gang gi tshe bdud sdig can gyis tshig snyan pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su song ba de'i tshe na bdag grol ba snyam du shes so/ /yang gang gi tshe 'khor 'di nas bdag 'gro'o snyam du bsams 6pa de'i tshe yang mgul pa bcing ba lngas bcings par bdag gis shes te/gang gi tshe gang du'ang 7'gro bar ma nus pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la mgon dang ske/ skyabs su sems bskyed nas yang bdag nyid grol bar shes so/ /lan bdun gyi bar du bdag bcings pa dang grol bar shes te de nyid du 'dug go/ /'dus pa chen po 8rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ bdud btul ba'i le'u0)zhes bya ste gsum pa'o// //bam po bzhi pa/ gong du smos pa'i bar du ste/ nyan thos chen po bzhi po de dag rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms kyi phyir song ba bdud gzhon nu de dag gis dge sbyong glu long nya shig /dge sbyong gar byos shig ces spyod pa ma yin pa byed du bcug nas/ nyan thos chen po de dag kyang srang gi dbus na rgyug cing mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam gyi tshig dang ldan pa'i glu'i dbyangs kyis gang gi tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos so/ /skad cig de nyid la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po brgya stong mang po bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa rnams 56—582

gdong mchi ma can gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /chos kyi kha lo bsgyur 1)mchog mya ngan med bzhugs kyang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di lta bu yi naganas gyur te/ /nyan thos de dag la ni kyalas rika deng byas pa/ /'gro ba rnams kyis mthong na dad par ga la 'gyur/ /de nas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye 4chen po dang / srin po bye ba khrag khrig mang po gdong mchi ma can gyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /da ltar bstan pa 'di yis5)gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun gzigs te/ /bstan pa'i cho ga bsrung slad du/ /kun mkhyen btang snyoms ma mdzad cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ltar nga nyid der song ste/ /bzhon rine dpung bcas pa'i bdud btul rtsol/ /skye bo mang po thams cad kyang / /mya ngan 'das grong 'gro bar bya/ /de nas bdud de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab/ bdud kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab/ klu'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab/ las rnams kyi las kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ma stsal tam/ yul thams cad kyi nang na ni sangs rgyas kyi yul khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchog lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan 'di la bzhugs bzhin du bdud bye ba khrag khrig rab tu pham par mdzad pa dang /chos kyi phung po bye ba khrag khrig rab tu 8bstan pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtsho bskama'9pa dang / lta ba'i rgya 7mo dral ba dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig ye 56—583

shes kyi rgya mtsho la gzud par spyod mod kyi/ 'on gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das deng 1 cigi dus la gshegs pa'i mi rigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / sems can gyi khams na sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bdud du gyur la/ de dag re re'i bdud kyi stobs dang / byin gyi rlabs kyang sa'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul ji snyed pa de tsam du gyur te/ de dag thams cad nga la bsadatshanapar shom yang spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la yang gnod par mi nus so/ /ngas ri ri'adi na 'dug bzhin du bdud bye ba khrag khrig rnams rab tu pham par bya ba dang /gdul bar nus te/ bdud g.yog dang bcas pa 'di ni ma gtogs so/ /yang nga la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir bdud 'di dag gis rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po thams cad bdud kyi stobs dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi bkod pas brgyan pas/ de dag la snying brtse ba'i phyir 'gro bar bya ste yongs su spyod do/ /de nas bdud de dag rab tu dga' zhing dad pa skyes nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dge ba'i 4ris bon skyed 5par 'gyur ro/ /ji tsam na gdan las bzhengs 6par bzhed pa dang /de nas 'od ma'i tshal bsrung 7ba'i lha mo mthu mdzes zhes bya ba des bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gdong mchi ma can du 'dug nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan de ring gshegs pa'i dus ma lags/ /grong khyer 'di dag kun nas bdud kyis bltam / /re re la yang shin tu ma rungs pa/ /bye bas smra ba'i seng ge bskor cing mchis/ /zhe sdang rab 'bar rno ba'i mtshon thogs te/ /khyod dgrongs slad du 'khrugs pa'i sems kyis gnas/ /mgon po rnam pa kun tu deng ma gshegs/ /'jig rten rtsa lag brlag 9par ma bzhud cig1 /gang gi 56—584

tshe bcom ldan 'das gdan las bzhengs pa de'i tshe/ gtsug lag khang gi lha mo snang (1)ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sdig can dag ni lnga stong po/ /mtshon char bcas pa mchis pa ni/ /bsamathoX med de dag khyod la sdokyi/ /thub chen de ring ma gshegs shig /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang nas byung ba de'i tshe/ sman gyi lha mo grub pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'jig rten sgron ma brlag ri rtegyur na/ /kyi hud chos kyi lam stor cing 9ge/ /chos kyi tshul ni rab tu 'jig /chos kyi gru yang 'jig par 'gyur/ 'jig rten kun na rgya chen chos kyi ro ni nyams par 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'di dag 9)nyon mongs g.yo can gdug pas shin tu bltam47ri/ /sa 'di bde gshegs thub pa'i mchog ni ma rungs 8'gyur ba las/ /ji ltar shin tu 'byung ba'i mthu ni bdag la ci ma mchis/ /khyod brlag yobagyi slad 'di na rab tu mi bzad mang po dag /sdig pa'i chos can ral gri sta re mtshon rnon thogs shing mchis/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten bsrung slad bdag gi tshig gson te1 / /stobs bcu grub par bzhud de de ring grong khyer ma gshegs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang gi dang ra nas bzhud pa dang / de na shing gi lha mo 'od 'chang zhes bya ba de snying rje 11snying brtse 12bar ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad don grub thub pa yid bzhin rdzogs khyod ma rungs 1 gyur na ni/ /mgon po khams gsum 'di dag thams cad sna de'u re mig ni stor bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' 'di la sbrul gyi rked chings rno ba'i mda' 56—585

dang mtshon thogs shing / /khyod dgrongasam3)slad du kha nas me 'bar rgyu yis〈bad ni der ma gshegs/ /de nas sgo khang gi lha mo 'od zer chu'i lha zhes bya ba de sgra cher ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /grong khyer bzang po 'di na bram zer ming btags stong phrag nyi shu po/ /mda' dang spubagri mtshon cha 'bar ba thogs te snying rje med par blta/ /gcig pas gcig mi bzad pa snying rje med pa stong phrag nyi shu rnams/ /khyod dgrongs bslad du 'di na mchis kyis gegatsang ma'i zhal ni ma gshegs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgo khang7du byon pa dang / der rgyal po'i khab (7kyi grong khyer bsrung48)ba'i lha mo ta ma la'i snying po zhes bya ba de nam mkha' las sgra cher ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rings par57song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldanatshwa)rishul 'di seng ge rnga mo glang chen smyon pas bskor/ /dge slong rnams la gtse slad bdud kyi 1gernam mang gnod par〈nyebagyid/ /sa 'dir ston pa khyod dgrongs7slad du mu stegs gzhan yang brtson/ /sprin dbyangs 'od 'bar lha klu thugs brtse'i slad du ma gshegs shig /bcom ldan bdudamatshebatul khyod kyis bstan7pa rnam zhig dang / /sgyu ma bgyis pa mi 'thun gdong can bdud mthong nas/ /lha mi klu dang mi 'am ci yi7 tshodabang po rnams/ /kun 'dus mi dga' skrag nas shin tu rnam par 'khrugs/ /dam chos cher zhig pa dang 'jig rten 'khrugs gyur dang ske/ /nam mkha' skar ma'i 'od stor nyi zla gyur mthong nas/ /'gro mchog kye ma mi bzad klad78pa deng drag rdob/ /bde gshegs ma rung77'gyur bar kun dogs kyi hud mchi/ /mthong ba'i nyi ma 'di nyams shing / /chos kyi sgron ma zad 56—586

par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grongs nyu)pas brlag /chos kyi chu yang skam par 'gyur/ /dam chos spyod pa 'jig rten du/ /ma rung 5)'gyur ba nyer gnas tshe/ /mi dge ba yis ribadud rnams kyang / /'di dag tu ni 'byung bar 'gyur / /de nas lha mo des bcom ldan 'das phyir ldog par ma mthong nas gdong mchi ma can gyis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thub pa 'jig rten kun la gzigs su gsol/ /smra mchog de ring brlag par ma bzhud cig /bdag gi grong du ma rung57khyod gyur na/ /'jig rten gsum gyis rtag smad 'gyur du mchi/ /'dren pa bdag gi tshig (snyenagason sems can mchog /bdag gi grong du brlag par deng ma bzhud/ /sems can thugs brtse'i slad du 'dir gzhesam6)te/ /sems can skye bas gtses pa 'jigs thar mdzod/ /dam pa brnyes nas sgrol bar rab 'gyur bar/ /sngon gyi dam bcas de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs/ /sems can mang po sdug bsngal du mas gdungs/ /srog chags rnams kyi gtso bo dbugs phyung shig /sku mchog bskal pa bye ba mang por bzhugs/ /kye ma 'dod la chags pa'i ri byis pa'i sde/ /de rnams zhi bgyid slad du chos lam shod/ /skye mched5shedabang po don ni rang bzhin stong / /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgo khang59)du gshegs pa dang / de nas sa'i lha mo gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba'i lha mo khri dang lhan cig spa bshig hpha cicing gdong mchi ma can gyis bcom ldan 'dasamanya1kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'dug nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rab tu sbyin la dgongs shing khyod kyis ni/ /rgya mtsho bzhin bltam pa yis12khrag bstsal 12cing | /dbumatshadang rus pa khor yug ri rab tsam/ /spyan yang gang gā'i dbye ma rnyed stsalam to/ /sngon ni rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /sras dang btsun mo 56—587

glang chen de bzhin rta/ /gnas dang gos dang mal cha zas skom dang / /de bzhin nad pa dag la 'dod sman bstsal1no/ /rang byung mchog rab la ni mchod pa mdzadan/ /khyod kyis bag yod par yang tshul khrims bsrungs/ /bzod pa dang ni thos pa rtag tu bsnyen/ /phar 'dzin mar 'dzin pa yang de bzhin no/ /bya ba dka' ba dag kyang mtha' yas spyad/ /sems can du ma nyon mongs thar bar mdzad/ /gang sngon khyod kyis smon lam btab pa ni/ /lam mchog ston pa sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /chu bo chen po las ni 'gro ba bsgral/ /'jig rten la yang shin tu chos bstan te/ /sdug bsngal ma lus par ni bsal bar bya /sems can mang po 'jigs la/med grong khyer gzud/ /sems can de dag dgos pa yongs rdzogs shing / /byang chub dam pa la ni shin tu khod5ci/ /'di na 6)lam bor sdig pa spyod pa rnams/ /tshul khrims thos bshig mgon pos bzod par mdzod / /'di dag sgrol tshig dam bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por chos ston to7/ /mgon po chu bo dag las 'jig rten sgrol/ /'di dag yan lag brgyad kyis chu yis khrus/ /mgon po mchog rab khyod dang 'dra ba ni / /'jig rten gsum po 'di na 'ga' 8)ma mchis/ /bdag grol 'jig rten 'di dag grol bar mdzad/ /srid gsum rgya mtsho las kyang 'gro ba sgrol/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig /rtag tu bzhugs 9)shing chos ni bshad du gsolam/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgo khang 1 nas gshegs pa dang / skad cig de nyid la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po nam 11mkha' la rgyu zhing gdong mchi ma can gyis 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bde gshegs sngon mthong ba/ /zhi ba'i dus la 56—588

shin tu slob ma dul/ /chos rnams rgya cher ston pa mdzad pa na/ /de la de lta bu yis1)bgegs ma byung / /ston pa 'di ni shin tu dus nangan la/ /rgya chen blo yis rang byung nyid brnyes te/ /thub dbang 'gro ba yongs smin mdzad slad du/ /'jig rten nyon mongs bsgribs la chos ston cing / /smra ba'i seng ge 'di na bzhugs bzhin du/ /sdig can dag ni bye ba stong mang po/ /de ltar chos rnams rab tu 'jig par bgyid/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo grong du deng ma gshegs/ /de nas lha mo gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba 'jig rten phan brtson pa/ /de dag yul cig 'khor lo bskor gyur pa/ /'di ni gang du gshegs pa der yang bskor/ /de ring ma rung bar gni gyur ta re/ /de nas yang lha mo gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ded dpon 'dir ni thugs rje'i slad/ /shin tu sems can don mdzad spyad/ /de ni de ring grong khyer 'dir/ /brlag par 'gyur snyam bdag rtog go/ /yang de'i tshe lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye casachen po bye ba 5khrag khrig brgya 6stong gdong la mchi ma zag cing ngom zung gnag 7/pa dag nam mkha'i ngos kyi lam las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar na 'khod nas bdag nyid la rnam pa mang po byed de/ la la ni skra 'bal/ la la ni rgyan 'grol/ la la ni gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan stol/ la la ni bdag nyid kyi lus sa la rdob9/ la la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'dzin/ la la ni shin tu nyon mongs par ngu / la la ni lag pas brang rdung / la la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung na 'dug cing so bya bzhin du 'gre ldog /la la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 56—589

bstod cing phyag 'tshal bar byed/ la la ni bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / gos dang / phyangs3)'phrul dang /gser gyi skud pa dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / ras bcos bu dag mngon par 'thor ro/ /de nas lha gzhan bye ba mang pos mgrin gcig tu skad mthon5kyepor 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'jig rten don slad 'di bas mang ba yi/ /bya bar dka' ba khyod kyis rab tu spyad/ /zad pa'i dus deng 'dir ni khyod skyes kyis ske/ /btang snyoms mdzod la mi gshegs bzhugs su gsol/ /sdig med khyod kyis sangs rgyas mdzad pa nyung ngu mdzad/ /lha dang mi rnams dbang du mdzad pa shin tu nyung / /shin tu yun ring chos rnams ston cing khyod bzhugs la ske/ /srid pa gsum gyi rgya mtsho 'di las 'gro ba sgrol5)/ /dge ba'i las rnams bgyid cing sa bon yongs smin te/ /bdud rtsi'i snod du gyur pa'i sems can du ma la/ /khyod kyi thugs rje bskyed de so sor rab ston la/ /chu bo las ni 'jig rten nyam 6thag bsgral bar mdzod/ /'gro ba dgon pa'i dbus song /'khyams gyur cing / /'khor ba'i dgon par shin tu lam stor ba/ /de dag la ni lam mchog so sor ston/ /'phags pa'i chos mchog tshig gis thar bar mdzodal/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa gang bskor ba/ /de ni khyod kyi thugs rje ngo mtshar rmad/ /rlabs chen thugs mnga' ring du bzhugs su gsol/ /'gro ba rnams ni mgon med ma gyur cig /de nas yang 7lha mo gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnam na'adren brgya la ma rung 9)gyur na ni/ /'jig rten 'di ltar ma lus ldongs par 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad lam rnam thar gsum gyi rgyu / /'dir ni yong ye thams cad ma mchis 'gyur/ /ngag 1 tsholus sems las 56—590

skyes dge sa bon dag /bdag cag bag yod gyur pas 'dir btab ste/ /de slad bdag cag bde ba kun dang ldan/ /bsod nams 'byung gnas 'dir brlag ma gyur cig /yang de'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po dag de nyid du 'dus par gyur te/ de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sa 'dir bye ba'i bdud rnams nyer lhags kyang / /thub pa rlabs chen thugs mnga' nam yang ni/ /ma rung0)mi 'gyur khyed cag ma 'jigs shig /dge ba 'di la bdag cag mngon sum gyur/ /dpag tshad sum cu drug tu mgyogs nashing drag shul ldan pas kun tu bskor/ /sna bgrang ral gri mtshon rnon rtsub pa'i sgra mang 'jigs pa bdud kyi sde/ /byang chub snying por lhags pa pasnen de'i tshes de dag 'jigs shing brlag55)gyur na/ /da ltar don brnyes grags pas khyab pa de la ga la bgegs shig byed/ /de nas lha mo gzhan zhigs6)ngu zhing 'di skad ces smras so/ /sngon byung ba ni bdud kyi sde gcig yin te de dag dpung mi che/ /'di ni bye ba khrag khrig bdud kyi sde ste shin tu dpung che bas/ /'jig rten rnam par 'dren pa 'di ni brlag par 'gyur du rab tu dogs/ /de brlag57)na ni 'jig rten 'di dag shin tu snang med 'khyam 8par 'ong / /de nas brgya byin dang —/ tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la 'jus nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /blo zhan bdag cag gi ni tshig gson te/ /dge ba bzhugs shing gtso bo thugs rje can/ /lha mang bye ba mya ngan chen pos gdungs9kyi/ /de la chos kyi bcud kyis da 1 )gtor cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la byams pa yangs pa'i spyan gyis sna gzigs nas/ de dag shin tu dbugs dbyung 12ba'i phyir tshangs 56—591

pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /deng khyed ma 'jigs khyed ni ma skrag shig /bdud rnams thams cad bzhonas)1bcas gcig char (7du/ /tshogs kyang spu gcig skrag par mi nus na/ /nga yi lus kun la ni smos ci dgos/ /deng ni 'jig rten thams cad dbugs phyung ste/ /nga yis rtag tu sa 'dir chos bshad do/ /lam rnams stor ba la ni nga nyid kyis/ /dri ma med pa yang dag lam bstan bya/ /ngas sngon bya ba dka' ba mang po byas/ /zas dang skom yang shin tu rgya cher byin/ /gnas dang sman yang mi nyung sbyin byin pas/ /nga la deng su gnod par byed par nus/ /ngas ni rta dang glang chen shing rta dang / /lhab lhub phyang 3'phrul dag gi rgyan 47rnams dang / /bran pho bran mo grong rdal yul 'khor btang / /nga la su zhig gnod par 5byed par nus/ /chung ma 4bu pho bu mo bran mang dang / /yid 'ong dbang phyug sa steng rgyal po'i rigs/ /sems can rnams la phan phyir ngas byin rlob/ /nga lus de ring ci phyir 'jig lapar 'gyur / /mgo dang sna dang rna ba mig gnyis dang / /lus dang pags (8)pa khrag dang rkang lag bcas/ / nga yi (srog kyang lus can rnams la btang / /su zhig nga la 'tshe bar byed par nus/ /ngas ni sangs rgyas bye ba nya )rab mang la/ /gus ldan bdag gi lag 11nas shin tu mchod/ /rtag tu tshul khrims thos dang bzod la dga'/ /nga 32la su zhig rlag 12par byed par nus/ /ngas sngon shin tu bya dka' mang po rnams/ /mnyam par bzhag pas rab tu nga yis byas/ /lus kun bcad kyang nga la 'khrug med na/ /nga la rnam par 'tshe ba su zhig nus/ /nyon mongs ngas btul 1 nges par nga sangs rgyas/ /sems can thams cad la 'ani byams sems ldan/ /khro med phrag tshadog tha ba nga la med/ / nga yi mdunas na 56wa 592

de ring su zhig nus/ /ngas ni bdud kyi dpung rnams tshogs pa btul/ /ngas ni bdud mang bye ba pham par byas/ /khyed kun rnam par thar par nges par bya/ /grong du ci phyir mi 'gro ma 'jigs shig /sems can don phyir phyogs bcu 'di dag na/ /sangs rgyas la la gang dag bzhugs pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun dang byang chub sems dpa' yang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po rnams ni kun na bsogs//zhing rnams mtha' dag rab tu gang bar bya/ /bsod nams ye shes dag gis gnas par bya/ /sangs rgyas de dag tshul bcas kun gnas pas/ /sangs rgyas dag gi dgongs pa'i mdzad pa bya/ /yang de'i tshe lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye 1chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la nalegs so zhes bya ba gsol nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i grangs med pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo mtshar chen po rmad du byung ba grangs med pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dbugs 4byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud kyi phyogs pham par mdzad do/ /sems can rnams kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa bsal to/ /sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal gyi ri rab tu bsnyil to/ /skye ba'i shing ljon pa bcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlags so/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal to/ /gzhan mu stegs can rab tu dad par bsgyur to/ /chu bo bzhi skams ci so/ /chos kyi sgron ma rab tu 'bar bar mdzad do/ /byang chub 56—593

kyi lam ston to/ /bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do/ /1)bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser stsal to/ /'phags pa'i bden pa nabazhi khong du chud par mdzad do/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po mnga' bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skye ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral to/ /sems can rnams 'jigs pa ma mchis pa'i grong khyer du rab tu btsud do/ /de nas lha dang mi de dag gis bdug pa dang ske/ me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / lhab lhub dang ske/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par mchod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lam de phyag dar byas so/ /lha'i gos dang / me tog dang /lha'i ras bcos bus kun tu g.yogs snyenaso/ /lha'i me tog man dā nganor ba dang /man dā par ba chen po dang / ba ru nesha ka dang / ba ri7)ru sha ka chen po da nga /mañdzu nasha ka dang / mañdzu 9)sha ka chen po dang / mdog mdzes dang / mdog mdzes chen po dang / 1 ud pa la dang / ku mu da nyastodang / pad mas kun tu g.yogs so/ /gang du bcom ldan 'das kyitshwa zhabs gnyis 'dor ba'i lam de'i ngos gnyis su lha'i rin po che 12sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa mngon par sprul te/lha'i ras bcos bu dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / lag rgyan dang / rna rgyan dang ske/ mgo'i rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan to/ /shing de dag gi bar bar du lha'i rdzing bu grang zhing zhim pa'i chu dang zhing 1 rnyog pa med la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus kun tu gang ba kho ra khor yug tu rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyan gyis 12brgyan pa dag sprul te/ bar snang la yang rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gser gyi skud pa dang / mu tig gi phreng ba bzung zhing gser gyi phye ma dag gi char yang phab bo/ /dngul dang / bai drurya'i 756wa 594

phye ma dang / a ga ru dang / rgya spos dang / dus kyi rjes nya)su 'brang ba dang /ta ma la'i 'dab ma'i char yangasarab tu phab bo/ /go shir sha dang / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma'i char yang lam der phab bo/ /lha'i rgyan sna tshogs gser gyi skud pa dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dag gis kyang nam mkha'i dkyil thams cad brgyan to/ /grong ngam/ grong khyer gyi phyi rol na yang lha dang mi rnams bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i〈phyir lam mdzes par byed do/ /grong khyer gyi nang〈gen bdud dam bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir bkod pa dag bkod pa byas so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs (snyenas ting nge 'dzin deloyel snyoms par zhugs bzhin du lam du gshegs so/ /yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das sku'i gzugs dang / rtags dang /spyod lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lam der zhugs te/ de na sems can gang dag tshangs pa la dad cing tshangs pas 'dul ba de dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das tshangs pa'i gzugs su lam nas gshegs par mthong ba nas/ gang dag brgya byin gyis 'dul ba'i bar dang / gang dag sred med kyi bus 'dul ba dang /gang dag dbang phyug chen pos 'dul ba dang / gang dag rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyis 'dul ba dang / gang dag 'khor los sgyur bas 'dul ba dang / gang dag khams kyi rgyal phran gyis 'dul ba dang / gang dag rdzu 'phrul chen pos 'dul ba dang / gang dag dge sbyong gis 'dul ba dang / gang dag gzhon nus 'dul ba dang / gang dag bud med kyis 'dul ba dang / gang dag seng ges 'dul ba dang / gang dag glang po ches 'dul ba dang / ri7dgang dag klus 56—595

'dul ba dang / gang dag lha ma yin gyis 'dul ba 1nas/ gang dag ri bong la dad cing ri bong gis 'dul ba'i bar de dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das ri bong gi nagazugs dang rtags dang / spyod lam gyis lam nas gshegs par mthong ngo / /sems can gang dag sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba de dag gis ni/bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / rtags dang / spyod lam gyis lam nas gshegs par mthong ste/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang thal mo sbyar nas mngon par bstod cing phyag 'tshal te/ zhabs 'bring du 'brang zhing dong ngo / /yang de'i tshe gangs kyi ri dang nye ba na gnas pa drang srong skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba bdud sdig can gyis btang nas/ de g.yog lnga brgya dang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo'i drung na sdod pas bcom ldan 'das drang srong gi gzugs dang / rtags dang / kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / spyod lam dang / bkod pa de lta bus lam nas gshegs shing lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po mchod pa byed par brtson par mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du 4sems so/ /bden par 'di ni drang srong chen po mthu che zhing mchod par 'os pa ste/ lha dang mis mchod par snang ngo / /'di'i lus thams cad kyang bsod nams kyis 5mtshan gyis brgyan te/ mkhas shing slob dpon yin par shes so/ /bdag cag gnyis gang rgan/ gang mkhas pa de la ngas ji ltar brtag snyam ste/ de nas yang 'di ltar bdag gis mdun bsu la/ 'di la rigs dang / rus dang / gnas dang / brtul zhugs kun dri'o snyam du sems so/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas bdag gi 'khor la ( bltas nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /thos ldan yid 'thad brtul zhugs che 'dzin mchod 56—596

pa'i rigs par snang / /ye shes chos don ldan zhing thub mchog bzod 'di la ma rab mkhyen/ /khyed cag thams cad 'di la gus par mchod chen yang dag sbyor/ /yon tan ldan pa 'di las 'khor mthar 'gro ba'i legs bshad mnyan/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de dag thams cad kyis mgrin 3)gcig tu mkhan po de bzhin du bgyi'ol/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' ba g.yogatshanadang bcas pasam bcom ldan 'das ga la ba 4der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'dug nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /khyed su zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni bram ze'o/ /gsol pa/ khyod kyi pa gdung rus ci/ bka' stsal pa/ nga'i rus ni gi ga67ta ma'o/ /gsol pa / khyod kyi brtul zhugs ci/ bka' stsal pa/ nga'i brtul zhugs ni rnam par thar pa gsum mo/ /gsol pa/ khyod kyi spyod pa ci/ bka' stsal pa/ nga ni yang dag pa'i mtha'i 7/de bzhin nyid la spyod do/ /gsol pa/ khyod rab tu byung nas ji srid lon/ bka' stsal pa/ ma rig rinapa byung nas ji srid lon pa nga rab tu byung nas kyang de srid lon no/ /gsol pa/ drang srong chen po skar ma 9bshad pa lung bstan pa'i rig pa gsung ngam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgro btags pa med par mnyam pa nyid du'o/ /'di ni 'jig rten gyi shes pa ste/ de la snying po ci zhig yod/ drang srong gis gsol pa/ mkhas pa rnams dga' bar kṇi bgyid pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar ma'i gnas gang yin/ drang srong gis gsol pa/ gang zla ba dang nyi ma la brten cing rjes su rgyu ba'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad brjod pa 'di dag go/ /de la mdzub 11ni sor brgyad kyi 12tshad de/ mdzub de'i tshad kyis lus la srid du 56—597

mdzub bcu gnyis mchis tshopar rig par bgyi'o/ /kladas pa'i spyi bo la mdzub gang dang / rkang pa'i mthil la mdzub gang ste/ mdzub bcu bzhi ni skar ma rnams kyi gnas so/ /gang de dag na gda' ba ni rnam pa gzhan du5kyemi 'gyur te/skar ma gang dang cagang la btsas pa de dang de dag na gda'o/ /yang gang zhe na/de bshad par bgyi yis skorathub pa chen po gson cig /smin drug la ni su btsas pa / /de yi gdong gi sor bzhi na/ /g.yas phyogs na ni sme ba mchis/ /spu can gnag 6la mdog kyang dmar/ /longs spyod bdog cing grags dang ldan/ /mkhas shing rab tu dpal 'bar te/ /smin drug la ni skyes pa yi kyi/ /mtshan ma nyid ni de lags so/ /gang zhig la ni sor bzhi na/ /sme ba 'di nyid gda' ba de / /snar ma la ni skyes pa ste/ /shes shing rtag tu chos la dga'/ /mkhas la longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /rnam pa kun tu mdzes dang ldan/ /dpa' zhing rgyal ba phun sum tshogs/ /dgra rnams rtag par rab tu 'joms/ /mgul pa yi nani mdzub byed na/ /gang la tshig pa 'dra gda' ba/ /de ni mgo la skyes pa ste / /dpa' zhing longs spyod ldan pa'o/ /mdzub kyi phyed po gnyis pa la/ /g.yon na sme 9ba gang mchis pa/ /lag la 1 skyes pa khro ba ste/ /de ni blun zhing longs spyod bdog /mchan 1 khung g.yon na sme nag mchis/ /nab nya so la ni skyes pa ste/ /nor dang 'bru rnams 'byor par 'gyur/ /de ni shes pa'i rgya 1nayang chung / /ji ltar khyod ni rgyal la 〉skyes/ /mtshan mchog dag ni rab tu gda' / /phyag gi mthil na 'khor lo ni/ /nyi ma lta bur rab tu mdzes/ /dbu skra dag ni thams cad kyang / /gyen du g.yas 'khyil legs par mchis/ /sku ni chu zheng gab pa stes/ /'dren pa khyed kyis nyon mongs thul/ /tshig 'dra gang gi 56—598

snying ga mchis/ /skag la skyes te thab7)mo sred/ /tshul khrims 'chal zhing 'grogs mi bde/ /de ni g.yem la dga' ba'o/ /'og gam brang ngam rgyab cig na / /gang la byi sran 'dra ba gda'/ /mchu las skyes te nor dang ldan/ /btsun zhing chos dang ldan pa'i mi/ /lte ba g.yas g.yon gnyis kur na/ /gang la rma ge'adra gda' ba ni/ /de ni gre la skyes pa ste/ /ser sna che zhing tshe yang thung ske/ /lte ba man chad sor bzhi na/ /gang la sme ba rab gda' ba/ /spos la de skyes longs spyod can/ /khrims ldan shi 'phos mtho ris mchi/ /me bzhi la ni skyes pa dag /sme ba dmar po chu sor 57gda'/ /rku zhing g.yo can sgyu ma ste/ /bsod nams chung zhing shes pa zhan/ /gang gi mtshan la sme ba ni/ /gda' bar gyur pa nges par yang / /nag pa la ni skyes pa ste/ /'dod chags glu gar rtags nitu dga'/ /mtshan gyi 'og gam steng na ni/ /sme ba serang po rab tu gda'/ /sa ri la ni de skyes te/ /mi mkhas brkam zhing mang po sdang / /brla gnyis kyi ni mdzub gang na/ /sme ba dmar po de bzhin te/ /sa ga la ste shor ba mchog /skyes pa bud med rnams kyis bskor/ /mkhas shing dpa' la dgra yang thul/ /rtag tu bde la gnas pa ste/ /ngo tsha shes shing brtan smyo dang ldan/ /shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris skye/ /brla gnyis kyi ni mdzub do na/ /gang la byi sran 'dra ba gda'/ /lha mtshams la ste 1 tshul khrims can/ /chos dang longs spyod ldan pa'o//gang gi brla 'og gnyis na ni/ /sme ba gda' ba snron la skyes/ /mi sdug tshe thung tshul khrims 'chal/ /dbul zhing snying rje ma mchis so/ /pus mo gnyis ma'i gong na ni/ /gang la rma chung gda' ba de 1/ /snrubs 1 la skyes te dbang thang can / /myur du bdag khyim zhig par bgyid/ /chu stod la ni skyes pa dag /sme 56—599

ba pus mo'i lha nga na/ /sbyin pa bgyid cing chos lam 'tshal/ /shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris mchi/ /chu smad la ni su skyes pa/ /gru do la ni sme ba mchis/ /de ltar gda' ba shes dang ldan/ /longs spyod ldan zhing sems can byams/ /sme ba gnyis po gda' ba ni/ /gro bzhin7)la ste longs spyod rtag /de bzhin nad med sems can byams/ /shi 'phos nas ni mtho ris mchi/ /sme ba nag po rje ngar la / /gda' ba mon grus skyes pa ste/ /de ni khro zhing 'dod chags chung / /longs spyod ma mchis shes rab ldan/ /rje ngar la ni mdzub do na/ /sme ba nag po rab tu gda'/ /mon gre lam skyes blun po ste/ /de ni chu yis 'chi bar 'gyur / /rje ngar 'og gi mdzub gang na/ /rma 'dra mchis pa khrums stod la/ /blun zhing gzhan la gnod pa bgyid/ /de ni dbul zhing rkun po bgyid/ /gang la sme ba mdzub gangs na/ /khrums smad la ni skyes pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims dran pa dang / /shes rab 'jigs med snying rjer ldan/ /gang gi rkang pa gnyi ga zhel / /sme ba phra mo gda' ba ni/ /nam gru po)skyes pa ma rabs te/ /'dreg tho)mkhan du yang 'gyur ba lags/ /gang gi mthe bo'i phrag na yang / /sme ba sngon po gda' ba ni/ /rtag tu stobs ldan nad ma mchis/ /tha skar la ni de skyes so/ /rkang mthil sme ba mchis pa ni/ /bra nye la ste snying brtse med/ /gsod pa'i gshed ma'i ngang tshul can/ /shi 'phos nas ni dmyal bar mchi/ /gang gis spyod pa 'tshal ba yin/ /skar ma'i gnas ni 'di dag lags/ /'jig rten na ni rnamatsha9 shes 'dis/ /sems can rnams ni pha rol 'dren/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun tu rtog pa'i spyod yul can/ /byis pa gang la chags 'dug pa/ /de ni byis pa rmongs pa ste/ /sems la gnas shing rims nad 56—600

bcas / /khyi dang sbrul dang ru sbal0)dang / /srog chags gzhan yang rnam mang po / /skar ma rgyal la gang skyes pa/ /de dag bde la sten mtshwa yin/ /ji ltar bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul dang / /thar pa khyod kyis rnyed pa bzhin/ /nga yang thams cad gzigs pa na/ /ci phyir nga la khyod mi 'dri/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor nas yid rab tu dga' ste 'di skad ces gsol to/ /drang srong mi yimuXgazugs su ni/ /mtshan mchog rnams kyang shin tu gda'/ /khyod kyi gdung rus ma 'tshal na/ /lha 'am 'on te khyod mi lags/ /gsung dang dbyangs dag 'byin pa ni/ /tshangs pa chen po bzhin du gda'/ /spyod pa'i gnas dngatshang tshul gyis ni/ /sngon gyi drang srong rnams dang 'dra/ /thub pa ci 'dra phun sum tshogs/ /'di bsngon ma mthong ma thos na/ /khyod kyi ston gang de ci smra/ /khyod kyi gdung rus ci lags gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /pha rol tshu rinarol mi shes shing ge/ /mtshan ma la ni gang gnas pa/ /de dag sdug bsngal kun gyis bcings(8) de ni thar pa'i snod ma yin/ /pha rol phyin drug nga yi 9 rus/ /bram ze mngon shes drug dang ldan/ /yang dag dga' bya drug smra 1 zhing / /dbang po drug ni rnam nyu1par bshig /chos gsum rtogs pa'i shes dang ldan/ / nga yi nyu spyod pa rnam kyi thar gsum/ /byang chub sems ni nam skyes pa/ /de tshe nga 1 rini rab tu byung / /mtshan ma rnams ni ngas ma dmigs/ /mtshan ma med pa rab tu bsgoms/ /sems can 15med cing srog med pa/ /bdag med stong par mngon sangs rgyas/ /tshor ba gsum dang 'du byed gsum/ /stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgoms/ /nga ni ye shes pha rol song / / nga yi tshigs la'adi gsungs pa med/ /gang dag 56—601

mkha' bzhin ma chags par/ /byang chub phyir ni sems bskyed pa/ /de dag bzodanyestobs phun sum tshogs/ /ye shes 'di 'dra thob par 'gyur/ /chos rnams la ni mi 'jug cing / /rnam par smin pa 'dod med la/ /de bzhin nyid las 'gal mi byed/ /de dag byang chub rnyed mi dka'/ /chos rnams la ni mi gnas shing / /pha rol tshukhurol mi rten⑧par/ /yang dag mthar ni 'dir bsgoms na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid med cing mtshan ma'ang med/ /dmigs pa de ni rnam par spangs/ /chos rnams kun dang ma 'dres na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gi mtshan nyid 'dir 'ong la/ /rang gi sems la the tshomasaspongs/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar shes nas su/ /nga 'drar gesangs rgyas khyod 'gyur byos/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa de dag gsungs sne)ma thag tu de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' ba g.yog dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang ske/ rtags dang / spyod lam du zhugs par mthong nas sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams mngon 77du gyur to/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas ting nge 'dzin gang thob na byang chub sems dpa' rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo bzhin du 'dug nas / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la lta zhing gzhan la rag las pa med de/ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis mi 'phrogasam par 'gyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rin po che tog ces bya ba thob po/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar nas lag pa gnyis na me tog thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /yon tan mtha' yas 'jig rten mgon po bden pa 56wa 602

gsung ba legs bzhugs pa/ /khyed kyi ye shes spyan gyi 'od zer gyis ni 'jig rten kun snang mdzad/ /rtag tu sems can kun gyi slad du dpa' bo byams pas mngon 'phags pa/ /sems can snying po chags pa zad pa 'dren pa khyod la deng phyag 'tshal/ /gser gyi kha dog gser dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis bsil gyur pa'i/ /yon tan dag gis sems can thams cad byang chub rgyur 'gyur rab tu bskul/ /khyod kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor7nyon mongs ri rnams bcom par gyur②/ /tha ma'i spyod pa byang chub shes pa'i rgyu ni de ring mthar phyin to/ /sman pa chen po sems can snying po mtshan rnams kyis ni rab brgyan pa/ /sems can snying po sangs rgyas 'gyur ba 'dren pa de ring bshad du gsol/ /bdag gis lta ba'i rgya mo5)bcad cing grol nas 'gro ba bsgral bar bgyi/ /ji srid kyis ni sangs rgyas 'gyur ba mi yi gedam pa lung bstan gsol/ /sdug 'a/bsngal chu bos bdasalgepa'i sems can srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba zag pa med pa'i lam la dgod par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas gang rnams yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu dag /de dag bdag gis dpang du gsol te byang chub tu ni sems gzhol bgyi( ni/ /drag cing mi bzad rtsub pa'i sdug bsngal dag gis reg pa'i sems can kun/ /dus gsum gyi ni bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bsod nams des/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal de ring zhi bar gyur cig sems can kun/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni bde dang ldan zhing rtag tu mya ngan 'das par shog /sems can thams cad nad zhir gyur cig nyon mongs chu yang skams 8par shog /ngo bo nyid kyi ye shes dbang po'i snying po ldan pa thob gyur cig /sems can gang dag gsadamashe par chad cing 56—603

sdug bsngal dag gis gtses pa rnams/ /de dag bdag gi bsod nams gzi brjid dag gis myur du thar bar shog /sems can re res kyang ni yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad thob gyur cig /shes rab bsod nams tshad med pa dang bde ba kun gyis tshim par shog /de dag sdig pa'i rnam spangs lta ba mnyam nyid myur du bsten gyur cig /sems can thams cad skye ba dran cing chos la spyod pa nyid du shog /sems can de kun chos grus srid pa'i rgya mtsho pha rol rgal 1)gyur cig /thams cad chos kyi pha rol phyin pa sangs rgyas su yang grub par shog /bskal pa dpag tu med par chos kyi char pa 'bebs shing 'dug gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi sprin gyi char chus legs par 'khru bar shog /bdag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis nongs pa cung 5zad ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dpang du gsol te gus par bgyis nas so sor bshags/ /bdag kyang phyin chad sdig la lta ba'i las rnams spyod par ma gyur cig /rtag tu mdun na bsam gyis mi khyab gang zag mchog bzhugs mthong bar shog /bdag gi bsod nams cung zad ci mchis deng de byang chub bsngo bar bgyi/ /sems can ched du spyod pa kun dang sdug cibasngal thams cad spro bar bgyi/ /sems can thams cad byang chub mchog gi lam du rab tu gzud par sgrubagyi/ /bskal par zhing dang ye shes sems can rgya mtsho rnam par sbyang bar 6bgyi/ /gang du byang chub reg me'agyur zhing yang 8rnam par dag pa thob par bgyi/ /'khor kun rnam par dag cing bzod pa'i sa la rab tu gnas par shog /smra ba'i seng ge nges par mngon par shes pa lnga rnams thob par shog /'dren pa chags med ye shes ldan zhing thams cad gzigs pa lung bstan gsol/ /'jig rten du yang sangs rgyas chos kun kha 56—604

lo bsgyur nyu)bar 'gyur zhe na/ /me tog sil ma gtor ba nam mkha' la ni gdugs su gnas par shog /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin mi rnams lhags tsho ripa kun kyang dpang gyis shig /sa rnams g.yo bar byed cing khyod kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal shog /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas me tog de dag bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de'i steng logs su gtor ba dang / me tog de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug gi steng du gdugs gcig tu gyur nas 'dug ste/ drang srong skar ma la dga' bas de mthong nas rab tu zang zing med cing mchog tu dga' ba dang / yid bde bas tshim pa skyes snesapar gyur te/de nas pus mo'i lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs 4)so/ /drang srong chen po skar ma la dga' bas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs ma thag tu de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'aristong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs 6med dpag tu med pa gang dag der lhags pa de dag thams cad kyang yid 7skyo zhing ltad shenamor gyur to/ /gang dag glang po ches 'dul ba'i sems can de dag gis ni bde bar gshegs pa glang po che'i gzugs su mthong nas yid dga' bar gyur cing drang srong chen po 9 skar ma la dga' bas 1 cime tog gtor ba de dag steng gi bar snang la gdugs su gyur te gnas pa dang sa g.yos pa de yang mthong nas rab tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs so/ /gang dag yang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can de dag thams cad kyis ni bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 56—605

dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can de dag gis ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs par mthong nas zang zing med cing mchog tu dga' ba dang / mgu ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / phyang 1'phrul dang / rgyan ji snyed pa dag gis gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /drang srong chen po myur du longs la nyon/ /byang chub lung bstan zhes ni 'dren pa gsung ske/ /mnyam pa med pa'i mthus ni sa g.yos shing / /nam mkha' la yang me tog gdugs gcig 'dug /khyod ni 'jig rten phan phyir ston dbang po/ /rkang gnyis bdag gi gtso nabo sangs rgyas su/ /bsod nams mtha' yas nam mkha' tshad mnyam pa/ /khams gsum snying po 'gro ba'i sgron mar 'gyur(1)/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' bas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang du bdag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ci 'dra bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod ni bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med pa na/ byang phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing me tog rgyas pa'i dri zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni ji ltar da ltar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can bzhin du bkod pa de lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes bu dam pa khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten 56wa 606

mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdul med spos snang skar ma'i dpal zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ khyod kyi che'i tshad ni bar gyi bskal pa bcu thub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas med cing ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'ba' zhig gi gnas su 'gyur te/ khyod kyang de na theg pa chen po'i gtam 'ba' zhig ston par 'gyur rol/ /'khor ji snyed lhags pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' ba hu)lung bstan pa de thos nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i las la mngon par brtson par gyur to/ /bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po de dag dang / srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur te/de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa snye/zhes bya ba thob bo/ /'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las / drang srong skar ma la dga' ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //bam po lnga pa/ de nas bdud bye ba dag 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar grong khyer 'di'i phyi rol lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dag gis brgyan pa de bzhin du bdag cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das grong khyer 'di'i sgo gang dang gang nas gshegs pas /de'i sgo de dang de'i sa phyogs bkod pa'i rgyan dam pa khyad par du 'phags pas brgyan to snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis bdud bye ba de dag gi sems kyi kun tu rtog pa mkhyen nas/ 'di 56—607

'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par mdzad de/ de ji 1)lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par mdzad pas/ /grong khyer gyi sgo bcu gnyis su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bcu gnyis grong khyer gyi sgo re re nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por gshegs so/ /bdud bye ba de dag kyang nam mkha' la gnas bzhin nadu bdud kyi yul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul grangs med pa dang ldan pa/ bkod pa'i mchog rnams dang / bkod pa mdzes pa rnams kyis dgong khyer gyi sgo de dag dang ske/ sa'i phyogs de dag dang / rtsig pa de dag dang / shing de dag dang /sa'i ngos de dag brgyan to/ /bdud bye ba de dag dang / bdud kyi 'khor de dag la la ni tshangs pa'i cha byad lta bu nas drang srong chen po'i cha byad lta bu'i bar du bsgyur te nam mkha' la gnas bzhin du khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gi skar khung dang ske/ rta babs dang / ba gam dang / skyed 4shing gi nang du me tog dang /bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / gser dang / dngul dang /nor bu dang / mu tig sna tshogs kyis spras pa dang / gos dang / ras dang /ras bcos bu sna tshogs dang / lhab lhub kyi rgyan rnams kyi char ni rab tu phab/sil snyan dang / dkrol sgrub sna tshogs ni dkrol nas bstod pa dang / yon tan bsngags pa sna tshogs kyi dbyangs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba chen po sngon ma thos pa'i bkod pa mchog tu rgya che ba/ khyad par du 'phags pas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo na bzhugs te/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bos 7sgo'i them pa la reg par mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sgo'i them pa la reg ma thag tu/ de nas 56wa 608

de'i med la51)thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rab tu g.yos so/ /gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dag dang / sa dang / chu dang /rgya mtsho chen po dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor gyi lha dang / skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo dang / lha'i drang srong chen po'i 'khor dang ske/ 'og min gyi bar nas bzung ste/ sems can gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba de dag thams cad sa g.yos par snang ba des bskul ma thag tu rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po kho ra khor yug tu bskor nanas sa dang nam mkha' la gnas shing me tog dang / spos dugadus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i phye ma'i bar gyis bcom ldan 'das la gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis me tog dang /phye ma'i bar de dag phyogs bcu'i phyogs kyi cha re re na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa dang / stong pa dang / mi stong pa rnams su sangs rgyas la mchod cing bste 4stang bya ba'i phyir nam mkha' la gtor ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu me tog dang / phye ma dang / rgyan de dag las tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /myur du sad par gyis la 'di dag ltosar/ /byang chub phyir ni bag yod spyad pa spyod/ /khyod kyi 6'khor ba'i gcong rong 'khyams pa yi/ /'jig rten thams cad dag ni bsgral bar byos/ /yongs su smin dang ldan pa'i 56wa 609

dus bab kyis1)/ /g.yeng bar gyur pa rab tu myur thong la/ /'dir ni sngon gyi dam bcas yid la byos/ /byang chub lung bstan rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /thub dbang drang srong chen po ༷mya ngan med/ /'gro la phan phyir de ring grong57khyer gshegs/ /bdud stong bye ba rang gis pham mdzad des/ /dam④ni chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor/ /grogs po zhi ba 'di la 'gro dga' mdzad/ /dpa' mchog dngos po yang dag ston par mdzad/ /'gro ba sdugartson)bsngal dag las thar mdzad nas/ /byang chub tu ni de ring lung yang ston/ /rang byung mya ngan med pa grong khyer gshegs/ /de phyir zhing der rab tu myur gshegasam6)la/ /de ltar mdzes pa de dag rab ltos 7)te/ /rim gyis byang chub tu yang 'gyur bar byos/ /yang de'i tshe 'od ma'i tshal na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang /nyan thos dang / nyan thos chen po gang dag nang du yang dag parapo)'jog la gnas pa de dag gis ston pa de la bltas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo na 'dul ba la gzhes smyo shing bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi snam 1 logs su 'khod pa dang / bkod pa chen po de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de nas me tog dang / phye ma'i rgyan de dag las tshigs su bcad 11pa'i sgra 12gang byung ba de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa dang / stong pa dang / mi stong pa 18sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thams cad du gang bar gyur to / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang ske/ nyan thos chen po 1 gang dag gnas pa de dag gis sgra de thos nas 'di 56wa 610

snyam du sems te/ yid du 'ong ba 'di lta bu/ ro myang bar 'os pa 'di lta bu/dga' bar bya bar 'os pa 'di lta bu/ tshim par byed par 'os pa 'di lta bu/spro bar byed pa 'di lta bu'i yon tan chen po brjod par 'os pa 'di lta bu'i sgra 'di dag dang / me tog dang / phye ma'i char 'di dag gtulas 'ongs snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag rang gi dge ba'i phyogs btang ste ngo mtshar cher 'dzin par gyur tol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pasnyesangs rgyas kyi rgyan dang lhab lhub kyi rgyu 'thun pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyasashekyi rgyan dang lhab lhub kyi rgyu 'thun pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed50'di dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du bkod pa chen po 'di lta bu dag snang ste/ 'di lta ste/ma 'ongs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag cing rdul bsags pa med ces bya ba yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa 'di 'dra ba dang ldan par 'gyur/ rtsig pa med la legs par brgyan pa'i phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thams cad du yang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 5thub pa des nirgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo na/ shin tu lham me 7lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs par snang ba ni ma gtogs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag sgra thos pa des bskul ba dang / phyogs bzhir blta zhing 'khod de/ de dag thams 56—611
