cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ti kyi'adi ha cang yang mi ring ba na 'dug par mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi yul gyis lha'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan de dag thams cad kyang mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa'atshan)sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag kyang 'dus pa chen po'i bkod pa de dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa de dag blta ba dang / brtag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la yang blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir der 'dong dngo / /der ni bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa yang thob par 'gyur gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang /nyan thos chen po de dag de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i rdzu 'dzul gyi mthus rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas mi snang bar gyur te/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjedas 'dir phyin to/ /de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med gdapag tu med pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed rnams kyang 'dir lhags (tshonas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dis thams cad sa dang nam mkha'i bar ma lus par gang bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sna tshogs kyi rgyu 'thun pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs 8kyis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir brtson par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 56—612

sems dpa' chen po la la dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad me tog sna tshogs kyi char gyis khebs par byas so / /la la dag gis ni mu tig gi char phab pa nas/ de bzhin du sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir la la dag 6)gis ni gser dang /dngul dang / bee druryamanadang / shel dang / rdo'i snying po dang / spug dang / go shir gas dang / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / shing ta bum la'i lo ma'i phye ma'i char gyis nam mkha' khebs par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir la la dag gis ni lhab lhub dang / phyang55)'phrul dang / rgyan dang ske/ ras dang / ras bcos bu sna tshogs kyi char rab tu phab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir la la dag gis ni rin po che'i gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs bsgreng ngo / /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir la la dag gis ni spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs4)so/ /la la dag gis ni rin po che'i phreng ba sna tshogs gtor to/ /la la dag gis ni sil snyan dang dkrol ba sna tshogs dkrol to/ /la la dag gis ni glu dang gar dang / rol mo'i sgra rab tu bstan to/ /la la dag gis ni sa phyogs der spos chu sna tshogs kyi char gyis chag chag btab bo/ /la la dag gis ni rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod rnams rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na gethogs so/ /la la dag gis ni rin po che'i snod sna tshogs rnams spos chus bkang ste / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo mas brgyan nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na thogs so/ /la la dag gis ni rin po che'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs lha'i gos dang / rgyan dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis 56—613

brgyan nas 'phang stod tu de thogs so/ /la la dag gis ni bdag nyid tshangs pa chen po'i cha byad du mngon par sprul te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te/ 'khod pa nas rgya cher ji ltar gong du smos pa bzhin no/ /la la dag 5ni seng ge'i cha byad du mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu dang / rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs bskyed pas sems can de dag phan tshun mig gi dbang pos gzugs snang ba rnams la thags thogs med do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang de lta bu'i bdud kyi yul chen po lha'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs rnams dang / rang gi dran pa nye bar gzhag57pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi yul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs (3)kyis bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por gshegs nas srang gi dbus na pad ma yod pa ga la ba der gshegs te byon nas/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gyis pad ma'i snying po la reg par mdzad de drangs nas bzhugs so/ /pad ma de drangs te g.yos pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i ri khor yug dang / ri khor yug chen po dang /ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang / bdud kyi gnas thams cad kyang g.yos so/ /bdud kyi gnas thams cad na gzhal med khang dang / gnas khang 6dang / mal cha 7 dang / stan rnams kyang rab tu g.yos so/ /de na gang bdud kyi bu rnams dang / bdud kyi bu mo rnams dang / bdud kyi tshogs kyitshana'akhor gnas pa de dag kyang 'jigs skrag cing skyo ba skyes nas phan tshun 'di skad 56—614

'dzer to/ /rgyu med rkyen med par ni gzhal med khang 'di dag g.yo bar mi 'gyur na/ bdag cag gi rgyal po bdud de rang gi yul nas 'phos par ma gyur grang ske/ bdag cag kyang khang pa 'di nas 'chi 'pho ba'i chos 'byung bar mi 'gyur grang / bdag cag gis blta gor ma chag go snyam ste/ de nas de dag gis mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ni snyigs ma lnga can du gyur na/ 'di sus legs par brgyan cing shin tu nyams dga' bar byas snyam mo/ /de nas rang gi yul la gnas pa'i bdud g.yog dang bcas pa de dag de na 'khod bzhin du yang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan cing shin tu lham me lhan nemanyu)lhang nger bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad kyang sems can gzugs dang / kha dog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs sna tshogs su gnas pa sha stag gis yongs su gang nas sems can gcig kyang ngo mi shes te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir brtson par mthong ngo / /de nas de dag yang 'di snyam du sems te/bdag cag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang ske/ da ltar nabadag cag gi jo bo dang / g.yog tu bcas pa gar dong 45ba yang dri ba'i phyir der 'dong gor ma chag nasnyam mo/ /de nas yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas 5kyi zhing 'di'i bdud bye ba phrag brgya po de dag thams cad g.yog dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis bcom ldan 56—615

'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rab tu rnam par dad sems kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag khrol 'di nas myur du thong / /chos ni yang dag spyad par bgyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba yang / /ngas ni su la'ang bzlog pa med/ /gal te lam ni rab shes na/ /gang du dga' bar 'gro bar byos/ /bdud 1sdig can gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rang gi spyod yul gar dga' bar/ /gang tshe bdag ni mchi 'tshal te/ /bdag ni bcing ba (5)lnga dag gis/ /bcings par mthong ngo gau ta ma/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni rtog pa kun spangs te/ /grol nas 'gro ba grol byed pa/ /ngas ni 'tshe ba rnam spangs nas/ /sems can bcings pa thar b.ram bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad sa dang nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyis yongs su gang ba la gzigs nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'dir lhags pa dag thams cad kyang / /the tsom zhithams cad rab spongs la/ /skad cig ci yang ma smra bar/ /khyod 5cag rnams ni da nyon cig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten dkon/ /chos dang dge 'dun shin tu dkon/ /dad cing mos pa 'byor pa dang / /byang chub spyod pa shin tu dkon/ /'jig rten mgon po'i mngon sum du/ /chos nyan pa yang shin tu dkon/ /gang du bzod pa sten 6byed pa/ /de yi dus ni rnyed par dka'/ /gang du 'jig rten sdig pa yi/ /rtog pa thams cad rab spong ba/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgoms pa dang / /sems ni dul bar byed pa dkon/ /ji ltar ngas ni sngon spyad pa'i/ /byang chub spyod pa rnyed par dka'//56—616

de las me tog tsams1tshod 'di/ /khyedar cag rnams la bshad dpar bya/ /gang gis byang chub 'byor byed pa/ /srid pa'i bcings las dirab grol zhing / /mun pa'i phung po sel ba yi/ /lam gyi mchog ni bstan par bya/ /dri ma ngan pa gsum spongs la/ /ston pas gsungs pa 'dir nyon cig /chu bo rnams kyi pha rol rgol/ /rgya mo 5)can gyi sred pa spongs/ /rnam thar gsum la rab gnas shing ske/ /sdom pa gsum la yang dag gnas46/ /khams gsum kun gyi nyon mongs gang ske/ /de dag ma lus rnam par chom/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mchod medadang ske/ /chos kyi don du khyed cag rnams/ /sangs rgyas lha dang bdud gsum gyi / /byin rlabs sprul pas lhags pa rnams/ /dus gsum ma rig bsgribs pa'i sems / /bye brags8)tu ni rab tu spongs/ /khams gsum pa las grol ba yi9// /zhi byed bzod pa 9thob par byos/ /phyin ci log ni rnam bzhi yis/ /so so'i skye bo bslad pa rnams/ /dngos po med la rtog byed pa/ /de dag bzod pa'i snod ma yin/ /mig ni gzugs la chags pa yis/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsgribs nas/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang bral ba rnams/ /'khor ba shin tu bsten par 'gyur/ /'jig rten na ni gang mkhas gsal/ /bsam gtan sgom pa 11byed pa rnams/ /de dag phyin ci log bzhi las/ /de ring rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug de dag sems can rnams/ /chu bo bzhi las thar bar byed/ /'chi 'pho skye ba rab shes pa/ /des pa rnams ni pha rol 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med pa/ /rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa dag /sems can sred pas bcings pa rnams/ /yang dag shes pas gcod par byed/ /phung po lnga rnams yongs shes pas/ /zhags pa las grol zag pa med/ /yang 56wa 617

dang yang du mi skye ste/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin0)/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar khyedageni/ /sdig pa dag ni myur du shogasal/ /sdig pa ma lus rab spongs la/ /'jigs pa med par pha rol song / /srid par yang dang yang skyes pas / /sdig pa'i grogs kyi dbang song bas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de dag ni / /'dus byas la yang myong bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i grogs po rab spongs te/ /sdig pa'i lta ba rnams bor nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran byas te/ /dam pa'i chos la rab sbyor cig /btung ba'i dam pa 'thung bar byos/ /stong pa nyid kyang rab sgoms pa shig /dam pa'i don la dngos po med/ /rdzas kyang med cing mtshan nyid med/ /'di ltaradzanadabang po drug stong ste/ /byed pa po ni 'di la med ri/ /de bzhin mtshan mar rtogasngonapa yang / /dngos po tsam ste g.yo ba medam/ /tshor ba drug dang sred pa drug /reg pa drug las byung ba yin/ /de bzhin reg pa'i skye mched drug /stong pa yin par shes par byos/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dngos med par/ /dngos po nyid la brtag53)par byos/ /skye ba med cing 'gags9med pas/ /'di na rdzas kyang med par ltos7/ /gang gis chos kun tshul gcig ste/ /dus gsum du yang dngos med par/ /shes pa de dag nad med de/ /de ni bla na med pa'i lam/ /rnam pa bcu gsum nges grol la/ /sems can 'du shes rnam 'jig cing / /tshu 11rol pha rol rnam grol ba/ /de ni bzod pa bsgom 12pa yin/ /de nas gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi bsod nams kyi stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa'i shugs dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu 'thun pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 12dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgra thogs pa med pas 'tshigs su bcad pa de dag gsungs pa de'i mod la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 56wa 618

gyi khams stong pa dang / mi stong pa'i snyigs 17ma lnga can gang gā'i klung dpag tu med pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bye ma snyed rnams su dbyangs na kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshig brjod pa 'di dag grags par gyur nas/ /de'i mod la sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re nas kyang sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa dag ni shin tu zang zing med pa'i dga' ba dang / dad pa rnyed de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /la la dag gis ni ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa cadang / gzungs sna tshogs thob bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir 'dus pa'i gsems can grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams kyis ni don dang / tshig dang / yi ge 'di dag thos nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par gyur to/ /sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag ni theg pa gsum po dag gis nges par 'byung ba thob par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la 6dga' bas pad ma'i khri la 'dzeg par bya ba'i phyir rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus rin po che sna bdun gyi them skas me tog gis kun tu g.yogs pa mngon par sprul ste / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rga shi mya ngan gyi/ /'dam du bying ba'i 'jig rten thams cad la/ /rab tu gzigs te mi rgyu rgyur bcas kyin/ /'jig rten du ni chos kyi zam pa thogs / /thal mo sbyar ba'i sems can rgya chen brgyas/ /rab tu bltam 9pa'i zhing la gzigs nas su/ /chos kyi mchod sbyin rab tu bgo bar gsol/ /rang gi mthu rtsal rab tu bstan du gsol/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i pad ma mngon 'dzegs te/ /mgon po shes rab dang ni thabs rnams kyis/ /chos chu sprin 56—619

gyis char pa rab phob la/ /nyon mongs gzir ba'i mi la bstan du gsol/ /phyogs bcu dag gi sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /drang srong chen po shes rab ldan pa gzhan/ /khyod kyi dpang du de dag kun bzhugs kyis1/ /thub pa'i dpang po bdud rnams pham par mdzod/ /chos rnams stong pa nam mkha' lta bu dang ske/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ya ma brlar mkhyen nas/ /sngon gyi dam bcas rnams ni dgongs mdzod la/ /bla med 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol/ /chu bo bzhi dbus 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ / mi yi naseng ge de ring bsgral du gsol//khyod kyis chos rnams shin tu thugs su chud/ /srid gsum mtsho las 'jig rten bsgral du gsol/ /shin tu rlabs chen thugs mnga' bcom ldan 'das/ /bde bar gshegs kyi lam ni bde ba la/ /'gro ba gzud mdzod ra mtshungs med chos kyang ston / /'jig rten nyes pa'i 5dri ma bsal du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji lta bur sprul pa'i them skas de las pad ma'i khri la mngon par 'dzegs te/ pad ma'i snying po la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu thams cad du rnam par gzigs nas bdud sdig can la bka' stsal pa tsho / bdud sdig can ji ltar khyod kyi rkyen 7gyis deng 'dir 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pas sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag mngal na gnas pa dang / rga shis gtses pa rnams las rnam par grol 8bar 'gyur rnam par thar bar 'gyur9/ chu bo bzhi las yang dag par rgal 1 bar 'gyuram/ zhi ba'i lam la gnas par 'gyur/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes khong du chud par 'gyur te/ 'di la sdig can khyod ni sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam 1par 'phel ba'i thog mar 'gro ba yin gyis 1 khyod dga' 56wa 620

bar gyis shig /sdig can khyod kyis nga la chos bshad par gsol cig dang ngas deng bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mthon po'i yul gyi chu bo'i pha rol tu 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /ci ste sdig med khyod la tha ba zhe sdang rgyags med na/ /ci phyir deng 'dir kun tu skrag par bya phyir chos kyang ston/ /de ste 1khyod la tha ba rgyags dang nga rgyal yod na ni/ /thub dbang khyod kyi thar pa ci 'dra bdag la 'dir nashod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni sa la mngal gyi gnas na zla ba bcur gnas pa/ /de na yang ni bdud khyod nga la bsad dpar rab tu sbyar/ /de tshe nga la khon dang tha ba cung zad tsam yang med/ /nga ni bzod dang ldan te tha ba ma lus med pa yin/ /nga ni btsas ma thag 'dir khyod kyis sa yang g.yo bar byas/ /nga gsad ri phyir ni rdo ba'i char pa rab tu dbab par byas/ /de nas khyod kyis nga yi ma yi 6nu zho myur skams 7byas/ /khyod kyis nga la gnod pa rnam pa du ma ci ma byas/ /nga ni bsam gtan zhugs na /khyod kyis bud med khrid de 'ongs/ /nga ni bsod snyoms rnam par spyod tshe zas kyang gcad 9par byas/ /khyod kyis rtag tu nga la rgyal srid mngon par rab tu bstabs / /nga ni 'byung ba'i nub mo 'dir yang mun pa byas par gyur/ /de tshe khyod dang skyes bu rnams kyis grong khyer kun tu bskor/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni song tshe rdzing 1 char drag por 1 rab tu phab/ /sa ni 'dom 12do 'phang tsam rdo ba dag gis gang bar byas/ /zhi ba'i gnas na gnas pa'i tshe yang sgra ni rab tu phyung / /nga ni shin tu dka' ba spyod tshe grang ba'i rlung dang ni/ /'bab chu na'agram na gnas tshe khyod 1 kyis chu bo rab tu btang / /nga ni gsad 5par bya phyir khyod kyis seng ge 56—621

rab tu btang / /de tshe khyod kyis nga yi 1zas la drag po'i dug kyang btab/ /nga ni byang chub shing drung nye bar yang dag song ba na/ /rdo rje dang ni gnams lcags spu gri mda' char khyod kyis phab/ /'gro la phan phyir rdo rje'i gdan la mngon par gnas pa na/ /khyod kyis ngur smrig gos kyang 'jim rdzob dag gis rab tu bskus/ /de na yang ni nga gan khyod kyis bu mo rnams bkye ste/ /nga gsad phyir ni khyod nyid camathu dang bcas te 'ongs mod kyi/ /'on kyang khyod kyis nga yi 5yid la gnod byas cung zad med/ /ngas ni khyod btul nas su byang chub mtshungs pa med pa thob/ /'on kyang ngo tsha bor te ne'adir 'ongs nas ni yang smra 'am / /sdig pa'i tshul gyis 'od srung mchog la sogs pa bzlog byas te/ /khyod kyis sems can bye ba du ma ma rung 8byas nas kyang / /snying rje bor te 'dir yang nga la rgol 9zhing sgyu byed dam/ /nga yis zas ma zos pa de yi tshe yang khyod kyis su/ /nga gsad 1 phyir ni glang chen myos pa drag shul can yang btangs/1/ /sa steng nga la lhas sbyin gyis ni rdo ba 'phangs pa dang / /kye ma ngas ni zla ba gsum du rta chas zos pa dang / phyar ka btang 1 phyir bu mo mdzes ldan rab tu gang btang dang / /me mdag 'bar ba mi bzad pas ni 'obs rnams bkang ba dang ske/ /kha zas dag ni myur du gdug pa'i dug dang sbyar ba yi/ /de la sdig pa'i las can khyod ni rtsa bar nges pa yin/ /khyod nyid dpung bcas bu dang lhan cig sder bcas 'ongs nas su/ /nga gsad ngaphyir ni mda' bo che dang ral gri mda' mang thogs/ /'on kyang 'dir ni khyod kyis nga yi 1 spu gcig ma g.yos na//ci phyir khyod ni rgyags par gyur nas da dung 'dug /ji snyed bdud ni stong phrag bye ba rgol du yang btsud kyang / /sems can bye ba khrag khrig dag ni 'dir yang 56wa 622

lhags nas su/ /zhing tshokun rab tu gang bar 'dug pa nga yi na/dbang yin te/ /nga ni khyod phyir mchog tu byams pa'i yid kyis gnas par bya/ /nga ni snying rje'i gnas te 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin byed pa/ /khyod ni shin tu gtum po nga la rtag tu bgegs byed de/ /thub pa'i dbang po khyu mchog 'di dag nga yi snyedabang yin gyi tshol/ /da ltar tha ma'i dus la nga 5)ni sangs rgyas mdzad pa bya/ /rnam thar sems kyis sems can rnams kyi don yang spyad par bya/ /smras par gyur kyang bzod pa yongs su gtanga' bar mi bya'o/ /nga la phrag 0dog tha ba rab tu khro ba'i yid med de/ /khyed ni rjes su gzung saphyir nga nyid rtag tu mngon par brtson/ /nga la gsol dang khyod yid 9zhi phyir 'jig rten gsum dag tu/ /mchog tu zhi bar byed pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bshad par bya/ /de phyir khyod kyi sdig pa'i las rnams med par rab 'gyur gyi1 / /'jig rten mgon po nga la yidamanyunyani myur du dad par byos/ /khyod ni rtag tu 'di na gnod pa bya bar rab sems kyang / /khyod dgrol phyir ni nga snying rtag tu byams par rab tu dang / /sdig pa'i blo gros bor la dad bcas yid la byos shig dang / /ring por mi thogs khyod ni byang chub tu yang lung bstan to/ /de nas bdud sdig can bcom ldan 'das la rab tu khros 12te 'khrugs shing rngam nas de nas slar 'gro bar 'dod pa dang / bdag gi mgul pa bcing ba lngas bcings pa snyam du shes te/ 'jigs skrag pa'i sgra 'byung 1 bar 'dod kyang de ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das dgrongs ཿ pa'i phyir rang khros 15pa'i mthus shin tu tsha ba'i gludabugs btang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dbugs de shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i me tog tu mngon par sprul te1 /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na nasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 56wa 623

bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes te chos kyang ston pa de thams cad kyi dbu'i gtsug gi drang thad kyi steng gi bar snang la shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i gdugs su byin gyis brlabs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag 'khod pa de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la gsol pa/ me tog gi gdugs 'di dag ga las 1mchis/ su'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul lags/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed naces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba de rab tu nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sngon gyi smon lam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos ston te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de da ltar bdud kyi yul gyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms 4par byed pa/ stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad mthon por byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyud thams cad dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi sgron ma yun ring du gnas par byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam par 'phel ba'i brtson 'grus kyi byin gyi rlabs ci kyi stobs byed pa/ dgra dang phas kyis rgol ba thams cad shin tu tshar gcod par byed pa/ ngo mi tshomatshar dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / rtsod snyepa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas nangan pa dang / mu ge dang / 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang / 'thab pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / 'ching ba dang /'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / char mi 'bab pa dang / dus ma yin par 56—624

grang zhing tsha ba dang / rlung dang / tsha ba dang / nad dang / sgra mi snyan pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /mi dang / mi ma yin pa thams cad 'dun par byed pa rgyal rigs thams cad 'dun par byed cing 'gugs pa/ rigs bzhi thams cad chos kyi don la 'dzud pa / shes rab kyi sgron ma rab tu 'bar bar byed pa/ lam drang por rab tu ston pa khyim dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang ske/ yul dang / pho brang 'khor dang / yul 'khor thams cad 'dun par byed pa/ gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / nyin par dang / mtshan mo dang /zla ba gcig dang / zla ba phyed dang / dus dang / lo thams cad 'thun par byed pa/ lo tog dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / 'bru dang / sman thams cad grub par byed pa/ bzo 1dang / las kyi mtha' dang / gnas dang ske/ byin gyi rlabs 2dang / dgos pa thams cad grub par byed pa/ lus dang ri/ ngag dang / yid kyi nyes pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/rig 5pa dang / dran pa dang / blo gros dang / mos pa dang / dpa' ba dang ske/ brtan pa dang / bzod pa dang / spobs pa rnam par 'phel bar byed pa / chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i snang bas rab tu sad par byed pa/'phags pa'i rigs bzhis chos kyi tshul byin gyis rlob pa6/ theg pa chen po ston par byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phel bar byed pa/ sems can chen po rnams dbugs 'byin pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la rdo rje lta bu'i sems byin gyis rlob pa/ sa bcu la yang dag par 'jug par byed pa/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa khong du chud par byed pa/ dbang bskur ba'i chos dang /56wa 625

byang chub la gzhol bar byed pa/ gdul ba'i sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin pa/chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos khyab par byed pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa la 'dzud pa/ bla na med pa'i lam la yang dag par 'jog 1par byed pa/ chos kyi char rab tu 'bebs pa/ chos kyi ros sems can rnams tshim par byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ bdud bzhi'i yul las rab tu thar bar byed pa/phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'jog par byed pa/chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten napa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms ripa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa 'chad par cibazhed do/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 5pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang ske/ tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa gsungs so/ /byin gyis brlabs so/ /gcig la gcig dgyes so/ /da ltar phyogs bcu na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston pa'i 6sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i 7chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu 9dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa gsung ngo / /byin gyis rlobs so / /gcig la gcig dgyes par mdzad do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag 'byung ba de dag 56—626

kyang chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu 1 brten pa'i na chos kyi snying pos lus ri'ajoms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs gi phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu 5dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro/ /gcig la gcig dgyes par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag yod pa de dag gis 6so so'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag la yongs su zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis sngon ma thos pa'i chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 7pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 8pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa/ gang 'di ltar yon tan mang po bgyid pa/'di ltar yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i snang ba bgyid pa nas zhi ba'i bar du bgyid pa de gang lags/chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 9)pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa/bdud kyi stobs kyi yul thams cad rab tu 'joms 1 par bgyid pa nas/ phung po'i lhag ma ma mchis pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du bgyid pa de skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang ske/ mi rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ride dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag nged kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du de 56—627

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la bzhugs pa der 'dong ngo / /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang 1gzhan dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor cing / nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pas mdun du bdar nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 2du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la bzhugs dpa der gshegs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de dang lhan cig sems can thams cad la phan pa dang ske/ ngan par laspyod pa las bzlog pa dang / bzang po'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / bla na med pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 5pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms tshopa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa 'di 'chad 7par 'gyur/ byin gyis rlob 8par 'gyur/ gcig la gcig rjes su dgyes par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du 'dus nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor cing nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyi mdun gyis bltas te/ chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang / tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa 'di 'chad par 'gyur gyis/ khyed cag las gang chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten rka pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa mnyan pa dang / sangs rgyas 56—628

bcom ldan 'das tshad med grangs med pa gang gā'i :klung gi bye ma snyed dus gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig na bzhugs pa de dag la mchod pa bya ba dang /chos de yang nyan pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /lha'i yul dang / bdud kyi yul thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan nabakod pa de dag la blta ba dang / sangs rgyas mang po 'dus pa sngon ma mthong ma thos pa blta bar 'dod pa de dag dang / da nged lhan cig tu 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der 'dong ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing der gzungs 'di 'chad pa na/ gal te bdag cag gis gnas rnyed cing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar tshogs pa de dag la yang phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang /mchod pa dang / chos nyan par rngo thogs pa lta na de bzhin du bdag cag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 4yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 5pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 0pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa mnyan pa'i slad du mchis te/ der bdag cag gis dus gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig na /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med grangs med pa zhig bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes pa rnams la mchod par 8bgyi'o/ /de dag las chos kyang mnyan par 56wa 629

bgyi'ol/ /der bdag cag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi 1yul bkod pa bzhis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed gelegs par brgyan pa de yang blta bar bgyi/ 'dus pa chen po bkod pa de dag kyang blta bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing so so na narang rang gi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag khyed cag 'jig rten gyi khams der 'jug pa'i gnas dang / go skabs kyi phyir de ltar the tshom ma za zhig /de ltar nem nur ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi 5zhing du 'jug pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa ni mtha' yas so/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de thabs mkhas pa chen po dang ldan pas go skabs yangs sol/ /rigs kyi bu dag yongs su brtag pa bzung ste sems can gang la la sems can gyi khams su bsdu 6bar bsdus pa/ khams dang skye mched la 7gnas pa'i 8sems can de dag gal te re re'i lus kyang ri rab tsam du gyur du zin kyang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des sems can lus de lta bur gyur pa de dag thams cad yungs 'bru gcig gi nang du chud par nus so/ /sems can re re zhing yang yul dang gnas kyi 9skabs yangs te/ sems can de dag phan tshun du mig rgyang gis kyang mi slebs so11/ /yungs 'bru de 1 gcig tu sems can thams cad kyi lus bcug kyang bri ba dang gang bar yang 1 mi mngon te/ rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de ni thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang sra ba nyid ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 56—630

ni sa'i khams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des sa'i khamasamanyuthams cad rdul gcig gi steng du 'jog nus la/ rdul de gcig gi steng du sa'i khams thams cad bzhag kyang bri ba'am gang bar mi mngon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de ni thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang gang cung nazad gsher bar snang ba de thams cad ni chu'i khams te/de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des chu'i khams de thams cad skra'i rtse mo gcig tu chud par nus la skra'i rtse mo de gcig tu chu'i khams de thams cad bcug kyang bri ba'am gang bar mi mngon no/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang ji tsam du dro bar snang ba de thams cad ni me'i khams te/ me'i khams gang sngon byung ba dang /'byung ba dang / 'byung bar 'gyur ba de thams cad rdul phra rab gcig tu chud par nus la me'i khams de thams cad rdul phra rab de gcig tu bcug kyang gnas shin tu yangs te/ rang gi yul bzhin du rgyu'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang gang cung zad rlung gi khams su snang ba'i rlung gi khams de thams canacad de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu 'jug nus la/rlung gi khams de thams cad ba spu'i khung bu de gcig tu bcug kyang gnas shin tu yangs te/ rang gi yul bzhin du rgyu'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des ni gang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyi sems can thams cad 'byung ba chen po bzhi po de dag thams cad dang / lhan cig tu rdul gcig gi steng 5du 'jog par nus te/ rdul gcig la sems can de dag thams cad 'byung ba chen po de dag dang bcas par rang gi yul gyi las kyis ( mtha' rnams spyod kyang gnas shin tu yangs par rgyu ste/56—631 4

phan tshun gnod pa yang med la rdul gcig gi rtse mo de yang 1byi ba'am gang bar yang mi mngon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de ni thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang dus gsum du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi skye mched drug dang / spyod pa dang / nye bar len pa dang /smon lam dang / byin gyi rlabs 2dang / tshig gi lam gyi sgra dang / yi ge dang /tshig brjod pa dang / 'du byed gsum gyi 3las kyi mtha'i bya ba dang / phung po dang ske/ dpyod 4pa dang / bsags 5pa'i bya ba tha dad pa ji snyed pa dang /gang yang sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi mtha'i 6mu nas bzung ste/ dus gsum du gtogs pa'i 'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba na srid pa 'grub pa dang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba 'byung ba dang / sa'i khams kyi rdul phra rab ji snyed pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du gtogs pa'i skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'das pa ji snyed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du gtogs pa'i spu'i khung bu ji snyed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi longs spyod pa dang / kun tu spyod pa dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des skad cig gcig la rab tu mkhyen te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de ni mtshan nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / mngon par shes pa'i ye shes 'di lta bu dang ldan pas mi rtog rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub par 7dus gsum gyi mtha' yongs su mkhyen to / /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de sangs rgyas kyi yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes la mkhas pas mnyam pa nyid kyis sems can yongs su smin 56wa 632

wa wa wa ———— ———————wa wa par byed pa'i thabs tshad med pa 'di lta bu dang ldan no/ /mtshan nyid bshad pa 'di lung bstan pa na phyogs tha dad pa dag na de bzhin gshegs pa 1de dag gi naso so'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa dag smon lam gyi yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur /ske /lnga pazlo/ /du/ sa pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las / mtshan nyid kyi le'u bam po drug pa/ yang de'i tshe shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' ba na de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams dang thabs cig tu sangs rgyas kyi yul la 5rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs 6kyi stobs kyis gshegs par chas nas/ skad cig gcig tsam la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir dbus kyi gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su byon te / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la bzhugs pa der gshegs nas pad ma'i gdan ji lta bu byung ba la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems 8dpa' chen po de dag kyang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pas pad ma'i gdan ji lta bu byung ba de dag la 'khod do/ /de dag la sogs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med dpag tu med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir dbus kyi gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su byon to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa re re yang byang chub sems 56—633

dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med dpag tu med pa dang / nyan thos bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang thabs cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de ga 1la bzhugs par byon to/ /byon nas kyang pad ma'i gdan ji lta bu byung ba rnams la bzhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe na lho phyogs logs nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che 2tog ces bya ba byon nas pad ma'i snying po la bzhugs pa'i bar du rgyas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang phyogs logs nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra zhes bya ba byon nas pad ma'i snying po la bzhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe nub phyogs logs nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med ces bya ba byon nas pad ma'i snying po la bzhugs pa'i bar du'o/ /'og gi phyogs logs nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba byon nas pad ma'i snying po la bzhugs pa'i bar du'o/ /steng gi phyogs 3logs nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi 'od zer zhes bya ba byon nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi casangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dang thabs cig tu sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyi 5rlabs kyis de nas 6gshegs par chas pa dang / sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir dbus kyi gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la bzhugs pa der gshegs nas pad ma'i gdan ji lta bu byung ba la bzhugs so / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kyang ji ltar rang rang gi bsod nams dang rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyi byin gyi rlabs 8kyis pad ma'i gdan 56wa 634

sprul pa rnams la 'khod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir la la dag 1gis ni 'dzam bu'i 2chu bo'i gser gyi char phab bo / /gong du smos pa bzhin sbyar te/ la la dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus par bskor bar byas so/ /la la dag gis ni chos nyan pas bskor nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te 'khod do/ /la la dag gis 4ni rang gi dge ba'i phyogs yid la byed cing gnas so/ /yang de'i tshe na zla 'od gagazhon nur gyur pas thal mo sbyar te rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi stobs bskyed pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ma lus par dbyangs kyis bkang ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /the tsom 6thams cad gcod mdzad pa/ /thub pa zla ba kun nas gshegs/ /sngon chad ma mthong ma thos pa'i/ /dge 'dun phun sum tshogs 'di snang / /byang chub sems dpa' brtul zhugs mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab gang bas/ /zhing 'di mchod rten gyur pa ste/ /zhing rnams kun gyis phyag byas so/ /gang na sems can smad 7pa yi/ /zhing ni snyigs ma lnga ldan 'dir/ /thub pa snang mdzad rgyu med par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas deng mi gshegs/ /de ring bdud ngan tshar gcad 8cing / /nag po'i phyogs ni rab gzhom dang / /spyod pa dge ba bsdu ba'i phyir/ / de yi don du kun nas gshegs/ /yid ni rab tu dang 0byos la//bdud sde rab tu 'joms 1pa yi/ /chos nyid zhi ba rab nyon la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur bar byos/ /theg pa chen po spyod pa'i lam/ /bzod pa'i go bgos shes par byos/ /nyon mongs thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /gzungs 'di 56wa 635

de ring mnyan par byos/ /gdan rnams la ni bzhugs nas ni/ /bsrung 1ba 'di ni bshad gsol phyir/ /de phyir thams cad mgrin gcig tu / /'dren pa rnams ni spyan drongs shig /dam chos yun ring gnas bya'i phyir/ /sgrib dpa thams cad zhi byed pa/ /chos rnams thams cad sdud 4pa yi/ /gzungs 'di gzhan gyis mi thub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa thob pa grangs med dpag tu med pa de snyed kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams pad ma'i gdan 'di dag la bzhugs te deng thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis byams pa chen po'i mchog dang bzod pas g.yongs su bsgom 6pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i rgyu 'thun pa bshad pa chos thams cad sdud pa/ 'jigs pa nadang bral ba la 'jug pa/bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das par bgyid pa/ bdud kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu snyol la chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng 9bar bgyid pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms pa / dgra thams cad tshar gcod pa/ the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'dzud pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las rnam par thar bar bgyid pa/ dgra 1 thams cad bsrung rib bla na med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi chos thams cad dran pa dang ske/ blo gros dang / rtogs pa dang / mos pa mi brjed pa1 / spyod pa thams cad kyi thabs dang ye shes la mkhas pa kun ston pa/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi skye mched dang / byin gyi rlabs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ gzungs dang / bzod pa la 'jug pa/ snang ba'i ye shes 15mkhas pa la 'jug pa nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi snying po 'dzin 51—636

pa'i bar gyi gzungs 'di sems can rnams kyi gzi brjid dang / kha dog dang /longs spyod dang / stobs dang / grags pa dang / bde ba la reg par gnas pa dang / spobs pa dang / dran pa rnam par 'phel ba dang / thos pa 'dzin pa mi brjed pa dang / dgra thams cad pham par bgyid pa dang / lo tog mngon par 'grub pa dang / bslab pa 'dzin pa dang / dran pa'i snod du 'gyur ba dang / spyod pa mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub yang dag par thob par bgyi ba'i slad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gzungs 'di da 'dir bdag cag la bshad 1du gsol/ chos kyi tshul rjes su gzung ba dang / yun ring du gnas pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs chud mi 'dza' ba dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam mtha' dag bstan pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / nam mkha' dang / de bzhin nyid dbyer ma mchis 2pa dang / mun pa dang / snang ba dang / dmigs pa dang ske/ mi dmigs pa dang / tshu rol dang / pha rol dang / rtog 3pa dang /rnam par rtog pa dang / sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang /skyes bu dang / gang zag thams cad dbyer ma mchis pa dang / chos thams cad mi skye ba dang / mi 'byung ba dang / mi 'gag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dngos po ma skumachis shing yang dag pa'i mtha' dbyer ma mchis pa dang /sa dang / chu dang /( me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dbyer ma mchis pa'i slad du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis 'dir bdag cag la chos thams cad kyi tshul gyi dkyil 'khor dam pa'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ gang 'dir thos ma thag tu sems can bye ba khrag khrig 56—637

brgya stong dpag tu med pa dag la dkon mchog gsum mngon sum du gyur cig /sems can rnams phan tshun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgyid cing phan par bgyid par gyur cig /sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / lung bstan pa thob par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis kyang chos bstan pa'i phyir cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang nas pad ma'i snying po de dag la bzhugs so/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsags pa'i phyir dran pa dang / dad pa dang / dang ba dang / mos pa rnyed par 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems dang sems las byung ba rnams la 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / lta ba ngan pa dang / nga rgyal dang ske/ rgyags pa 1dang / dregs pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta 2ba dang /the tshom 3dang / nye bar len pa dang / srid pa'i srid pa kun gzhi'i nyes pa dag rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can so so canas 'di snyam du bdag gcig pu de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar chos nyan / pa'i phyir 'dug gi 'di na gzhan 7su yang med do/ /bdag gcig pu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs thams cad kyis dgongs te nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston par bzhed do/ /'di na gzhan sus kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la chos mnyan pa'i phyir gsol ba ma btab bo snyam du shes par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sangs 56wa 638

rgyas kyi yul gyi smon lam mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /yang de'i 1tshe gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'dir gtogs pa'i sems can rnams dbang po thams cad bstan nate thal mo sbyar nas de dag gis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bdag cag la chos bshad du gsol/ btsun pa labade bar gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag cag la chos bshad du gsol/ bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nan tan gyis bsdu bar bgyi'o/ /de nas yang de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzhan rnams la mchod pa'i phyir spos bkod pa las shin tu lhag pa'i spos gong du mchog tu khyad par du gyur pa rgya chen pos sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad khyab par byin gyis brlabs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lhag ma rnams mchod pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lag pa rin po che dang / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug 5pa sna tshogs dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rgyan dang ske/ lhab lhub sna tshogs dag gis gang bar byin gyis brlabs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /da 6ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan dag nas bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du dri ba'i phyir byon pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag sngon gyi smon lam gyis 'di 'dra bar rab tu nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sems can bsam pa nyams pa/ lam rab tu stor ba/56—639

ma rig pa'i mun pa dang rab rib kyi ling tog gis nyon mongs pa'i mun par bcug pa/ ngan song gsum du bzhugs 1pa/ mi dge ba dang 'grogs pa/dge ba thams cad dang bral ba/ mkhas pa thams cad kyis yongs su spangs pa/mtshams med pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ snying rje med pa'i bsam pa can gyi sems can rnams la snying rje ba'i slad du snying brtse ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyi brtson pa chen pos grang ba dang / dro ba dang / rlung dang / tsha ba dang / ngal ba dang / chad pa dang du blang bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang /ljongs dang / yul dang / yul 'khor du rkang gis 'gro bar bya'o/ /sems can la phan par bgyi ba'i slad du rtsub pa dang / nyung ba dang / ro med pa shin tu smad pa/ mi 'thun pa'i zas bza' bar bgyi'o/ /de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i slad du sbom pa rtsub pa/ reg na mi bde ba/ sha na dang /shing bal dang / gso rima'i ras dang / phyag dar khrod kyi gos bgo bar bgyi'o / /ri dang / ri sul dang / nags stug 3po dang / grong stong dang /dur khrod du gnas par bgyi 4ba nas rtswa'i 5mal cha dang / gso tshom dang /shing gi 'dab 7ma / rtsub pa/ dri mi zhim pa/ reg na mi bde ba'i mal cha spyad par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis 9thabs mkhas pa dang / snying rje chen po dang /brtson 'grus kyi go cha bgos nas sems can rnams la gtam rnam pa sna tshogs bgyi ste/ rgyal rigs rnams la ni rgyal srid dang dbang phyug gi gtam bgyi'o/ /bram ze rnams la ni rig byed dang / skar ma'i gtam dang / blon 0po rnams la ni yul dang las kyi mtha'i gtam dang / sman pa rnams la ni khams dang /56 wa 640

sman dang / bsgrub 1pa'i gtam dang / tshong pa rnams la ni nyo tshong gi gtam dang ske/ dmangs rnams la ni las kyi mtha' la mngon par zhen pa'i gtam dang /bud med rnams la ni kha dog dang / rgyan dang / bu dang / phyug pa dang /'gran zla med pa'i gtam dang / dge sbyong rnams la 2bzod pa dang / des pa dang ske/ las gsum la brtson pa'i gtam bgyi'o/ /sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du ma thob pa thob par bgyi ba dang / mngon du ma bgyis pa mngon du bgyi bar gzud 3do/ /ma thar ba rnams rab tu thar bar bgyi ba'i slad du sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs la spro bar bgyi'o/ /sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du yul thams cad du rgyu bar bgyi'o/ /de lta mod kyi sems can 'di dag ni de na bdag la gshe'o/ /mi snyan pa zer ro/ /phrag dog gi chos kyi rgyus bdag la 'khrig pa'i chos kyis med pa la skur pa 'debs so/ /kha gsag dang / tshul 'chos pa dang / sgyu dang / g.yo dang / brdzun lasmra ba dang / zhe gcod pa dang / bud med kyi tshig dag gis skur ci pa 'debs so/bdag la sas 'thor ro/ /bdag la gsad pa'i phyir mtshon dang / dug dang /me dang / 'khor lo dang / mda' bo che dang / mda' dang / ral gri dang /mdung dang / dgra sta dang / rdo dang / mtshon cha'i char 'bebs so/ /bdag gsad tshopa'i phyir glang po che dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / glang dang / ma he dang / spyang ki nadang / phag rgod dang /tshan po che rnams kyang 'gyed do/ /bdag gi ‘ gnas dang / gnas khang dang /gtsug lag khang yang mi gtsang ba dang / dri nga bas 'gengs so/ /bdag gi nyan thos 0grong khyer du bzhugs pa rnams la 'phags 1pa ma yin pa'i sems can 56wa 641

rnams kyis glu dang gar tshul ma yin pa byed du 'dzud do/ /thabs brgya stong du mas bdag gsad 1pa'i phyir brtson no/ /bdag gi bstan pa nub par bya ba dang ske/ chos kyi tshul gyi sgron ma gsad 2pa dang / chos kyi gru bshig 3pa dang /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyal ba dang / bdag gi chos kyi mchod sbyin rnam par gtor ba'i phyir brtson no/ /da sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi chos kyi tshul la gzigs te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa 'dir 'dus pa chen po mdzad nas dam pa'i chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba dang / bdud kyi stobs kyi yul thams cad rab tu gzhom pa cadang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad 5par bgyi ba dang / sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel bar bgyi ba dang /dgra dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad chos dang 'thun pas tshar gcad 6pa dang /sems can rnams kyi 'thab pa dang / rtsod 7pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dang ske/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / 'ching ba dang / 'gyed pa dang /rgol ba dang / dus ma yin par grang ba nadang / tsha ba dang / char pa dang /rlung dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi nyes pa dang / lta ba ngan pa ya nga ba rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /lha ma yin dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad 'dun par bgyi ba dang 1 /khyim dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor thams cad bsrung ba dang / g.yo dang / dug dang / byad dang / rmongs byed dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas 2ngan pa thams cad gzhil ba dang /56wa 642

'bru dang / sman dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / bcud thams cad kyis sems can nye bar 'tsho bar bgyi ba dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang ske/ dmangs rigs dang / rje'u rigs rnams dge ba spyod pa la gzud pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi sems rab tu bskyed pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la gzud pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams thabs shes pa la mkhas pa dang / dran pa dang / blo gros dang / rtog 17pa dang / mos pa dang / dpa' ba dang / brtan na pa dang / spobs pa rnamadza ripar 'phel bar bgyi ba dang / dbang bskur ba'i sar dbugs dbyung ba la 'dzud cing ye shes kyi pha rol tu 'gro bar bgyi ba'i slad du sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 4rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 55pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad cing byin gyis brlabs te/ gcig la gcig dgyes pa des 6'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das da ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes 7pa dag nasangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa 'dir dri ba'i phyir gshegs te bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di 9bsrung ba'i slad du chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 1 ripa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 1 pa zhes bgyi 1 ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dam pa'i chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par 1 bgyi ba dang / bdud kyi yul gyi stobs thams cad rab tu gzhom pa dang / ji ltar gong du rgyas par brjod pa bzhin du sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes 56—643

kyi pha rol tu 'gro bar bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gis gsol ba btab pa la thugs brtse bar mdzad de/ gang 1sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas shing pas kyi 2rgol ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa dang / mi 'jigs pa'i chos can du 'gyur ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi 'chad dpa dang / chos kyi bcud kyis sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar bgyi ba'i slad du legs par bshad du gsol/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bshad nas kyang phan tshun rjes su dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du bdag cag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa/ lags kyang bgyi ste/ chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba dang / bdud kyi yul gyi stobs thams cad rab tu gzhom pa nas sgrib capa med pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu 'gro bar bgyi ba'i bar gyi slad du byin gyis brlab cing chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 5pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i tsigazungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad kyis 7gang su dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad nyon cig /'di lta ste/ e 8ka ra/ e ‘ ka ra/ rghaṃ ka ra/ pra lha ka ra/ bha ya mi ha/ mi tra ma bha se 1/ a khe/ a kha/ e ba 1 re do me / do mad te/ ke bad ṭi/ ke yu re/ sa ma bā 4ha ne/ sa man ta bha dre gal/ dharme/ dharme/ dharma ke/ dza pha le/ mi tra a nu pā pole/ pha la ba te/ga ṇi/ ga ṇi/ ba rān te/ hi li hi li/ hi li hi li ke/ dzam bha ba te/ṭa ka ṭi/ ṭa ka ba rān te/ hi rin te/ shi rin te/ bin du ba te/ go bha 56wa 644

rte ༷/— ——bye me ———— —— —the —rte /————dzu she aṅge ——— shā bye cad ——sa suta shādhe wa hu lu hi le/ tsan bre1/ sa ma nadhi/ me 3dharma/ ku tsu ru/ mu tsu ru/ a tsid ta4/ tsi li tsi li/ li tsa bā 5ha/ tsu lu tsu lu/ me tra bā 6ha/ ku lu ku lu/ sa ra sa ra/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ma hā sa ra sa ra/ tu ṭu tu ṭu/ ma hā satya / hro 7da ya/ saspre su pulpe/ dhu nam pa ri ha re/ a bha ye/ ru tsi ne ka rakṣi / ā 9ya ma stu/ bi ba ha/ ti ti la/ ma ma le/ bā sha ka / shi shi ra shi shi ra/ lo ka bi nā ya ka badzre badzre dha re badzre 1 ba te/ badzre ma te/ badzre da de/ tsakra badzre/ tsakre tsa ba te/ dha re dha re/ bha re bha re/ pu re ta 1 re/hu hu re/ st+waṃ ga baṃ ba re shwa ra sha 1 tsa tsi li tsu ru pū 15re/ man tra ṇi/man tra khe16/ ga ga ra ṇi / mu dra ṇi / sarba mū ha ne 9/ dhi dhi ra ya 2 ni/ mu khe shwa 21ra la ya ni/ ṛ ṣa ni dza ni/ dha ba ba tsi/ tsaṇa 25ḍa la sa na me/sarba satya 2 a dhiṣṭha na/ a dhiṣṭha te/ sidhyan tu ma hā nī 5/ ni ni/ pā la ra til/ o dzo 20gre/ bi tsi ni/ bā na ha ra / bu bu re/ gu ru gu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ hi li hi li/ ha ra ha ra28/ ka ka nā da 9ba ha/ hi hi ta ma/ a yur ri ha na kuṇa ḍa dzwa la/ bha se ga da ne/ a ta ha ni/ mārga a bhi ro ri ha ni/pha la sa hye/ a ro ṣa ba ti/ hi li hi li/ ya thā ba dza ya swā gra ya thā lha/ ba ra ṇa tsa hre da yā bā ha sa tya pa ri bhā ba/ marga gas bhi ro ha ṇi tsi/ a tsa la bud rnyi da da pra tsa la pa tsa ya/ piṇa ri ḍa skṛ da ya / tsan dra tsa ra te 9/ a tsa le sho dha ni/ pra kṛ ti mārge 0/ i li i li le/ pra bho sa ra pra te/ sarba tra ta thā ta/ satya a nu ga te/ a na ba ra ṇa bra te/ a la tha/ e rig re/ sha mi ni mi bra dmā pa yo ha/ a hi ta / a bha hi/ ni ba ra ya ba sa tsi ra 56wa 645

mārga1ske/ la na largya sa re/ tri ran na nabang she/ dharma kā ya/ dza la tstshan dre/sa mu dra ba ti/ ma hā da bhū 31 bya ya/ sa lamu dra be gā sgrub dha ra ṇi/ mu dre ṇa/mu 6khi mu dra/ su ra pra ti sam bi dha / sa mu dra/ ā 8brta ni/ saṃ mo ha 9ska ra/ bibyu ta ra se na 1 kṣi ti/ mu dri to si/ ye ke tsid pra 11ti bhi bā 12ha/ba ha ba ha ba ha/ ki ṭa/ ka ba ṭa/ she la pra tī tya ṣṭṛ 1snyed ye na mu dri tā 1 dha ra ṇi na/ dha ra dha ra dha ra/ dā na ti la hu kṣa sarba ṣṭṛ 15da ya/ mu dri 7to si dzu da du 1 dza ba da ta/ dza kha ba ta/ su ma ti pa ti/ ma hā ad bhū 18ta mu dri 19ta/ ye ke 2 tsid/ ṣa ḍā 21ya ta na ni shri tā na bhu ta/ i na na mi ne/ sa tsa ne/ go ṣa sa tsa ne/ mu dri tā / ārya a dhiṣṭha 55na bha ba thā nā phyi/ n+ya thā 7ma hā purkye 28sa mu tstsha ya/ a ba tā ra ma hā kā ru ṇa 29ya/ mu dri tang sarba saṃ myag pra ti bad tsi rā rā tra na 1dza la tu dharma ne/ tri sarbe namu ni bhi ṣa bhra/ ma hā kā ru ṇa/ sa mā dhi/ dzñā rinan la bha ba le na/ mi tri tya ri ga /a bhi bīrya 25ba le na a dhiṣṭha)ratsi/sarba bhū ta u pa tsa yā ya swāhā/ de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis 'di skad ces sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyag 'tshal lo smyosangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan gsum smras nas 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /kye ma'o thub pa 'dus pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /kye ma'o byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams 'dus pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /kye ma'o chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'jomasang pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi 56wa 646

chos kyi 1tshul 2dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs dbyin gyis rlabs 4 ston pa/bdud kyi yul gyi stobs rnam par 'joms 5pa/ bdud kyi zhags pa kun gcod pa / dgra thams cad tshar gcod pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng 6ba/ chos kyi phyogs bsrung 7)ba 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sngon ma thos pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yul mtha' dag yongs su rjogs par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyis snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / 'byung ba chen po thams cad dang /'du byed dang / skye mched drug yongs su sbyang 8bar bya ba nas sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya ba'i bar gyi phyir da ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis phyag rgya dang tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad do/ /gzungs lung bstan pa 'di bshad pa na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā'i 9klung sum cu rtsa drug gi bye ma snyed dag gzungs mngon par bsgrub 10pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe zla 11'od gzhon nur gyur pa stan 12las langs nas thal mo sbyar te kun tu rnam par bltas nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 15dang / rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di lha thams cad dbyangs kyis bkang ste 'di skad ces smras so / /rgyal ba zla ba rnams kyi 'khor/ /'di 'dra ba ni rnyed par dka'/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtul zhugs che/ /mkhas pa 'di 15ni rnyed par dka'/ /gang 'di thugs rje ldan pa yi/ /mgon pos chos tshul byin brlabs pa/ /phyag rgya 'di 'dra thos pa yang / /mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'o1dzi/ /bdud kyi phyogs rnams thams cad dang / /dgra rnams kyang ni pham byed pa/ /dkon 56wa 647

mchog gsum rgyun mi 'chad 1pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ /bzod dang des pa rab 'phel ba /sems can rnams kyang 'dun dbyed pa/ /rgyal po dang ni yul 'khor skyong / /'di na ngan byas zlog byed pa/ /lta ba ngan pa rab 'gog pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbugs 'byin pa/ /byang chub lam yang rab ston pa/ /pha rol phyin pa 'phel byed pa/ /bzang por 3spyod pa rdzogs byed pa/ /thabs dang ye shes spobs pa rnams/ /'phel bar bya phyir byin gyis brlabs/ /dkar po'i phyogs ni sdud 4byed pa/ /gzungs 'di gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /byang chub lam las mi g.yo ba/ /chos kyi dbang rnams 'bar byed pa'i/ /gzungs la yid gnyis thams cad ni/ /bsal nas lhag par mos par byos/ /gang gis byang chub 'grub 'gyur ba/ /'di ni rdzogs pa'i lam yin no/ /chos smra rnams ni bsrung ba dang / /nyan pa mngon par 'phel bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa yi gzungs / /bdag gis da yang bshad par bya/ /sgrib pa med pa 'grub pa dang ske/ /sems can rnams kyi phan 'phel phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen po/ /su dag 'di la dad pa 'bul/ /yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhon nur gyur pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag cag kyang gzungs 'di la dad pa 'bul lo tshobyin gyis rlob 7bo/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig gis khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgos la me tog sna tshogs bkram pa/spos sna tshogs kyis rab tu bdug 8pa/ ro bro ba sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor 56wa 648

bske/ ras dang rgyan dang ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba/ gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng bas 1shin tu brgyan pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su seng ge'i khri reg na 'jam pa la 'dug ste gzungs 'di yang dag par bshad na su yang de'i sems 'khrug pa'am/ khams 'khrug pa'am/ lus 'khrug pa'am/yid 'khrug par mi byed do/ /de'i lus la su yang dbugs mi gtong ngo / /klad 2pa na bar byed mi nus so/ /mig na ba dang / 3lce na ba dang / so na ba dang /rus pa na ba dang / mgul pa na ba dang / dpung pa na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang ske/ rgyu ma na ba dang / lto na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang /byin pa na bar byed sus kyang mi nus te/ de ni gnas med do/ /de'i skad 'gag 4par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /chos smra ba de sngon gyi mi dge ba'i las kyis khams 'khrug pa'am/ skad 'gags 5par gyur na yang des gzungs 6'di bklags 7na thams cad ma lus par zhi bar 'gyur te/ las yongs su byang nas bde bar 'gyur /ro/ /chos nyan pa gang dag der 'du bar 'gyur ba de dag la yang su yang khams 'khrug pa'am/ skad 'gags ‘ par byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag de na gzungs 1 'di nyan pa de dag kyang mi dge ba'i las kyis yun ring por na ba dang / khams 'khrug pa dang / skad 'gags 1 pa de thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla 'od gzhin nur gyur pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor can gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed de dag ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 1 bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gzungs 'di la dad pa stsal du gsol/ 'di lta ste/ kha shān sate/ a sa mā ro be/56wa 649

mi tre sau 1ma ba te/ e hi/ na ba kun dza ben/ na ba kun dza be/ mū 3la sho dha ne/ ba ha kha/ ba ha kha/ mā ra ba 4ta thā tā/ pa ri tstsha 5da ba ha sa ba ha sa / a mū 6la/ a tsa le/ 7tsa tsa le/ pra tsa lhan/ dhi dhi 9le/ e ka nā ya sa pa ri tstsha 1de/ tsaṇa ḍi ṇa ba 15ra sa tri ne ri/ kha ga su ra tri 1 ṇi/ sta ba su ra tri ṇi/15 lhu tā 16ko ṭi pa ri tstsha de1 / dzwa 18la kha/ dzwa 19la kha ba ye/ dzwa 2 la kha 2 nā ma kha sha 22kha ka ka kha ha hā ha hā 2 hu hu hu na spar ṣa na be da na ba ri tstsha 26da na/ a ma mā n+ya ma ma 2 khya ma ma 28sa mu dra 9/ mu drwa da ba kha/ saṃ sku rā 31kho ma pa ri tstsha da ṇa / bo dhi sa twa kṣu 2 ti bi ma ma hā ba mi bhu ta ko ṭi ā ka sha 35shā sa pa ri tstsha smod swāhā/ yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad du gtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po de dag dang / sems can gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba de dag thams cad kyang legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang 'di skad ri du kye ma gzungs 'di ni stobs che ba drag shul dang ldan pa ste/dgra thams cad bzlog 9pa/ 'jigs pa dang / nad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang ske/ ltasang ngan pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar byed pa nas sgrib 1pa med pa'i ye shes dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes chen po bsags 5pa/bla na med pa'i ye shes dkyi rgyu 'thun pa'i bar gyi gzungs 'di bshad do/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /yang de'i tshe tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug ces bya 56wa 650

ba kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ lha'i 1las 'das pa'i gos dang ske/ spud pa dang / rgyan nadang / me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang ske/ byug pa dang / rgyan chen po mchog rnams kyis lus brgyan nas bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ tshangs pa chen po'i stobs kyi yul bkod pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi spyan sngar ca'adug go/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug stan las langs nas/ thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gang bdag gis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'dir dbyangs kyis go bar bgyi ba la der bdag la bgegs cung zad kyang mi 'byung bar dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshig brjod pa rnam par gdon mi 'tshal ba bstan par bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bdag gis da ltar chos smra ba rnams dang / chos nyan pa rnams kyi slad du 'di 'dra ba'i gsang sngags kyi tshig bsrung ru ba bshad par bgyi ste/ ci nas slad ma'i dus na bdud dam/ bdud kyi 'khor tamane/ lha'am/ / klu'am/ klu mo'am/klu rgan po'am/ klu rgan mo'am/ klu'i 'khor tam / klu'i 'khor mo'am/klu'i bu po'am9/ klu'i bu mo'am/ de bzhin du rgyas par bgyi ste/ sha za'am/sha za mo'am/ sha za rgan po'am/ sha za rgan mo'am/ sha za'i 'khor tam1 ske/ sha za'i 'khor mo'am/ sha za'i bu'am/ sha za'i bu mo'am/ mi'am mi ma 1 lags pa'i bar gang la la chos smra ba rnams dang / chos nyan pa rnams la glags lta ba'am/ skabs tshol ba'i dgra phyir rgol ba zhig mchis te/ tha na chos smra ba'am/ chos nyan pa / rnams kyi spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la yang 'tshe 56—651

ba'am / gnod par bgyid dam/ 'jig par bgyid dam/ mdangs 'phrog gam / lus la dbugs chen po gtong 1ngam/ tha na skad cig gcig tsam yang sdang ba'i sems kyis blta na/ bdag gis bdud nas mi dang mi ma lags pa'i bar de dag bzlog 2pa dang / chad pas gcad 3pa dang / tshar gcadas pa dang ske/ rmugs pa dang / rengs pa dang / rmongs par bgyi/ bri stsal 5bar bgyi na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gang bdag gis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'di dbyangs kyis gang bar bgyi bar dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgyu tshig brjod pa byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'di la su zhig bdag gi grogs su 'gyur / de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas brgya byin gtsug pud 8'dzin ces bya ba 'dzam bu'i 9chu bo'i gser gyi rgyan gyi 'od kyis lus brgyan nas ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu 'dug go/ /de nas brgya byin gtsug pud 1 'dzin gyis tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /che zhe de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi spyan sngar ma 'dug shig /che zhe 'dir bag med par ma byed cig /bcom ldan 'das la ma 'tshe zhig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byis pa rnams ni 11spros la dga'/ /de bzhin gshegs la spros mi mnga' / /de dag skye 'jig mtshan nyid kyi/ /'dus byas dag kyang ston pa mdzad / /de bzhin gshegs pa ni gzungs 1 dang / yi ge dang / tshig rab tu dbye ba thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyi tshul brnyes pa ste/ che zhe 1 de bzhin gshegs pa ni 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid du gcig pas de bzhin nyid la 'gal bar mi mdzad de/ nam mkha' la ni 'du byed gsum gyi 56wa 652

'jig pa'i nyamatshan nyid sgro btags pa med do/ /ji ltar 'du byed rnams nal nam mkha' mi rtog cing rnam par ni rtog pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang 'dod pa'i yon tan la spro bar mi mdzad/ mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog /mi gnas / mngon par mi zhen te/ de bzhin du srog la ma yin/ skye ba po la ma yin / gso ba la ma yin / skyes bu la ma yin/ gang zag la ma yin/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams la yang spro bar mi mdzad/ mngon par mi zhen na/ che zhe khyod kyis ji ltar na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la spro bar byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po rtog rtogs te tshig smros shig /khyod la des mi sdug pa'i 'bras bur gyur ta re/ skyes bu dam pa chen po 'di ni sangs rgyas mang po la lhag par bya ba byas shing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir legs par brgyan nas/ bud med kyi lus su mngon par sprul pa yin gyis ca'adi la bud med ces tshig tu ma brjod 5cig /de nas brgya byin gtsug pud 6'dzin gyis tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu bdag 7la thugs brtse 8bar dgongs te bzod 9par gsol/ 'di skad smras pas bdag 'bras bu mi sdug pa thob par ma gyur cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ltad mo can gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te brgya byin gyis tshig de slar ma bshags na/ de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ji tsam zhig tu 'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gal te des slar 10ma bshags 1su zin na/ tshe rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa'i 56wa 653

mngal smad pa bud med kyi dngos po yongs su blangs par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu ci nas kyang ngag gi las bsrung bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis khyod kyi dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshig brjod pa byin gyi rlabs kyis 1khyod spobs par gyis shig /de nas tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 2kyis thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi bsam pa la chos kyi tshul 'di yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba dang / chos smra ba rnams dang / chos nyan pa rnams dang / nan tan dang ldan pa rnams la 'tshe 3bar mi 'gyur bar 'dir dad pa castsal du gsol/ gang slad ma'i dus na bdud nas/ mi dang mi ma 5lags pa'i bar gyis/ de dag la 'tshe bar mi bgyid par dad pa 7stsal du gsol / de nas tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug gis de dag gi 7snang ba'i sems bzlog pa dang / mnas bsgag pa'i phyir/ dbyangs kyi sgra phyung nas/sgra des 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad gang bar byas so/ /yang de'i tshe tshangs pa'i dbang po de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras sol/ /bdag cag kyang gzungs 'di la dad pa 8'bul lo/ /bdag cag nyid kyis kyang phyi ma'i dus na gzungs 'di gzung bar bgyi'o/ /rab tu bstan par bgyi'o / /dam pa'i chos kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba dang / nyan pa 56—654

de dag dang / nan tan dang ldan pa de dag kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams kyi spyan sngar gzungs 'di la dad pa 'bul gyis 1skyes bu dam pa gsungs shig /de nas tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang ske/ nyan thos chen po rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di lta ste/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ ga ṇa ṣa ṇa ḍi/ ha re tsaṇa ḍi/ ma hā tsaṇa ḍi/tsa me ha/ tsa me/ sau mye/ sba me/ ā 5ba ha/ bi ba he / i ga dzā ne 7tra / kha kha/ mū la pa ri tstsha de/ yakṣa tsaṇa khen/ pi shā tsa tsaṇḍi9/ a brta ni / sa ma brta ni/ sam ka ri 1 ṇi/ dzam bha ni/ stam bha ni/ mo ha ni/utsā 1 ṭa ni/ ha ma hā/ ha ma hā/ ma hā saṃ ku 12tsa ne/ kha ga sha ba1 / a ma le/ a mū 1 la pa ri brtes/ a sā ra 17kha ba swā 1 hā/ gsang sngags 'di las gang 'da' zhing 18/ /mang po tshogs par mi spyod na/ /mig mi mthong zhing mgo yang 'gas/ /yan lag tha dad 'jig par 'gyur/ /'di lta ste/ a tsa tsa a ba ha/ tsa tsa tsu/ khra kha sha tsa ṭa ṭa kha tsa tsā 19na/ kha na ga tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa tsa na 2 tsa ha/ mū 22la tsa tsa tsa/ mū 2 la tsa tsa/ ha mū 2 mu la tsa tsa ha mū ha mu/ba u ba ha swā hā/ de nas tshangs pa'i dbang po thams cad nas sha za'i dbang po'i bar gyis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /stobs chen stobs kyi na shugs shin tu 'joms 27pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di bshad de/ phan pa ma yin par sems pa'i 'byung po thams cad la zhags pa 56wa 655

'dis btab na de dag 'tsho bar ga la 'gyur/ tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'byung po gang dag sdang ba'i bsam pa can / snying rje med pa byas pa mi gzo 1ba/ sems can la 'tshe ba rnams sam/bdud dam/ bdud kyi 'khor glags lta 2zhing skabs tshol 3ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba rnams la skabs tshol 5du nye bar 'ong ba (tshodang / btsun mo dam pa dang /bu dang bu mo dang / btsun mo'i 'khor rnams dang / blon po dang / shor ba dang ske/ dpung chi dam pa dang / 'khor rnams dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / chos smra ba dang /chos nyan pa rnams dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang 8bsam gtan dang ske/ kha ton la 'grus pa rnams dang / zhal ta byed pa la brtson pa rnams la skabs tshol ‘ du 'ong zhing tha na sems kyi skad cig gcig la spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la 'tshe'am/ gnod par byed dam/ 'jigs par byed dam/ mdangs 'phrog gam/ lus la dbugs gtong ngam/ snang ba'i sems kyis blta na/bdud nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 1 bar lus dri nga ba de dag gi 1 mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas so/ /de dag gi mig kyang long bar 'gyur / snying yang skams 15par 'gyur / sha bkra 15can du 'gyur/ lus rul cing dri nga ba dang / rdzu 'phrul yang yongs su bri bar 'gyur/ de dag sa gas par ltung bar 'gyur/rlung gis kyang de dag phyogs bzhir gtor bar 'gyur/ rdul gyis kyang yog nas de nyid du sems 'khrugs te 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag sa la rgyu ba de 56wa 656

dag ni sa'i khung bur 'jug par 'gyur te/ sa'i 'og tu dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong du de dag gi tshe yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag chu na rgyu ba'i 'byung po sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par ma dad pa/ de dag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i rgyal rigs nas zhal ta byed pa la brtson pa'i dge slong gi bar la 'tshe ba'am/ gang dag 1sngags kyi tshig 'di dag las 'da' na de dag kyang de bzhin du mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas pa nas/ de nyid du de dag gi tshe yongs su zad pa'i bar du 'gyur rol/ /yang yul gang du bdud kyi tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'byung ba der bdag cag 2gis bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad du spro bar bgyi'o/ /der chos 'dod pa'i sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyi'o/ /sdang ba'i gnod sbyin nas sdang ba'i lus srul po'i bar thams cad de nas bskrad par bgyi'o/ /yul de na 'thab pa dang ske/ rtsod dpa dang / mu ge dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dus ma lags pa'i char dang / rlung dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / nad thams cad slar bzlog par bgyi'o/ /bde ba dang / 'dum pa dang / lo legs pa dang —/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'thun pa rnams bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba rnams dang chos nyan pa rnams la nad ma mchis pa dang / grags pa dang /rnyed pa dang / bste 4stang chen po nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /yang de'i tshe tshangs pa chen po skadabyangs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la gnas pa/ tshangs pa'i nang du ni tshangs pa kun gyis bkur / bdud kyi nang du ni bdud kun gyis bkur/ brgya byin gyi nang du ni 56—657

brgya byin kun gyis bkur ba nas de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam thos kyi bu dang /'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang 1dang / yul 'khor srung na/dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / sred med kyi bu dang / lha ma yin dang / lha'i dbang po'i nang du ni de dag kun gyis bkur ba/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ rgyan dam pas legs par brgyan pa bud med kyi gzugs dang ske/ rtags dang / spyod lam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir lag pa gnyis na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbyangs dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la mig mi 'dzums 3par bltas te/ gzhan ma yin pa'i dngos po brjod du med pa ci yang ma yin par bltas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des tshangs pa dbyangs dang ldan pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye khyod mig mi 'dzums capar ci yang ma yin pa'i bar du nga la ci zhig blta/ ci 'di la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang / ci yang ma yin pa 5zhes bya ba'i chos de gang yang yod dam/ de bzhin du 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi nyon mongs pa rnams yod do zhes bya ba'i ming gi dngos po ni rkyen gyi mtshan nyid do/ /mtshan nyid kyi rkyen ni ma rig pa'o/ /ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams nas tsho'agog pa'i bar du rgyas par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar ma mchis pas na de'i slad du ma rig pa zhes gsungs na/bcom ldan 'das gal te ma rig pa ma mchis na srid pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis po 7de dag ga las skye bar 'gyur/ ci nam mkha' las skye zhes bgyir ni nanam 56—658

mkha' nyid kyang ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni nam mkha' lta bu'ol/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rdzas ma yin/ mtshan nyid ma yin/ mun pa ma yin/snang ba ma yin/ rtog pa ma yin/ rnam par rtog pa ma yin/ rnam par rig pa ma yin1/ grub pa ma yin/ brjod pa ma yin/ ci yang ma yin pa cha tsho shas med pa/ dngos po thams cad spangs pa de bzhin du rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams de bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni yang dag pa'i mthas /yongs su bcad pa'o/ /bri ba med pa dang / gang ba med pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni pha rol dang tshu rol la reg pa med pa'o/ /cha shas med pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni brjod du med pa'o/ /mi g.yo zhing rnam par gzhag pa med pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni rdzas dang /dngos po dang / mtshan nyid thams cad med pa'o/ /tshig gi lam dang bral ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni sgro btags pa med pa ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa/ kun tu rtog pa las srid pa'i yan lag rnams skyes so/ /bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong gis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis gsol pa/ gal te sangs rgyas kyi chos nam mkha' lta bur dngos po ma mchis shing brjod du ma mchis pa lags na/ de ci'i slad du ye shes dang /brtson 'grus dang / thabs dang / pha rol gnon pas khyod 'di ltar bdag la 'tshe / bdag gi bdud kyi yul 'joms/ bdag gi bdud kyi 5yul nas sems can kha 'dren/ 'gro ba med pa dang / 'ong ba med pa dang / ci yang ma yin 56—659

pa'i sgyu ma la slob tu 'dzud pa1/ gang gi tshe sems can 'di dag khyod kyis bslab pa la slob pa na de nadag la nyon mongs pa skye ba'i spyod pa yang dag par rjes su ma mthong 3ngo / /gang gi slad du khyod kyis bdag gi slad du grangs med dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / dbang phyug chen po rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams bsdus nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'di dag gang bar bgyis/ snying rje med pa 'dis kyang gang dag thos ma thag tu bdag klad 4pa'i nad mi bzad 5pas btab ste/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong zhing / lus kyang rul la dri nga bar gyur pa de 'dra ba'i gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams bshad/ yang de'i tshe bdud drug khri brgyad stong dang / bdud kyi 'khor tsigrangs med dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin du sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / grul bum dang / sha za de dag thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag cag kyang thos ma thag tu klad 7pa na bar gyur te/ lus kyang rul zhing dri nga bar gyur nas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba myong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /sdig can khyod kyis 'das pa de dran 8par byos shig /nga byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa'i tshe/ khyod kyis nga bsad 9pa'i phyir dpag tshad brgyad 1 cu tshun cad 1kyi sa dang nam mkha' bdud kyi sdes bkang ste 'ongs pa nas/ da 56wa 660

ltar bdud bye ba 'khor dang bcas te nga bsad 1pa'i bar du bkye bas/ de bas na khyod yongs su gdul nab dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang / de bzhin du bdud gzhan rnams nas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar du gdul ba dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad nye bar zhi bar bya ba dang / 'ong ba dang 'gro ba med pa/ ci yang ma yin pa'i sgyu ma la bslab par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad du 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba'i 'khor ba'i chu kun bskam pa dang / phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' grangs med dpag tu med pa nas / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar rnams bsogs kyis / sdig can khyod da bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed 4cig /de ltar na khyod klad 5pa na ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad 6pa'i tshor ba 'di las thar bar 'gyur te/ mthar gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta bu mngon du 'gyur/ bdud kyi yul las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul rnams kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i tshe bdud drug khri brgyad 7stong dang / bdud kyi 'khor grangs med dpag tu med pa dang / sdang ba'i gnod sbyin nas lus srul po snang ba'i bar gyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag gis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi na/ ji ltar bdag cag sangs rgyas kyi chos nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta bu de dag mngon du 'gyur/ thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul 'di yang thob par 'gyur/ de nas bdud sdig 56—661
