can gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te bdag phyi ma'i mtha'i mu'i 1 bar du klad napa na bar gyur kyang / bdag 'di 'dra ba'i g.yo sgyus cabyang chub tu sems mi skyed 5do/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po dbyangs dang ldan pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyan sngar bstan pa'i chos kun gzung bar spro'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga can 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa 'di'i bstan pa la gtso bos gtad pa gzung bar bgyi ste/ da yang shākya thub pa'i nyi ma nub kyi bar du bdag gis bstan pa 'di la chos kyi tshul 'bar bar bgyi'o/ /yul gang na bdud kyi tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma byung ba der bdag gis 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /gang du byung ba der ni shin tu lhag par 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang /yul de dag na rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang dag mchis pa de dag kyang bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ gnod pa las bzlog par bgyi / don dang dge ba la gzud par bgyi'o/ /gang dag bdud kyi tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha na bris nas/ 'chang ba rnams dang / gang na chos smra ba'i seng ge'i khri la mchis te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang dag par rab tu 'chad par 'tshal ba/ de dag gis der thog mar gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag brjod par bgyi'o/ /gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gis bdag 'gugs 6par 'gyur te/ bdag nyid 'khor dang bcas pa phyogs der mchis nas/ chos smra ba de dag dang / chos nyan pa de dag bsrung ba dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /'di lta ste/ a ba me/ a ba me/ a ma 56—662

ba re/ a ma ba re/ pa ri kuñdzag1/ nā ḍa nā ḍa puska ra mas nohā/ dza lu kha/ma kha ya/ i li mi rili/ ki li mi li/ bīrti latsa ra mu dre/ mu dra 5nu khe swāhā/bcom ldan 'das gang dang gang na chos smra ba de dag gis thog mar gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dran par bgyis la/ bdag gis kyang lha'i rna ba'i khams shin tu yongs su dag pas thos te der ma mchis na/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams neribaslus 7 par 'gyur zhing /bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang nami 'gyur bas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag der mchis la chos smra ba'i rkang pa'i drung du spyi bos blang bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba de'i spobs pa rigs pas nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba dang chos nyan pa de dag gi nad thams cad bsal bar bgyi/ lta ba ngan pa dang / bya ba ngan pa dang /the com 9thams cad bsal bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs gang na chos kyi rnam 1 grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa der bdag 'khor dang bcas te mchis nas 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang /mu ge dang / nad dang / 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag 1 tshogs dang /char mi 'bab pa dang / dus ma lags 12pa'i rlung dang / tsha ba dang / lta ba ngan pa dang / bya ba ngan pa de dag thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma lags pa dang ske/ dur khrod rnams kyi 'jigs 1 pa thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bkra mi shis pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / sdang ba dang ske/ brlang ba dang / zhe gcod pa dang / ro bro ba ma mchis pa dang / kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / dri nga ba dang / reg na mi bde ba'i dug de dag 56wa 663

thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /der tsha ba dang mu ge'i gnod pa rnams bsal bar bgyi'o/ /glang po che dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / ma he dang /spyang ki 1dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / rkun po dang / g.yon 2can dang /mi dang mi ma lags pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o / /der sems can thams cad kyi longs spyod dang / kun tu 4spyod pa'i slad du nor dang ske/ 'bru dang / sman dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / ro dang zas dang / skom dang / gos dang / mal cha sna tshogs nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o / /yul gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / 'dzin pa dang /klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / 'chad pa der bdag cag gis sems can rnams kyi gnod pa thams cad so sor bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / kun spyod pa'i slad 5du phan pa dang /bde ba dang / yid 6bde ba thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can de dag kyang chos 'dod pa dang 7/ dge ba spyod pa la gzud par bgyi ste/ 'di ni bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyan sngar smon lam btab pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bdag la thugs brtse bar namadzad du gsol/ skyes bu'i mthu 'di nyams 'og tu chud par bgyi ba'i slad du/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bdag la yid bzhin du bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ de nas de'i tshe de'i mod la shākya thub pa la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis tshangs pa dbyangs dang ldan pa de la thugs brtse / bar dgongs te 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa dbyangs dang ldan pa 'dis gang gi phyir/56wa 664

brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang /gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos la mngon par dga' ba'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin rnams bkug ste/ skyes bu'i mthu chen po 'di lta bu byed par 'gyur gyis1/ nged kyis gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag tshangs pa dbyangs dang ldan pa 'di la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa dbyangs dang ldan pa la grub par gyur cig /'di 2lta ste/ tsa myuṇa ḍi/myuṇa ḍa pa ri tshe 3de/ ha mū ha/ ha mū ha/ saṃ rakṣa ba la/ kṛtta 4mi kha/ pa ri ba ha/ tsa ma ra ya tha tsa/ su bi kha/ a mu hu la pa ri tshe 5de/ sarba bud dha a rnyikhri te swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu bdud dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang / gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba'i mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams dgug 6cing 'dun par byed pa'i gzungs 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su bzung zhing / byin gyis brlabs kyis 7khyod 'di skyes bu'i mthu chen po 'di lta bu byed nus par 'gyur ro / /dbyangs dang ldan pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag bud med kyi cha byad 'di lta bus chos kyi tshul 8bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bud med rnams kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bud med la la zhig bu 'tshal te / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par bgyid dam / bris te 'chang na bdag gis bud med de'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 56wa 665

bgyi'o / /yang bud med gang 'di lta bus sems 1yongs su skyong bar gyur nate/chos kyi 3rnam grangs 'di 'chang zhing klog pa nas nyan pa'i bar du bgyid na / de 'dod pa na spyod kyang de mngal du mi chags so/ /yang bud med gang brnyas shing smad par gyur pa'i longs spyod dang / kun spyod pa dang bral ba des/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rabaklags snyon bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing / bde ba thams cad kyang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba dang / sems can gyi 7bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ bdag gis nor bu rin po che 8'di gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la dbul 9lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu de de bzhin te/ bsrung 1 ba dang / yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/gzungs kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //bam po bdun pa/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba11/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu 'od 'bar ba dpal gyi spyan sngar 'dug nas/ de yud tsam gyis tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / skad cig gis bdud kyi gzugs su snang ngo / /de bzhin du sbyar te/ brgya byin gyi gzugs dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i dbang po'i gzugs dang / 'phrul dga' dang / dga' ldan dang / 'thab bral dang / rgyal chen bzhi dang / dbang phyug chen po 56wa 666

dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang ske/ grul bum dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / seng ge dang / 1glang po che dang / ma he nas dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi bar gyi 2gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ngo / /skad cig gis bya dang / shing dang / ri dang / 'bras bu dang / gos dang /mal cha dang / snam bu dang / snod dang / phyang ca'aphrul dang / rgyan dang /sman rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i gzugs dang / yud tsam gyis dge slong dang / dge slong ma'i gzugs dang / skad cig gis sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su snang ngo / /skad cig gis kha dog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs dang —/ gzugs brgyad cu rtsa bzhir snang ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'di kha dog dang / rtags dang / dbyibs dang /gzugs brgyad cu rtsa bzhir gda' ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po rigs kyi bu 'di rab tu mthu che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo gros dam bcas pa'i stobs kyi yul gang la gnas nas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed cing / shes rab kyi mig sgrib pa med pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa grangs med dpag tu med pa dag na bsam ru pa dang / sems pa ji lta bu dang / spyod pa ji lta bu dang / ci 'dra ba'i nad kyis btab pa dang / gang la gang skyabs su tshosong ba'i sems 56—667

can ji 'dra ba dag mthong ba de 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi gzugs dang ske/ kha dog dang / rtags dang / spyod lam dang / dbyibs dang /gzugs de lta bu dag gis sems can rnams theg pa gsum las phyir mi ldog pa la 'god pa dang / sems can gang dag 'dod pa'i zil gyis non te yo byad dang longs spyod rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'dod pa de dag gi chags pa spang ba'i phyir yo byad rnams byin nas phyir mi ldog pa la 'god pa dang / nad kyis btab nas sman 'dod pa rnams la sman sbyin 1 te/ phyir mi ldog pa la 'god pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo gros 'dis nyin 2gcig la gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams sdug bsngal las yongs su thar bar byas te/ theg pa gsum la 5phyir mi ldog par 'god pa'i dam bcas pa'i stobs kyi yul 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sa ma yin/bgrod pa ma yin no/ /gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'dis sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du/ skyes bu chen po'i mthu chen po brtsams nas ci srid lacig lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu 'dis bskal pa gang dag gi chi pha rol tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bskal pa ni grangs med de/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi /rdul snyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' shin tu rnam par phye ba'i blo gros 'dis bskal snyepa gang dag la ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus skyes bu'i mthu 'di lta bu brtsams nas bskal pa grangs med pa drug cu rtsa bzhi 'das so/ /gang pos gsol pa/ 'di ji srid cig na sangs rgyas kyi zhing nya6wa 668

gang du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bskal pa chen po brgya stong phrag nyi shu rtsa drug 'das pa'i 'og tu bskal pa chen po sgrol ba zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba 'byung 1bar 'gyur te/skye dgu'i 2tshe lo stong phrag bzhi bcu thub pa na mtshams med pa byed pa nas/ mi dge ba bcu'i chos kyi bar dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi nang du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas me tog rgyas pa lamatha' yas pa'i 'od zer zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /des lo bzhi khrir sangs rgyas kyi bya ba ma lus par byed par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir theg pa gsum po dag la 5sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su 0mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'dis sngon sems can gang dag yongs su smin par bgyis pa de dag gang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu chen po de'i smon lam ris su chad pa med de/des smon lam 'di skad du/ nam phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi mardul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams nasu/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag bar chad med par mthong bar ma gyur tam/ bdag gis sngon byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa na/ sems can gang dag thog mar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la btsud pa dang / yang dag par 56wa 669

'dzin du bcug pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 1bkod pa de dag phyogs bcur so sor sangs rgyas kyi zhing du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma mthong ba de srid du/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin bkod pa'i mthu 'di 'dra bas phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag dang gzhan dag na yang / sems can gang dag mtshams med pa byed pa dang / the tshom can nas mi dge ba'i chos kyi bar dang ldan par gyur pa de rnams de dag nas 2shi 'phos nas/ bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skyes la/ bdag byang chub sems dpar gyur dbazhin du/de dag thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 4bya ste/ phyir mi ldog pa la so sor bkod nas/ de nas gdod bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar skyes bu'i mthu chen po 'di lta bu rgyun du bya'o zhes smon lam btab bo/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gang dag da ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir lhags pa rnams ston pa 'di lta bu dag kyang mnyes par bgyis/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'dus pa chen po 'di lta bu yang mthong / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms 7pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang / tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i chos kyi )1—670

tshul gyi byin gyi rlabs sngon ma thos pa 'di yang chos 17mnyan pa'i slad du/ rnyed pa ni bdag cag gis rnyed pa ( legs par rnyed do/ /'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i le'u stesno/bdun pa'o// //yang de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la bos te/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar du gang dag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa 'dir lhags pa khyed (4)cag thams cad ngas spro bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dus pa 'di lta bu 'di dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'dus pa 'di dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa 'dus pa 'di lta bu ni dkon no/ /de bas na da khyod kyis 'di mthong nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dam pa'i chos 'di dang / chos kyi tshul 'di yongs su bskyang ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs 'di 'bar bar byed par spro ba dag gis/ de 5de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar khyed 56so so nas rang 7rang gi smon lam thob shig /yang de'i tshe bdud dge sbyong me tog ces bya bas me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo tog dang /2 myu gu 56wa 671

sna tshogs kyis rin po che sna bdun gyi bre bo byur bur bkang ste/ bud med kyi gzugs kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan par bsgyur nas/ bud med kyi gos dang / rgyan mchog gis brgyan te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang su dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir byon te bzhugs pa thams cad dang / gang gzhan yang su dag 'dir 'dus pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo tog dang / myu gu thams cad kyis byur bur yongs su bltams shing 1rgyas pa'i bre bo 'di 'bul na sems can thams cad la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis bdag gi 2bre bo me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo tog dang / myu gu thams cad kyis yongs su bltams 3pa 'di bzhes su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag bskal pa bzang po mtha' dag la sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'dir bud med kyi gzugs kyis/ sems can rnams la zas dang / skom dang / 'bras bu dang /me tog dang / lo tog gi sbyin pa'i bdag por 'gyur bar bgyi/ de dag kyang yongs su smin par bgyi/ bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa des bdag pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang 5rgya bar bgyi/ sems can gang dag bdag gis 'dul ba de dag kyang / yo byad kyis mi brel bar bdag gis rim gro bgyi na/ bdag gi bsam pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par dngos grub stsal du tshogasol/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod 'di ltar sems mngon par dad 56—672

pas sbyin pa che zhing mtho ba byas pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la khyod kyis mchod pa byas pa legs so 1legs so/ /khyod kyi bre bo me tog dang / 'bras bus yongs su gang ba 'di yang bzhes so/ /khyod kyang me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ 'bru dang / lo tog la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa dang / ji tsam 'dod pa dang /2 gang gi phyir 'dod pa rnyed par gyur cig /khyod kyi re ba yid kyi brnag pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ 'bru phun sum tshogs pa grub par gyur cig /'byor pa yang phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /de nas bdud dge sbyong me tog gis yang gsol pa/grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri brags 3gang dag na bdud kyi tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i gzungs 'di 'chang ngam/ ston tam / 'chad dam/ glegs bam la bris te/ bsti 4stang bgyi ba'i grong dang /grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri brags 5de dag tu bdag gnas par bgyi'o/ /de dang de dag tu shing ljon pa rnams kyi me tog dang /'bras bu nas 'bru dang / lo tog gi bar du bsgrub par bgyi'one/ /de dag thams cad na me tog dang / 'bras bu 'tshal ba'i sems can rnams kyang tshim par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bas na / tshe bas pa ma gtogs par gal te de na sems can me tog dang / 'bras bu'i zas 'tshal ba 'ga' zhig me tog dang 'bras bu'i zas ma 'tshal ba'i slad du/ 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par gyur na/dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang /'dus pa chen po ma lus pa 'di bdag gis bslus par gyur gyis 8bdag kyang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 51—673

bar ma gyur cig /gang 1yang de na sems can rnams me tog dang / 'bras bu 'tshal ba de ni bdag gi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de na me tog dang 'bras bu de dag 'tshal nas gang sems can de dag gcig la gcig phan pa dang / mnyen pa dang / snying rje ba'i 2sems su 'gyur ba de ni bdag gi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /gang me tog dang —/ 'bras bu 'tshal nas/ brtson 'grus dang ldan par 'gyur ba de ni/de dag 4gi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro / /gang sems dang sems las byung ba dag la mi rtag pa'i 'du shes 'jug pa de ni bdag gis 5bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /gang me tog dang / 'bras bu 'tshal nas tha na bya dang ri dgas kyang chos 'tshal sgyu bar gyur cing stong pa nyid la gnas na de ni bdag gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang du 'byung 8ba der sems can rnams kyi 'bras dang / gro dang ske/ nas dang / til dang / mon sran sde'u dang / mon sran gre'u dang /rgya sran dang / sran chung dang / sran ma dang /9 gang dag lo tog tu gyur pa de dag 'tshal ba'i slad du bdag gis nan tan cher bgyi'o/ /'bru dang lo tog mang po dag gis kyang mdzod dang / bang 0ba thams cad yongs su bltam 1 par bgyi'o / /de na sems can gang tha na bya dang ri dgas dag gis kyang 'tshal bar gyur na/ de ni bdag gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /der bdag gi bu ram shing dang / rgyan 'brum dang / bal po 56wa 674

se'u'i 1)khu shugs shin tu mang po bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /der bdag gis sems can rnams kyi rdza ma dang / bum pa dang / bya skyogs rnams yongs su bltam 5par bgyi'o/ /gang de la tha na bya dang ri dgas la sogs pas 'tshal na yang de ni bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar du yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur te/ de ltar bdag gi 4pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag yongs su rdzogs nas / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyis5/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyis bdag gi 6byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di lta bu 'di la rjes su dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 7de dag thams cad kyis cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang ba mdzad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog ces bya bas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod 'di lta bu'i mthu chen po byed nus kyisan/ skyes bu dam pa khyod kyi stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / spro ba dang ske/ rtul ba de lta bus sems can thams cad gnyer bar gyis shig /de nas bdud dge sbyong me tog gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog de las dbugs 'byin pa de thos nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ gang la la zhig na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mi spyod pa der bdag mi gnas kyi/ gang la lar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spyod pa der bdag gnas te/ sa phyogs de na 'bru dang / sman dang /'bras bu dang / me tog gang dag 'byung ba de dag sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / kun spyod pa'i slad du/ rab tu snum bag can dang / shin tu che 56—675

ba dang / shin tu mang ba dang / shin tu ro bda' ba dang / shin tu yongs su kha dog dang ldan par bsgrub par bgyi/ sems can de dag kyang bza' ba dang /btung bas tshim par bgyi/ sems can rnams kyi mdzod dang / bang ba dang /bum pa dang / rdza ma dang / bya skyogs rnams shin tu yongs su bltam 1par bgyi / tha na gang bya dang / ri dgas kyis de la 'tshal kyang / de ni bdag gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang / bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir bskal pa 2stong thams cad du/ sems can rnams la zas dang skom gyi longs spyod 'di lta bu dag gis tshim par bgyi/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun nas nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa snyigs ma lnga dang ldan par gyur pa grangs ma mchis dpag tu ma mchis pa gang gā'i 5klung gi bye ma snyed rnams su bskal pa stong re re la yang / skyes bu'i mthu chen po 'di lta bu bgyi zhing / de nas gdod bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi na/ bdag gi las yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni rang gi smon lam gyis 'gugs ( pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig lags so/ /'di lta ste/ tsa me kha/ tsa me kha/ tsa me kha/ bi bri ta ha te/ ba ha ba ha ba ha/sma ra asma ra kā nu / sa ra shen/ bi ba ba sa be/ sa ra sa ra/ yin dre/sa ra ma hrīn dre/ sa ra badzren dre/ ta ra badzren dre/ ta ra pa ya asma ka na/hu hu hu/ hu hu hu/ a sang ga dza be/ ha kha kha ba yu ba he/ u pa na ya/san ta ra ba ya/ bi dza pha la putpa/ o ṣa dhi/ dha na dha bhya na tsan dra 12a kṣa ye / dza la ba ha ne/ sma ra asma ra kun/ saṃ myag pra ti pan na pa ya sa ṭa 56—676

ta kā li/ ya ma 1me/ ma mi ma med 2tsa ba ra swā 3hā/ bcom ldan 'das bdag 4yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ gang dang gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dang /gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag bshad pa de dang de dag tu bdag gnas par bgyi'o / /de nas yang de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis de la legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang / bdud kyi 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang ske/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum dang / sha za dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin te/ skyes bu dam pa khyod bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug spyod pa legs so legs so/ /kho bo cag gi bsod nams dang / brtson 'grus dang /stobs dang / pha rol gnon pas skyes bu'i mthu 'di lta bu mngon par grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di'i grogs byed par snying brtse ba can du spro'o/ /de nas bdud dge sbyong me tog gi 'khor gang yin pa des mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag 'di'i slad bzhin du 'brang zhing mdza' 5ba dang /rjes su 'thun pa'i grogs bgyi'o/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod nam bla na med pa yang 56—677

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe/ khyod kyis bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston cig /bdud dge sbyong me tog gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dag de bzhin du gyur cig /sems can gang dag gis sa la sa bon rnams btab ste1/ me tog dang ske/ 'bras bu dang / dri kun tu spyod par gyur pa de yang bdag cag la phan pa dang bde bar gyur cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la bdud dge sbyong me tog gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag ni khyod kyi 2bstan pa 'dzin pa lags kyi /chos kyi tshul 'bar bar bgyid pa lags te/ 'di nyid du thog mar mu ge'i dgon pa rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ nan tan cher bgyis / bcom ldan 'das bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan du gsol/ de nas bdud dge sbyong me tog gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bdud dge sbyong me tog la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bde gshegs sras po dpa' bo pad ma'i 5gdong longs shig / khyod kyis tshode ring byang chub mchog tu smon lam snying po btab / /rtsa lag gcig pu snying rje skyes te bkres pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir ba'i 'gro ba 'di bkrol nas ni sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos rnams rang bzhin dri med dag la nam mkha' 'dra ba dang / /stong nyid mtshan ma rnams dang smon pa'i yul las rab grol bar/ /rtogs nas zhing 'dir ring por mi thogs dpal ldan zhes bya ba'i/ /sangs rgyas dgra thul blo gros shin tu bstan pa nyid du 'gyur / /de nas bdud dge sbyong me tog mchog tu dga' zhing yid 56 —678

bde ba skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das de dag la me tog sna tshogs kyis gtor to / /yang de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grub pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba stan las langs te/ thal mo sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 1rnams nal dbyangs kyis go bar byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bskal pa bzang po byung nas bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig gi spyan sngar sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du smon lam btab ste / sems can rnams kyi nad brgya rtsa bzhi rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis sa'i 5bcud las byin blangs te/ rtswa dang rtsa ba sna tshogs kyi nang du stsal sgyu to/ /sems can rnams longs spyod du bgyi ba snye dang / nad rab tu zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ sman bcud kyis len brgya rtsa bzhi sbyar te / rtsa ba'i sman brgya rtsa bzhi dang 9/'bras bu'i 1 sman brgya rtsa bzhi dang / mar las sbyar 11ba brgya rtsa bzhi dang /'bru mar las sbyar 1 ba brgya rtsa bzhi dang / bkru sman brgya rtsa bzhi dang / sman nad med ces bya ba brgya 1 rtsa bzhi nas bska ba'i phye ma dang / ril bu dang /snar stsal ba'i bar du stong rtsa bzhi bstan to/ /sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / nad zhi bar bgyi ba dang / sems can rnams 1 la phan par bgyi ba'i slad du bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig zhabs 'bring 5ba dang bcas pa la kun spyad pa sna tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur bgyis nas/ der bdag byang chub tu lung bstan par 'tshal slob dang / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig gis bdag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ma 'ongs pa'i 56wa 679

dus na/ skye dgu'i 1tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'i bar dang ldan pa shākya thub pa zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyis sangs rgyas 'dus pa chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa chen po 'byung ste/ der khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyis kyang de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de'i 'og tu 'od srung 2gis kyang bdag la de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ de'i tshe bdag gis sems can nad pa rnams kyi slad du/ bskal pa chen po gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sman chen po bcud kyis len gyi 3lhar gyur cig /der yang bdag gis sems can kun spyad 4pa dang /nad rab tu zhi bar 5bgyi ba'i slad du/ sa'i bcud rgya tshochen po blangs nas/rtswa dang / rtsa ba 7dang / lo ma dang / 'dab nam dang / me tog dang /'bras bu sna tshogs kyi nang du stsal to/ /de na sems can 9gang dag gis yang dag par sbyar te / 'tshal nas sems can de dag sems dang sems las byung ba dag la mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med par so sor rtog par gang 'jug pa de yang bdag gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar bdag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir skyes pa'i mthu chen po bgyid pa de bzhin du/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ bdag gis bud med kyi gzugs 56wa 680

kyis spro ba chen po dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / rtul ba 'di lta bu dang / sems can nad pa yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba 'di lta bus 1bdag bla na med pa 2yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /ces smon lam btab bo/ /da 4ltar yang bdag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyan sngar smon lam 'phel bar bgyid do/ / skal ba 5chen po dang ldan pa/ pha rol gnon pa/brtan pa dge sbyong me tog 'di'i grogs su yang gyur cig /bdag cag gnyis kus kha dog gcig tu bud med kyi gzugs 6kyis sems can rnams yongs su smin par bgyi'o/ /bud med rnams yongs su smin par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yang bdag cag 7gnyis kyis nad pa rnams dang / rgan po rnams kyi nad rab tu zhi bar bgyi 8ba'i slad du/ sa'i bcud las byin blangs la zas dang /skom dang / kha dog dang / dri dang / ro dang ldan pa sbyar bar bgyi ste/bdag gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar du yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamase kyis bdag la legs so/ /zhes bgyi ba stsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan du gsol de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ skyes bu dam pa khyod legs so legs so zhes de la legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed ni 'jig rten nad pa'i sman pa gcig /de bzhin dbang po rnams la bde byed pa/ /56—681

pad ma ldan pa zhing gtsang dam pa 1der/ /rnam par snang mdzad ces bya'i nargyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa 'dzin ces bya ba/ lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi 3 gzugs kyis sa la yongs su spyod pas smon lam btab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyod ni ri dang sa 'dzin gcig pu ste/ /khyod kyi re ba myur du rdzogs par 'gyur/ /rgyal ldan zhing mchog phun sum tshogs par ni/ /ye shes dbang phyug ces bya'i 5rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ye shes bla ma zhes bya ba/lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi 6gzugs kyis chu la yongs 7su spyod pas/ smon lam btab pa dang / de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyod kyis 'dir ni thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /me tog 'bras bus sems can tshim byas nas/ /zhing mchog rnam par dag pa sgo ldan du/ /nyi ma mchog gi bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thal ba ston zhes bya ba / lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis me la yongs su spyod pas/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'gro ba mi rtag 'du shes byas nas ni/ /skye bo byang chub yongs su smin byas nas/ /skye bo rdul can zhing mchog rab bsngags par/ / me yi sgron ma bde bar gshegs par 'gyur / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams 1la g.yo zhing /rdul dang bral ba lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis 56wa 682

— ——wa —wa ———wa —— ———————————— ——————— —————wa ————— wa —rlung la yongs su spyod pas/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /g.yo bas sems can rnams la dga' sbyar te/ /khyod ni nyon mongs rab tu zhi byed cing / /rnam dag zhing du mnyam nyid don mthong ba zla ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa med pa'i sgron ma lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis nam mkha' la yongs su spyod pas/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam btab pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 1de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mi gnas ye shes ston pa mya ngan named/ /yang dag byang chub lam mchog don smra 3ba/ /sgrib pa bsal cing chags pa med zhing du/ /ye shes mchog ces labya ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' spos mchog smra ba lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs dang ldan pa me tog la yongs su spyod pas/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal 5to/ /sangs rgyas lam mchog ston pa rnams la ni/ /me tog spos mchog dag gis mchod byas nas/ /me tog 'byung tsiganas zhing mchog rnam dag tu/ /kun nas spos kyi bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' kha dog ngur smrig lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs dang ldan pas tshon sna tshogs la yongs su spyod pas/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yang 'di skadangu bye sdu/'a

stsal to/ /'jig rten ngur smrig gos la btsud nas su/ /dkon mchog gsum rigs dga' bar ldan byas nas/ /sngon por snang ba'i sangs rgyas zhing mchog tu / /rin chen snang ba'i bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du sa bon dang —/ nags tshal dang / 'bras bu'i lha du ma nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa bdun gyi bar dag lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang —/ bud med shin tu yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pa dang / de dag tshigs su bcad pa re res 1lung bstan pa thob par gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ pho mtshan gyur te namo mtshan thob pa ni shin tu rnyed par sla la/ mo mtshan gyur te pho mtshan thob pa ni shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe na lha dang klu chen po bye ba phrag brgya lung bstan pa thob par 'dod nas/ byang chub tu smon lam btab pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa re res so sor lung bstan pa thob bo/ /de bzhin du lha ma yin dkrigs phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang ske/ lha dang mi'i bu mo mi 'khrugs pa 3bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bdun cu dang te/ bdud dang bdud kyi 'khor dkrigs phrag bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu nas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar dang / bram ze dang /rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa dang /bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par 'dod pa dang —/ tshigs su bcad pa re res so sor lung bstan pa thob bo/ /mi dang /56wa 684

——————————— wa wa wa wa———————————————————————— ———wa ——— wa mi ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / yi 1dgas dang / sha za bgrang ba nalas 'das pa sngon bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems ma bskyed 3pa dag ni sems bskyed par gyur to/ /sems can bgrang ba las 'das pa dag ni phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par gyur to/ /sems can bgrang ba las 'das pa dag ni/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang / gzungs sna tshogs thob par gyur to/ /sems can bgrang ba las 'das pa dag ni 'bras bu thob nas/ 'dod chags dang bral te zag pa zad par gyur to/ /sems can bgrang ba las 'das pa dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa las sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas nyid du phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par gyur te / de dag thams cad kyis mgrin cagacig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 5kyis bka' stsal pa bzhin du dam pa'i chos 'di yongs su gzung bar bgyi'o/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / yi ger 'dri snye ba nas/ 'chang bar bgyid pa'i bar gyis nagang zag de dag kyang / rig pas yongs su bskyang bar ༵༵༵// ba/dī/sa pa dī chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ lung bstan pa'i de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag thugs brtse bas dri 56wa 685

ba'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gshegs pa thams cad rigs kyi bu 'di dag gis gos dang / zas dang / skom dang / sman dang / yo byad kyis sems can rnams shin tu tshim par bgyis te/ bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / ci nas 'di dag sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du/sems bskyed ma thag tu ci 'tshal ba dang / gang gi slad du 'tshal ba dang / ji lta bu 'tshal ba'i gos dang / zas dang / skom dang / sman dang / yo byad rnams sprul pa'am/ bsham pa 'byor bar 'gyur ba'i yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas skyes bu 1dam pa 'di dag /skyes bu chen po'i 'amathu 'di lta bu bgyid pa dang / sems can rnams la longs spyod dang /yongs su spyod pas rim gro bgyid nus par 'di dag la dgongs su gsol/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ thugs rje chen po dang /bsod nams dang / ye shes dang / bsam gtan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyu 'thun pa yid la mdzad pas/ skyes bu dam pa de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyed kyi 3 bsam pa dang / yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi rgyu 'thun pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag sbyin 4no/ /'di lta ste/ byo gto ba ba/ sgri dzoti ba ba/ mu ni ba bske/ sa tya ba ba/ sru n+ya/ a lang ka ra ba ba/ sgyu na ra sa ba ba/ ma hā kā ru ṇa ba ba/ ma hā pra ti ba ba/ a mo ha ba ba/ ru ti ba ba/ kṣi ti ba ba/sa li la ba ba/ kha ga ba ba/ ba yu ba ba/ brta ba ba/ a dhiṣṭha snyen ba ba/56wa 686

a ma ba ba/ a ha na na ba ba/ ta thā ba ba/ bhū 1ta ko ṭi ba ba/ nir bri ti ba ba/ tri ya lan 5ba ba/ tree dhā tu ka ba / tri bi mo kṣa ba ba/ tri shu kla 5ba ba/ raṣṭi a dhiṣṭha yin ba ba/ ba ba ba ba ba ba/ sa ma tra yan n+ya sa ma tā /ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṣṭa/ sid nadhi sarba kun 9la sha la mu la/ a dhiṣṭha na ya 1 swāhā / skyes bu dam pa khyed kyis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi/1/ gsang sngags kyi 12tshig bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di dag /sems can rnams kyi longs spyod dang / kun spyod pa dang / yongs su smin par bya ba dang / khyed kyi byang chub kyi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir zung 1 shig /yang de'i tshe/ dge sbyong me tog dang / dpal gyi lha mo dang kṣa/ rtsi'i lha mo grub pa'i blo gros dang / lha mo sa 'dzin la sogs te/byang chub sems dpa' khri thams cad bud med kyi gzugs kyis/ sems can rnams kyi 15longs spyod dang / kun spyod pa dang / yongs su smin par bya 14ba'i phyir brtson par gyur nas 2/ de dag thams cad mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag gi yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di rnams kyis/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gsungs pas 19na/ byin gyi rlabs 2 'dis bdag cag sems can thams cad la rim gro bgyid nus so/ /bdag cag bla na med pa'i ye shes de bsgrub 2 par nus so/ /bdag cag gis sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du/ gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gzung bar bgyi zhing brtson pa drag pos spro bar bgyi'o/ /yang sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i slad du da de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar rang rirang gis 2 dam bcas pa la gnas 56—687

par bgyi'o/ /lha'am klu nas mi'i bar gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis 1 brlabs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di ma mchis par bgyid dam/zhig par bgyid dam/ rnam par ma rungs par bgyid la/ bdag cag gis dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du/ gal te de ma bzlog gam / nan tan ma bgyis na bdag 2cag gis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bslus par gyur cig /bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /kye grogs po dag lha nas mi'i bar gang la la zhig /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen 3nam/ dge bsnyen ma la 'tshe la/gal te bdag cag gis de dag ma cabazlog gam/ bdag cag gis de dag gi 'khrug pa zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du nan tan ma bgyis na/ bdag cag gis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag 5thams cad bslus par gyur cig /bdag cag 6bla na med pa yang dag par 7rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das byang chub don du gnyer ba'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig zhugs dang /chab dang / dug dang / mtshon dang / byad dang / rims zhag gcig pa dang ske/ zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pas 'jigs pa nas / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lus srul po dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / nad dang / bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / 'tshe ba gang yang rung ba'i bar dag gis 'jigs shing skrag par gyur pa 56—688

lasal/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i gzungs kyi 1gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dran na/sngon gyi dalas kyi sgrib pa ni ma gtogs te/ bdag cag gis de dag gnod pa rnams las yongs su thar bar ma bgyis na/ dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bdag cag gis bslus par gyur cig /bdag cag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /de'i tshe gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis de dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/skyes bu dam pa khyed 4kyis legs par dam bcas pa legs so legs so/ /khyed ru kyis skyes bu dam pa'i mthu chen po 'di lta bu byed nus so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bdud sdig to 6can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /thub pa gshegs pa 'di dag la ni dad cing dga' ba'i mchog bskyed de / /de ring gzhan gyi don phyir dga' bar myur du byang chub sems gzhol byos/ /sdig can khyod ni rang gi yul nas rab tu grogs med mthu med kyis / /thub pa la ni khyod kyis sdo 1 zhing snyog par byed pa gtang bar byos/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis gsol pa/ khyod kyi tshig gis byang chub dri med dad pa'i sems gcig bdag mi bskyed/ /thub pa ma gsung bzhugs shig bdag la rjes su 'gro ba rnams kyang mchis / /de dag lhan cig bdag gis 2yul na dpung dang bzhon par gnas par bgyi/ /phun sum mchog 'dzin bdag mthus ji srid 'tsho bar /khyod kyi dbang mi mchi / 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ snying brtse ba'i le'u ste/ dgu pa'o// //56wa 689

dā ra ba'i dri mos kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sangs rgyas 5kyi zhing tha dad pa dag nas byon te/ nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dus 3nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di ni legs par byin gyis brlabs/ bdud bye ba ni pham par mdzad/ byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po'i spyan gyis sems can rnams la ni gzigs/ sdig pa'i lta ba las ni rab tu thar bar mdzad/ shes rab kyi sgron ma ni 'bar bar mdzad/zhi ba'i lam la ni bkod de/ chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 5pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms tshopa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang / tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa lung bstan pa'i 7chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni bshad/ nag po'i phyogs ni pham par mdzad/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni btsugs pa de bzhin du/da ltar phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs shing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis kyang / sems can la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ nyon mongs pa can snyigs nam lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'du ba chen po mdzad de/ chos kyi tshul 'di legs par byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan btsugs pa'i bar du mdzad na/ shākya thub pa nyi ma khyod ni 9nub nas / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir su zhig mchog tu 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos 'di 'dzin par 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di 'bar bar bgyid par 'gyur / sems can rnams yongs su smin par bgyid par 'gyur/ 'dus pa 56—690

chen po 'dir yang bgrang bar chud par 'gyur/ bdag gis su'i lag tu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su gtad par bgyi1/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog man dā ra 2)ba'i dri mos la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa thob pa rnams sam/ brgya byin nam/ tshangs pa'am/'jig rten skyong ba'am/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'am/ gang su yang rung ste/ chos kyi tshul 'di la mngon par dbartson pa rnams dang / gang dag dbus kyi gling bzhi po 'di dag na 4gnas pa/ chos kyi tshul 'di la mngon par dad pa'i brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba nas/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i bar de dag gi lag tu gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su gtad par mdzod cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog man dā skur ba'i dri mos kyis/ dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshig brjod pa thogs pa med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag khyab par mdzad nas/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /grogs po dag gang su dag 6sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir 'dus pa thams cad nyon cig /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni shin tu dkon no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu 'dus pa 'di yang 8shin tu dkon te/khyod la thugs brtse ba dang / sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba dang /dam pa'i chos kyi tshul byin gyis brlabs 9pa dang / bla na med pa'i lam la 56—691

bkod 1pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'di dag thams cad 'dus nate/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba nas 'khor ba'i pha rol tu 'gro bar bya ba'i bar gyi phyir/ da ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du gtogs pa'i sa'i khams thams cad byin gyis brlabs so/ /chu'i khams thams cad dang / me'i khams thams cad dang / rlung gi khams thams cad dang / nam mkha'i khams thams cad byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis/ gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dag dang / gang dag yang 4gzi brjid che ba/ gzi brjid che sgruba'i sems can rnams dang / gang dag yang gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa de dag thams cad la bos te 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye grogs po dag sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi tshul 'di byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed 7kyi lag tu shin tu gtad kyis 7ci nas 'dir dam pa'i chos 'di myur du mi 'jig 8pa dang / nub par mi 'gyur ba de ltar khyed kyis dam pa'i chos 'di yid la gyis shig /'bar bar gyis shig /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa gang dag 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa nas/ yi ger bris te/ 'chang ba'i bar du byed pa dang /56wa 692

dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam1/ dge bsnyen nama'am/dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag de dag thams cad yongs su bsrung zhing bskyang ba'i phyir/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 3lag tu gtad kyis cachos smra ba dang /chos la dga' ba dang / bsam gtan la mngon par dga' ba dang / chos mnyan 5pa dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams khyed kyis bsrung bar bya ba nas/ yongs su bskyang ba'i bar du gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag byung bar gyur pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dus nas chos kyi tshul 'di bsrung ba dang / mi nub par bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag kun tu bsrung ba nas/ sems can thams cad yongs su 5smin par bya ba'i bar gyi phyir/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi lag tu gtad do/ /de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ phyogs bcur sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byung ba de dag thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skad cig gis 'dus te/sems can la phan pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag kyang 'chad par 'gyur/ chos kyi tshul 'di yang byin gyis rlob 7par 'gyur zhing /chos kyi tshul 'di bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba'i phyir brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi lag tu gtad par 'gyur ro//de bzhin du nged kyis kyang da ltar kun tu bsrung ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gnas pa rnams dang /56wa 693

gling bzhi pa 'di na gnas pa'i brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po rnams kyi lag tu 'di shin tu gtad kyis1/ ci nas myur du mi 'jig cing ske/ nub par mi 'gyur ban/ de ltar khyed kyis dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di yid la gyis shig /rab tu 'bar bar gyis shig /bsrung dbar gyis shig /rigs kyi bu 5'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa gang dag dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams gang 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa nas tha na 6glegs bam la bris te 'chang bar byed pa'i bar dang / chos smra ba dang /chos nyan pa dang / bsam gtan la mngon par brtson pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa de dag la khyed kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 7'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam / ri brags samatsho/ pho brang 'khor dang / dgon pa'i gnas nas dmangs kyi khyim gyi bar du gang na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu spyod de 'chad dam/ lung 'bog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ tha na glegs bam la 1byis te/ 'chang na chos kyi bcud des sa'i bcud dang /sems can gyi mdangs 'phel bar 'gyur te/ khyed des mdangs dang ldan zhing /gzi brjid dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang / pha rol gnon pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ khyod kyi g.yog 'khor dang / gzhal med khang yang 'phel 56wa 694

bar 'gyur/ mi'i rgyal po rnams kyang bsrung 1bar 'gyur te/ de dag gi nargyal srid dang / dbang phyug kyang 'phel bar 'gyur te/ de dag gi yul 'khor thams cad kyang bsrung dbar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal po rnams kyang lachos kyi bcud des tshim nas gcig la gcig phan pa'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po de dag las kyi rnam par smin pa la yang mngon par yid ches par 'gyur/ dge ba'i sems su 'gyur/ ser sna med pa'i sems dang /phan pa'i dngos po'i sems dang / sems can thams cad la snying rje ba'i sems nas / yang dag par 5lta ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /so so bdag gi yul la yang mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di yang skye bo rags 6pas gang bar 'gyur/ shin tu lo legs pa dang / shin tu nyams dga' bar 'gyur/mi'i skye bo mang pos gang zhing sa yang mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur/ 'bras bu shin tu mdog bzang ba dang / shin tu zhim pa dang / 'o 7ma'i sman dang /lo tog 8gi sman dang / nor dang / 'bru rnams shin tu 'byor pa dang / nad med pa dang / bde ba la reg par gnas pa bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /'thab pa dang ske/ rtsod pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang ske/ dug dang / sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / phye ma leb dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po ma rungs pa dang / ri dgas dang ske/ bya dang / sbyang ki dang / dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang / char rnams rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ skar ma dang / nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dang / zla ba dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / lo dang / dus rnams kyang legs par 'byung bar 'gyur/ sems can rnams kyang phal cher dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod 56wa 695

par 'gyur/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag kyang khyed kyi g.yog tu 'gyur ro/ /de ltar gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i yon tan mang zhing phan yon che ste/ sems can rnams 'khor ba'i pha rol tu 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir/sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'dus pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs te/ grags pa 'phel zhing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro1/ /bud med kyi dngos po skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba ma lus par yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /mdor na tshe 'di la bud med kyi dngos po myong bar 'gyur bar 'phangs pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur te/ mtshams med pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa ma gtogs par gang gzhan lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa'i gnas ngan len de thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha na glegs bam la bris te/ 'chang na yang 'dus pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mthus/ de'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ri rab tsam yang byang bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dmigs pa 'phel zhing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang /bsam pa thams cad phun sum tshogs pa dang / lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi legs par /spyod pa thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ lta ba ngan pa thams cad spong ba dang / dgra thams cad chos dang 'thun par tshar gcod pa dang / zhi zhing phra ba'i las thams cad la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /yul gang du gzungs kyi 56wa 696

chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spyod par 'gyur ba der sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1 byin gyis brlabs pa 'dus pa chen po'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i mthus sa phyogs de shin tu snum par 'gyur/ 'bras bu mdangs dang ldan pa dang /shin tu zhim pa dang / ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ kha ba dang / tsha ba dang /rtsub pa dang / ro med pa naspong bar 'gyur/ me tog dang / 'bras bu shin tu 'byor pa dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / bang ba dang / mdzod dang / rdza phru 3dang / bya skyogs rnams rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur / gos dang /zas dang / skom dang / sman dang / yo byad rnams shin tu mchog tu 'gyur 5te / de na sems can yigang dag 7zas dang skom gyis 'tsho ba de dag ni shin tu nad med pa dang / nor dang ldan pa dang / kha dog dang ldan pa dang /stobs dang ldan pa dang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang / chos 'dod pa dang /dge ba tshol 8ba la mngon par brtson pa dang / sdig pa'i lta 9ba yongs su spong bar 'gyur te/ de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ khyed dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis 0khyed kyi g.yog 'phel nas/ stobs dang ldan zhing thogs pa med pa'i tshogs su 'gyur gyis / chos kyi stobs kyis rigs bzhi'i skye ba'i 1 tshogs yongs su bskyang bar gyis shig /sems can rnams chos kyi don la tshud cig /de ltar na khyod kyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa me tog man dā ra ba'i dri mos kyis/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo'i chos kyi tshul 'di gzung ba dang / bshad pa dang bsrung ba'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi ye shes kyi sgra dbyangs rnam par dag pas don dang / tshig 56—697

brjod pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa 'di kun bkang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / brgya byin gyi 1dbang po nas tshangs pa'i dbang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang dpo thams cad kyi bar du gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gnas pa phal cher gling bzhi pa 'di na gnas pa rnams la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas spros ba mdzad do/ /yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa gang dag bzod pa thob pa bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa bdun sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gnas pa de gdag thams cad kyis mgrin tshigacig tu 'di skad ces gsol to / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ bdag cag gis kyang dus gsum du gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rigs pas ston 7par bkur zhing / gus pa chen pos bzungs bar bgyi'o/ /snying rjes sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba nas/ bla na med pa'i lam gyi bar la dgod pa'i slad du bdag cag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / pho brang 'khor dang / dgon pa'i gnas rnams su rgyas par bstan par bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du/ sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par bgyi'o/ /yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/skyes bu dam pa dag legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis de bzhin du gyis shig /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa nas lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i bar thams cad dang / gang dag gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir 'dus pa/ sems 56wa 698

can gzi brjid che ba/ gzi brjid che ba/ bye ba khrag khrig phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag gis kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung 1bar bgyi ba nas rgyas par rab tu bshad pa'i bar du bgyi'o/ /yang dag par bstan par bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams yongs su smin par bgyi'o/ /chos 'tshal ba dang / chos mnyan napa'i gang zag rnams kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spyod par 'gyur ba der sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi bkas bdag cag gis kyang 'thab pa dang / rtsod dpa dang / 'thab 4mo dang ske/ 'gyed 5pa dang / mu ge dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang / char pa dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / gdug pa dang / rtsub pa dang / ro ma mchis pa dang / sra ba dang / kha ba dang /tsha ba'i dngos po rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /bde ba dang / nyams dga' ba dang / lo legs pa dang / 'dum pa bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi tshul yun ring du gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du nan tan cher bgyi'o/ /chos nyan pa'i rgyal po de dag kyang shin tu yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /bsam gtan la mngon par dga' ba'i sems can rnams kyang tshobasrung bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/bzhin bzangs dag legs so legs so/ /khyed kyis de bzhin du gyis shig /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyi ga'i phyir nan tan gyis shig /de ltar na khyed kyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la mchod pa 56wa 699

byas par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar khyed kyis sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang ske/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'bar bar bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir brtson na khyed ring por 1mi thogs par myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbus kyi gling bzhi pa 'di na gnas pa'i brgya dbyin dang ske/ tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / lha'i dbang po nas lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i bar dang / gang dag yang sems can gzi brjid che ba gzi brjid che ba de dag thams cad stan las langs te thal mo sbyar nas 'dus te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi bkas bdag cag gis kyang / chos kyi tshul 'di bstan par bgyi/ bsrung bar bgyi / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /'dus pa chen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang rigs pas blang bar bgyi ba nas/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang —/ ljongs dang / yul dang / pho brang 'khor dang / dgon pa'i gnas rnams su rgyas par bshad par bgyi'o/ /dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /gang dag yang chos bsrung cabar gnas pa'am/ chos smra ba'am/ chos nyan pa'i dge slong dang ske/ dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa nas glegs bam la bris te/ 'chang ba'i bar du bgyid pa dang / bsam gtan la brtson pa de dag bdag cag gis bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/56—700

shādzñā ༷ snyeng ——— (bye wa —bye caparngo ——— rte/———————rte ṅgewa brte/ — rtewa shā ——— /rte /—————boda~X dang ske/ gdugs dang / ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan dang / byug pa nas sman dang ske/ yo byad thams cad kyi bar gyis bsti 2stang du bgyi'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba'am / klog pa'am/ ston pa'i drung du bdag cag nyid nyan 4pa'i slad du nye bar mchi 5bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la ston par 'du shes pas/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan gyis bsti tsistang du bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ ri mor bgyi/ mchod par bgyi'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chad pa'i tshe/ chos kyi bcud kyis bdag cag mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur/ stobs dang ldan/ brtson 'grus dang ldan/ mthu dang ldan/ dran pa dang ldan/ ye shes dang ldan/phyogs dang g.yog tu ldan zhing / chos dang mthu thogs pa ma mchis par 'gyur rol/ /de ltar bdag cag gis yul thams cad du 'thab pa dang / rtsod 7pa dang ske/ 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dus ma lags pa'i rlung dang / char dang / grang ba dang ske/ tsha ba dang / char mi 'bab pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas 8ngan pa dang / sdang ba dang / rtsub pa dang / brlang ba dang / kha ba dang /tsha ba dang / ro ma mchis pa dang / mi dge ba'i phyogs bgyid pa'i dngos po rnams rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /shin tu bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /nyams dga' ba dang / nad ma mchis pa dang / 'dum pa bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /rlung dang / char dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba rnams dus gsum du 'byung 56—701

bar bgyi'o/ /mtshan mo dang / nyin mo dang / zla ba dang / zla ba phyed pa dang ske/ lo dang / dus rnams kyang legs par 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /gza' dang ske/ rgyu skar dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba rnams kyang legs par rgyu bar bgyi'o / /'bab chu dang / chu mig dang / rdzing dang / lteng ka yang shin tu bltam 1par bgyi'o/ /gang du sems can rnams chu'i klung gis gnod par gyur pa yang bdag cag gis bsal bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal dang / ljongs de dag tu yang sems can la sman par bgyi ba'i slad du/bdag cag gis 'dab ma dang / yal ga dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ sdong bu dang / 'bru dang / sman dang / ro dang / lo tog rnams shin tu snum pa dang / bda' ba nadang / kha dog dang / ro che zhing mang ba 3bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams la nor dang / 'bru dang / sman dang /gos dang / lhab lhub kyis mi brel cabar bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /sems can de dag kyang dge ba tshol ba'i sems dang / sdig pa yongs su spong ba dang /dpal dang / bsod nams 'byung bas 6tshe ring po 'grub 7par bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang ske/ pho brang 'khor gang dag tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ngam/ tha na glegs bam la bris te/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/na mchod dam9/ bsti rka stang bgyid cing ske/ 'chang ba de dag tu rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba 'byung ba de dag kyang / bdag cag gis bsrung bar bgyi / yongs su bskyang bar bgyi / de dag la gnod pa bsal 1 bar bgyi/ phan pa bsgrub par bgyi'o1 / /56wa 702

ltad 1mo dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / lta ba dngan pa dang / byed pa ngan pa dang glu/ byin rlabs ringan pa dang / smon lam ngan pa dang / skyabs ngan pa dang ske/ tshul 'chos pa dang / kha gsag dang / g.yo dang / sgyu dang /brdzunas5du smra ba dang / phrag dog dang / khro ba dang / ser sna thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba'i lam drang po dang / dad pa dang ske/ dul ba dang / kun sdom pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa la gzud par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du btsun mo dam pa rnams dang / btsun mo'i 'khor rnams dang / blon po dang / rtsis pa chen po dang / grong rdal pa dang ske/ zho shas 'tsho ba dang / ljongs kyi mi rnams dang / rigs bzhi rnams dang ske/ bud med dang / skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams kyang bsrung zhing bskyang tsibar bgyi ba nas ngo tsha shes pa 7dang / khrel yod pa'i bar la gzud par bgyi'o/ /tha na yul de dag tu rkang bzhi pa rnams kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o / /gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chad par 'gyur ba nas glegs bam la bris te/ bzhag 8pa'i bar du bgyid na/ sems can de dag la bdag cag gis de 'dra ba'i nan tan chen po dang rtul ba chen pos yongs su bskyang 9bar bgyi'o0/ /chos kyi tshul yang dag par bstan pa'i slad du/ bskal pa mtha' yas par nan tan cher bgyi'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis skyes bu dam 1 pa de dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ bzhin bzangs dag legs so legs so/ /khyed 12kyis de bzhin du gyis shig /khyed kyis chos kyi tshul dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs dmi nub par nan tan byas na/ de lta na 1 khyed kyis dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 56—703

'das thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs las/ kun tu bsrung 1ba'i le'u ste/ bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang nadang / yul 'khor srung 3dang / lus ngan po rnams la bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs dag nga sems can la snying rje'i smon lam gyis nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i 4chos kyi mu ge byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir 5bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub snyomangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun par zhugs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i chom rkun dang / g.yon 7can gyis gtses pa rnams kyi nyon mongs pa rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ ngas bdud kyi phyogs ni pham par byas/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni bsgreng 8/sems can tshad med pa dag ni sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su thar bar byas/dam pa'i chos kyi char ni phab/ ngas bdud bye ba ni pham par byas so/ /bzhin bzangs dag kṣ-i gang gi phyir da 0ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 11dang /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi sa'i bcud dang / sems can gyi gnas kyi nyes pa rnams rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / mi dge ba'i las thams cad ma lus par zad par bya ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs yun ring du gnas par bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mtha' dag yongs 56—704

su grub par bya ba'i bar gyi 1phyir/ chos mnyam pa nyid rdo rje lta bu brten 2pa'i chos kyi snying pos lus 'joms dpa zhes bya ba'i gzungs phyag rgya dang / tshig rab tu dbye ba la 'jug pa/ lung bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabs kyis 4de bzhin du khyed 5kyis kyang byin gyis rlobs la srungs ( shig /gang nga'i dam pa'i chos kyi tshul yang dag par bsrung 7ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa'i tshogs dang / gang lung 'bogs 8pa dang ske/ kha ton byed pa dang / dran pa dang / brjod 9pa dang / bshad pa dang ske/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dge bsnyen 1 gyi sdom pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa'i tshogs dang / gang bsam 12gtan dang po bsgom 1 pa nas 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa bsgom pa'i bar dang / gang rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba nas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon par 'du 5bya ba'i bar gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / gang yang de 'dra ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du bya ba da lta na 17byed pa dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byed par 'gyur ba nas/ nga'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgron ma 'di 'bar bar 'gyur ba'i bar du bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba'i tshogs de dag thams cad khyed kyi lag tu gtad do/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud pa'i chos kyi tshul yang dag par 'bar bar byed par brtson pa de dag gis bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang khyed kyi lag tu gtad do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa nas/ tha na glegs bam la bris te/ 'chang ba'i bar du byed pa de dag kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 56—705

'dis las thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag grong ngam dmangs kyi khyim gyi bar du gang dang gang na chos smra ba shin tu khrus byas te/ gos sar 1pa bgos nas/ me tog bkram pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs pa ras bcos bu dang / ras sna tshogs bting riba'i seng ge'i khri la 'dug ste/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lce'i rtse mos 'chad dam/ tha na glegs bam la bris te/ klog pa der gal te khyod chos nyan pa dang / chos smra ba bsrung ba'am / chos nyan pa rnams yongs su bskyang ba'am/ bdag dang gzhan dang gnyi ga mi dge ba'i las yongs su zad par bya ba'i phyir der ma dong na de'i phyir khyed kyis bslus pa dang / lam bskyed pa la rmongs pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang 4ma mchis pa'i dus na/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul gyi bar du nub par gyur pa na/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ ri brags samar/ pho brang 'khor tamane/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ dgon pa'i gnas sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ bram ze'i khyim 'am / tshong dpon gyi khyim 'am / dmangs kyi khyim gang dang gang du dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma chos smra ba dang ske/ gzhan yang dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shin tu khrus bgyis te / yan lag shin tu byugs nas gos sar 9pa 'tshal te/ me tog bkram pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs pa ras bcos bu dang ras sna tshogs bting ba ro bro ba sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i seng 1 ge'i khri la 'dug ste12/lce'i rtse mos gzungs kyi phyag rgya 'di gzhan dag la yang 1 rgya cher yang dag par 56—706

rab tu 'chad dam 1byis te/ klog pa der chos nyan pa nasan/ chos smra ba de bsrung ba'am / chos nyan pa de dag dang / bdag dang gzhan caganyi ga'i nyon mongs pa'i las yongs su sbyang ba'am/ dge ba'i chos yongs su smin par bgyi ba'am / chos kyi tshul chen po yang dag par 'bar bar bgyi ba'am/ ye shes kyi 5snang ba chen po mchog gi lam la 'jug pa'i slad du/ bdag 'khor brgya stong du mas bskor te/ der ma mchis sam/ grong nas dmangs kyi khyim gyi bar de dag yongs su bskyang ba dang / sems can de dag gi nor dang / 'bru dang /mdzod dang / bang ba mang po rab tu dgang ba'i slad du/ der ma mchis na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyan sngar bdag gis/ sngon ma thos pa'i bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ e negu ha/ e gu ha/ stong 7ga pu nar ha na/ ya mi kha kha kha kha/ kha kha 9kha ba kha ba / khrin na kha ba swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni gal te bdag chos nyan pa'am/ chos smra ba bsrung ba nas/ nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang —/ bang ba mang po rnam par 'phel bas/ tshim par bgyi ba'i bar gyi slad dul/ der ma mchis na/ yi dam las 'gal bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin thams cad kyis mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa de la legs so zhes bya ba rab tu byin no/ /de nas kau shi gas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da 1 ltar dang / ma mchis pa'i dus na grong ngam/ grong khyer gang dang gang du zhes bya ba nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyan sngar bdag 56wa 707

gis sngon ma thos pa'i bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /'di lta lte/ kha ba sri 1kha/ kha ba sri nakha/ na la gha/ a mud nya/ a mu ba ha/ a ka ṭa ṭa/ a kha/ a 5sha kha/ dzi na bra khe swā hā/bcom ldan 'das gal te 4bdag gis dam bcas pa bzhin du ma bgyis na/'di ni bdag gi bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba nas/ mi dang ske/ mi ma yin pa dag gis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la legs so zhes bya ba byin pa'i bar du'o/ /de nas 'phags skyes pos kyang gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das da 5ltar dang ma 'ongs 6pa'i dus na/ grong gi bar du gang dang gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba 7ma bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gis bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur lags so/ /'di lta ste/ u kha na ba na ba sa ba na/ sa mu dra sang jid dzñā ta thā nargyud ta/ ba ru 9kho ba bā 1 rā dzā swā hā/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar gyis rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po la legs so zhes bya ba rab tu byin no/ /de nas mig mi bzang gis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da 1ltar dang ma 'ongs 1 pa'i dus na grong gi bar du gang dang gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung dbar ma bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gis bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa 1 dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /'di lta ste/ dza lo gha/ a to gha/ a ma ma/ mo gha/a ma sa rā dza na tsarya ya mu 5dza swā hā/ de nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar gyis rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang la legs so zhes bya ba rab tu byin no/ /de nas yang :yul 'khor srung 7gis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 56—708

da ltar dang / ma 'ongs 1pa'i dus na/ grong gi bar du gang dang gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba nam bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gis bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /'di lta ste/bin du dza ba /kha ba/ dza ba ra mu kha/ kṣa sā car/ pu ka ba ha/ a mārga rab ṭa swā hā/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar gyis rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung la 6legs so zhes bya ba rab tu byin no/ /de nas lus ngan pos kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang / ma 'ongs 7pa'i dus na/ grong gi bar du gang dang gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ba na ma bgyis na/bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bro bor ba'i dam bcas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /'di lta ste/kṣu tre kṣa kṣu kṣu tre/ kha kṣu tre/ a ti kṣu tre/ a na ya na kṣa tre/ hre 9da kṣu tre/sa ga ra skṛ 1 da kṣu tre/ saṃ ku su kṣu tre/ dharma kṣa ya mu tre swāhā/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar gyis rgyal po chen po lus ngan po la legs so zhes bya ba rab tu byin to ske/ /yang de'i tshe gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 1 'di na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'di na yongs su skyong ba stong nyis brgya 1 dang /gzhan yang gling bzhi pa gzhan na gnas pa bzhi khri dang / gzhan yang lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rdzu 'phrul che ba/ rdzu 'phrul che ba de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang / ma 'ongs 1 pa'i dus na/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgron ma'i bar du nub par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lamanyag/56—709

ljongs sam/ ri brag gam1/ pho brang 'khor taman/ dgon pa'i gnas sam/rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ bram ze'i khyima'am / tshong dpon gyi khyima'am /bdag nyid chen po'i khyima'am5/ dmangs kyi khyim gang dang gang du dge slong ngam / dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen phyinam/ dge bsnyen 7ma chos smra ba dang /gzhan yang dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shin tu khrus bgyis te/yan lag shin tu byugs nas/ gos sar 8pa bgos te/ me tog bkram 9pa'i 'khor gyi khyams su ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs pa/ ro bro ba sna tshogs kyis bltam 1 pas brgyan pa'i seng 11ge'i khri la mchis te/ gzungs kyi phyag rgya'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lce'i rtse mos gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu 12bshad dam/ glegs bam la bris te/ klog par gal te bdag cag re re zhing yang 'khor brgya stong du mas bskor nas ma mchis sam / der chos nyan pa'am chos smra ba bsrung ba 1 dang rang gi 'khor bsrung ba dang ske/ sems can gzhan yang bsrung ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i slad du grong ngam/ grong rdal nas dmangs kyi khyim gyi bar de dag tu ma mchis sam/ 'khor dang bcas pas bka' ma mnos sam/ yongs su ma bskyangs sam/ der sems can rnams kyi nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang ske/ bang ba mang po rab tu ma bltama'am1 / der ma mchis sam/ der sems can rnams kyi 'thab pa dang / rtsod 15pa dang / mu ge dang / nad dang —/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / dus ma lags pa'i char pa dang /rlung dang / shin tu grang ba dang / tsha ba rnams ma bzlog na/ bdag cag gis 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom 56—710

ldan 'das thams cad 1bslus pa dang / 'khus pa dang / mnyes par ma bgyis par 'gyur te/ lus la sha bkras btab pa dang / lta ba yongs su nyams pa dang / lus rul bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag g.yog dang bcas pas/da naltar dang ma 'ongs 5pa'i dus na yang gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di 'bar bar bgyi'o/ / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan par bgyi'oca/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la dad pa'i gang zag rnams bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su smin par bgyi'o / /ngan par bgyis pa'i las yongs su sbyang ba'i slad du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan par 6chos smra ba'i gang zag de la bskul bar bgyi'o/ /chos smra ba dang / chos nyan pa de dag gi nor dang ske/ 'bru dang / longs 7spyod dang / kun spyod pa rnam par 'phel ba bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi 'jig pa'i chos su gzung bar bgyi'ol/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyis mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad la legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ / de nas 8de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ltad 9mo can gyis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ci lags/ gang bdud bye ba phrag brgya 1 po 'dir 'dus pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ltad mo can gyis 1 gsol pa/ ci 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis dkon mchog gsum la dad pa thob pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de 12ni ma yin no/ /bdud sdig can 56wa 711
